        "contents": "const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!\nconst SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!\n\nif (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY) {\n  console.error('Missing required environment variables')\n  process.exit(1)\n}\n\nconst supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY)\n\nconst TOOL_SELECTION_PROMPT_V3 = &#96;You are a router. Choose exactly one tool and return ONLY valid JSON: {\"tool\": string, \"args\": object}. No prose.\n\nAvailable Tools:\n\n1. getAaplFinancialsByMetric - Financial metrics as NUMBERS over time\n\n   SUPPORTED METRICS:\n   - revenue\n   - gross_profit\n   - net_income\n   - operating_income\n   - total_assets\n   - total_liabilities\n   - shareholders_equity\n   - operating_cash_flow\n   - eps\n\n   METRIC MAPPING (with context clues):\n\n   Income/Profitability:\n   - \"sales\", \"revenue\", \"top line\" → revenue\n   - \"profit\", \"earnings\", \"bottom line\", \"profitability\" → net_income\n   - \"EPS\", \"earnings per share\", \"P/E ratio\", \"PE\" → eps\n   - \"operating profit\", \"EBIT\" → operating_income\n   - \"gross profit\", \"gross margin\" → gross_profit\n\n   Balance Sheet:\n   - \"assets\", \"total assets\" → total_assets\n   - \"liabilities\", \"total debt\", \"debt\", \"debt to equity\" → total_liabilities\n   - \"equity\", \"book value\", \"shareholders equity\", \"ROE\", \"return on equity\" → shareholders_equity\n   - \"cash and equivalents\", \"cash on hand\", \"cash position\" (balance sheet) → total_assets\n\n   Cash Flow:\n   - \"cash flow\", \"operating cash\", \"free cash flow\", \"FCF\" → operating_cash_flow\n\n   Other (use closest available):\n   - \"R&amp;D\", \"research\", \"development\", \"capex\", \"buybacks\", \"dividends\", \"margins\", \"ratios\" → operating_income\n\n   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:\n\n   1. If question specifies a NUMBER, use that EXACT number:\n      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3\n      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5\n      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1\n      \"10 years\" → limit: 10\n      \"2 years\" → limit: 2\n\n   2. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4\n\n   3. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 10\n\n   4. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5\n   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4\n   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4\n   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4\n   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 10\n\n   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}\n\n2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history\n\n   SUPPORTED RANGES:\n   - 7d (one week)\n   - 30d (one month)\n   - 90d (one quarter)\n\n   RANGE MAPPING - CRITICAL:\n\n   For 7d (use when):\n   - \"today\", \"current price\", \"now\", \"latest\"\n   - \"this week\", \"past week\", \"5 days\"\n   - \"recent\" or \"recently\" (without other context)\n\n   For 30d (use when):\n   - \"month\", \"30 days\", \"this month\", \"past month\"\n   - \"price\" (ambiguous, default to 30d)\n   - \"how's the stock doing\" (ambiguous, default to 30d)\n\n   For 90d (use when):\n   - \"quarter\", \"Q1\", \"90 days\", \"3 months\"\n   - \"6 months\", \"half year\" (closest available)\n   - \"year\", \"YTD\", \"12 months\", \"annual\" (closest available)\n   - \"long term\", \"historical\"\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"What's the price?\" → 30d (ambiguous defaults to month)\n   - \"How's the stock doing?\" → 30d\n   - \"Price today\" → 7d\n   - \"Show me 1 year performance\" → 90d\n   - \"6 month chart\" → 90d\n\n   args: {\"range\": \"7d\" | \"30d\" | \"90d\"}\n\n3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata\n\n   LIMIT RULES:\n\n   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number\n      \"last 3 filings\" → limit: 3\n      \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1\n      \"2 years of filings\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)\n\n   2. If question says \"recent\", \"latest\" (no number) → limit: 5\n\n   3. If question says \"all\", \"available\", \"history\" → limit: 10\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"recent filings\" → limit: 5\n   - \"last 3 10-Ks\" → limit: 3\n   - \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1\n   - \"all available reports\" → limit: 10\n   - \"filing history\" → limit: 10\n\n   args: {\"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}\n\n4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content\n\n   Use for qualitative questions about:\n   - Risks, strategy, operations, business model\n   - Management commentary, outlook\n   - Products, markets, competition\n   - Governance, compensation\n\n   QUERY RULES:\n   - Extract key terms from user's question\n   - Keep it simple (1-3 words usually best)\n   - Don't need full sentences\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"What are the risk factors?\" → query: \"risk factors\"\n   - \"Tell me about competition\" → query: \"competition\"\n   - \"Search for AI mentions\" → query: \"AI\"\n\n   args: {\"query\": \"&lt;keywords&gt;\", \"limit\": 5}\n\nTOOL SELECTION LOGIC:\n\n1. Numbers/metrics over time? → getAaplFinancialsByMetric\n2. Stock price? → getPrices\n3. List filings? → getRecentFilings\n4. Qualitative content search? → searchFilings\n\nUser question: \"{{USER_QUESTION}}\"\n\nReturn ONLY JSON - examples:\n\n{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"revenue\",\"limit\":5}}\n{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"eps\",\"limit\":1}}\n{\"tool\":\"getPrices\",\"args\":{\"range\":\"30d\"}}\n{\"tool\":\"getRecentFilings\",\"args\":{\"limit\":3}}\n{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}&#96;\n\nasync function addPromptV3() {\n  console.log('📝 Adding prompt v3 to database...\\n')\n}",

No prose.\n\nAvailable Tools:\n\n1. getAaplFinancialsByMetric - Financial metrics as NUMBERS over time\n\n   SUPPORTED METRICS:\n\n   Raw Metrics:\n   - revenue, gross_profit, net_income, operating_income\n   - total_assets, total_liabilities, shareholders_equity\n   - operating_cash_flow, eps\n\n   Calculated Metrics (✨ Native Support):\n   - debt_to_equity_ratio  (total_liabilities / shareholders_equity)\n   - gross_margin          (gross_profit / revenue × 100)\n   - roe                   (net_income / shareholders_equity × 100)\n\n   METRIC MAPPING (with context clues):\n\n   Income/Profitability:\n   - \"sales\", \"revenue\", \"top line\" → revenue\n   - \"profit\", \"earnings\", \"bottom line\", \"profitability\" → net_income\n   - \"EPS\", \"earnings per share\" → eps\n   - \"operating profit\", \"EBIT\" → operating_income\n\n   Valuation Ratios (use getFinancialMetric tool):\n   - \"P/E ratio\", \"PE ratio\", \"price to earnings\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/E\"]\n   - \"P/B ratio\", \"price to book\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/B\"]\n   - \"PEG ratio\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"PEG\"]\n\n   Calculated Ratios (✨ NOW NATIVE - use directly):\n   - \"gross margin\", \"gross profit margin\" → gross_margin\n   - \"ROE\", \"return on equity\" → roe\n   - \"debt to equity\", \"debt-to-equity\", \"D/E ratio\", \"leverage ratio\" → debt_to_equity_ratio\n\n   Balance Sheet (Raw):\n   - \"assets\", \"total assets\" → total_assets\n   - \"liabilities\", \"total debt\", \"debt\" → total_liabilities\n   - \"equity\", \"book value\", \"shareholders equity\" → shareholders_equity\n\n   Cash Flow:\n   - \"operating cash flow\", \"cash from operations\", \"OCF\" → operating_cash_flow\n   - \"free cash flow\", \"FCF\", \"unlevered free cash flow\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\n   - \"capex\", \"capital expenditures\", \"buybacks\", \"dividends paid\", \"stock-based compensation\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\n\n   Research &amp; Development:\n   - \"R&amp;D\", \"research and development\", \"R&amp;D spending\", \"R&amp;D expense\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"R&amp;D to revenue\"] or [\"research and development\"]\n\n   Other (use closest available):\n   - \"margins\", \"ratios\" (when not specific) → operating_income\n\n   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:\n\n   1. If question asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (2020, 2019, 2015, 2006, etc.) → limit: 20\n      Why: We have 20 years (2006-2025). To find any specific year, fetch all.\n      Examples:\n      - \"net income in 2020\" → limit: 20\n      - \"revenue for 2018\" → limit: 20\n      - \"What was EPS in 2006?\" → limit: 20\n\n   2. If question asks for a YEAR RANGE (2008 to 2020, 2015 to present, etc.) → limit: 20\n      Why: Need all data to filter to the specific range.\n      Examples:\n      - \"net income 2008 to present\" → limit: 20\n      - \"revenue from 2015 to 2020\" → limit: 20\n      - \"EPS between 2010 and 2018\" → limit: 20\n\n   3. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:\n      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3\n      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5\n      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1\n      \"10 years\" → limit: 10\n      \"20 years\" → limit: 20\n      \"2 years\" → limit: 2\n\n   4. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4\n\n   5. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 20\n\n   6. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"net income in 2006\" → limit: 20 (specific year)\n   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5 (number specified)\n   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 20 (all data)\n\n   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-20&gt;}\n\n2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history\n\n   ALWAYS use custom date ranges. Calculate the \"from\" date based on the user's request.\n   Today's date is {{TODAY_DATE}} (use this for calculations).\n\n   Date format: YYYY-MM-DD\n   \"to\" is optional (defaults to today)\n\n   CALCULATION EXAMPLES:\n   - \"last 7 days\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-11-01\"} (7 days ago)\n   - \"past month\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-10-08\"} (30 days ago)\n   - \"last 3 months\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-08-08\"} (90 days ago)\n   - \"past year\" → args: {\"from\": \"2024-11-08\"} (365 days ago)\n   - \"YTD\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-01-01\"} (start of current year)\n   - \"last 3 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2022-11-08\"} (3 years ago)\n   - \"past 5 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-11-08\"} (5 years ago)\n   - \"last 7 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-11-08\"} (7 years ago)\n   - \"past 10 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-11-08\"} (10 years ago)\n   - \"last 15 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2010-11-08\"} (15 years ago)\n   - \"past 20 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago)\n   - \"all time\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago, max available)\n\n   EXACT DATE RANGES:\n   - \"from Jan 2020 to June 2023\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-01-01\", \"to\": \"2023-06-30\"}\n   - \"prices between 2015 and 2020\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-01-01\", \"to\": \"2020-12-31\"}\n   - \"from March 2018 to now\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-03-01\"}\n\n   args: {\"from\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\", \"to\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\"}  (to is optional)\n\n3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata ONLY\n\n   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool returns ONLY metadata (filing type, date, URL).\n   It does NOT return filing CONTENT or text.\n\n   Use ONLY when:\n   - User wants to know WHEN filings were submitted\n   - User wants to know WHICH filings exist\n   - User wants filing dates/types/URLs\n\n   DO NOT USE when:\n   - User asks WHAT the filing says\n   - User wants content, quotes, or information FROM the filing\n   - User asks about topics like risks, strategy, etc.\n   → Use searchFilings instead for content questions!\n\n   LIMIT RULES:\n\n   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number\n      \"last 3 filings\" → limit: 3\n      \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1\n      \"2 years of filings\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)\n\n   2. If question says \"recent\", \"latest\" (no number) → limit: 5\n\n   3. If question says \"all\", \"available\", \"history\" → limit: 10\n\n   Examples (metadata questions):\n   - \"when was the most recent filing?\" → limit: 1\n   - \"what filings do you have?\" → limit: 5\n   - \"show me filing dates\" → limit: 5\n\n   args: {\"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}\n\n4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content (for WHAT they say)\n\n   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Use this when user asks about CONTENT, not just dates!\n\n   Use for ANY question about WHAT the filings say:\n   - Risk factors, strategy, operations, business model\n   - Management commentary, outlook, quotes\n   - Products, markets, competition\n   - Governance, compensation\n   - ANY question asking \"what did they say\", \"provide quotes\", etc.\n\n   Even if they mention \"latest 10-K\" or specific filing:\n   - \"What are risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → USE searchFilings\n   - \"What does the 10-K say about AI?\" → USE searchFilings\n   - \"Provide quotes from recent filing\" → USE searchFilings\n\n   QUERY RULES:\n   -             "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"gross margin\", \"gross profit margin\" → gross_margin",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"ROE\", \"return on equity\" → roe",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"debt to equity\", \"debt-to-equity\", \"D/E ratio\", \"leverage ratio\" → debt_to_equity_ratio",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "   Balance Sheet (Raw):",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"assets\", \"total assets\" → total_assets",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"liabilities\", \"total debt\", \"debt\" → total_liabilities",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"equity\", \"book value\", \"shareholders equity\" → shareholders_equity",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "   Cash Flow:",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"operating cash flow\", \"cash from operations\", \"OCF\" → operating_cash_flow",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"free cash flow\", \"FCF\", \"unlevered free cash flow\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"capex\", \"capital expenditures\", \"buybacks\", \"dividends paid\", \"stock-based compensation\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "   Research &amp; Development:",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"R&amp;D\", \"research and development\", \"R&amp;D spending\", \"R&amp;D expense\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"R&amp;D to revenue\"] or [\"research and development\"]",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "   Other (use closest available):",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"margins\", \"ratios\" (when not specific) → operating_income",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "   1. If question asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (2020, 2019, 2015, 2006, etc.) → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "      Why: We have 20 years (2006-2025). To find any specific year, fetch all.",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "      Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"net income in 2020\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"revenue for 2018\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"What was EPS in 2006?\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "   2. If question asks for a YEAR RANGE (2008 to 2020, 2015 to present, etc.) → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "      Why: Need all data to filter to the specific range.",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "      Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"net income 2008 to present\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"revenue from 2015 to 2020\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"EPS between 2010 and 2018\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "   3. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"10 years\" → limit: 10",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"20 years\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"2 years\" → limit: 2",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "   4. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "   5. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "   6. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"net income in 2006\" → limit: 20 (specific year)",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5 (number specified)",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 20 (all data)",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-20&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "   ALWAYS use custom date ranges. Calculate the \"from\" date based on the user's request.",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "   Today's date is {{TODAY_DATE}} (use this for calculations).",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "   Date format: YYYY-MM-DD",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "   \"to\" is optional (defaults to today)",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "   CALCULATION EXAMPLES:",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 7 days\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-11-01\"} (7 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past month\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-10-08\"} (30 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 3 months\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-08-08\"} (90 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past year\" → args: {\"from\": \"2024-11-08\"} (365 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"YTD\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-01-01\"} (start of current year)",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 3 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2022-11-08\"} (3 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 5 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-11-08\"} (5 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 7 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-11-08\"} (7 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 10 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-11-08\"} (10 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 15 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2010-11-08\"} (15 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 20 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"all time\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago, max available)",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "   EXACT DATE RANGES:",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"from Jan 2020 to June 2023\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-01-01\", \"to\": \"2023-06-30\"}",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"prices between 2015 and 2020\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-01-01\", \"to\": \"2020-12-31\"}",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"from March 2018 to now\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-03-01\"}",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"from\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\", \"to\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\"}  (to is optional)",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata ONLY",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool returns ONLY metadata (filing type, date, URL).",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "   It does NOT return filing CONTENT or text.",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use ONLY when:",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to know WHEN filings were submitted",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to know WHICH filings exist",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants filing dates/types/URLs",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "   DO NOT USE when:",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks WHAT the filing says",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants content, quotes, or information FROM the filing",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks about topics like risks, strategy, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "   → Use searchFilings instead for content questions!",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES:",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last 3 filings\" → limit: 3",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"2 years of filings\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "   2. If question says \"recent\", \"latest\" (no number) → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "   3. If question says \"all\", \"available\", \"history\" → limit: 10",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples (metadata questions):",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"when was the most recent filing?\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"what filings do you have?\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"show me filing dates\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content (for WHAT they say)",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Use this when user asks about CONTENT, not just dates!",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use for ANY question about WHAT the filings say:",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Risk factors, strategy, operations, business model",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Management commentary, outlook, quotes",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Products, markets, competition",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Governance, compensation",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ANY question asking \"what did they say\", \"provide quotes\", etc.",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "   Even if they mention \"latest 10-K\" or specific filing:",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What are risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What does the 10-K say about AI?\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Provide quotes from recent filing\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "   QUERY RULES:",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Extract key terms from user's question",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Keep it simple (1-3 words usually best)",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Don't need full sentences",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What are the risk factors?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What about risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Tell me about competition\" → {\"query\": \"competition\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Provide quotes about AI strategy\" → {\"query\": \"AI strategy\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone?\" → {\"query\": \"iPhone\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"query\": \"&lt;keywords&gt;\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "5. listMetrics - DISCOVER available financial metrics",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use when:",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks \"what metrics do you have?\"",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to browse metrics by category",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Uncertain which metric name to use for getFinancialMetric",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "   CATEGORY FILTER (optional):",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Valuation: P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, market cap, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Profitability &amp; Returns: ROE, ROA, ROIC, margins",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Growth: revenue growth, EPS growth, asset growth",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Leverage &amp; Solvency: debt ratios, liquidity ratios",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Efficiency &amp; Working Capital: turnover ratios, cycle days",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Capital Returns &amp; Share Data: dividend yield, payout ratio",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Per-Share Metrics: EPS, book value per share, cash per share",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Market Data: stock metrics, valuation metrics",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Other: miscellaneous metrics",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What valuation metrics do you have?\" → {\"category\": \"Valuation\"}",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Show me all metrics\" → {} (no category)",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What debt metrics are available?\" → {\"category\": \"Leverage &amp; Solvency\"}",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"category\": \"&lt;optional category name&gt;\"}",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "6. getFinancialMetric - GET advanced financial metrics (139 metrics available)",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "   COMPLETE METRIC CATALOG (organized by category):",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "   Valuation (11):",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "   - peRatio, priceToBookRatio, priceToSalesRatio, priceToFreeCashFlowsRatio, earningsYield",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "   - marketCap, enterpriseValue, evToSales, evToOperatingCashFlow, evToFreeCashFlow, freeCashFlowYield",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "   Profitability &amp; Returns (12):",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "   - grossProfitMargin, operatingProfitMargin, netProfitMargin, ebitPerRevenue, ebitdaMargin, pretaxProfitMargin",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "   - returnOnEquity, returnOnAssets, returnOnCapitalEmployed, roic, ebtPerEbit, netIncomePerEBT",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "   Growth (32):",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "   - revenueGrowth, grossProfitGrowth, operatingIncomeGrowth, netIncomeGrowth, ebitgrowth",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "   - epsgrowth, epsdilutedGrowth, operatingCashFlowGrowth, freeCashFlowGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "   - assetGrowth, debtGrowth, inventoryGrowth, receivablesGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendsperShareGrowth, bookValueperShareGrowth, weightedAverageSharesGrowth, weightedAverageSharesDilutedGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "   - rdexpenseGrowth, sgaexpensesGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "   - threeYRevenueGrowthPerShare, threeYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, threeYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "   - threeYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, threeYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "   - fiveYRevenueGrowthPerShare, fiveYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, fiveYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "   - fiveYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, fiveYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "   - tenYRevenueGrowthPerShare, tenYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, tenYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "   - tenYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, tenYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "   Leverage &amp; Solvency (9):",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "   - debtEquityRatio, debtRatio, currentRatio, quickRatio, cashRatio",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "   - interestCoverage, longTermDebtToCapitalization, totalDebtToCapitalization, cashFlowToDebtRatio",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "   Efficiency &amp; Working Capital (7):",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "   - assetTurnover, fixedAssetTurnover, inventoryTurnover, receivablesTurnover, payablesTurnover",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "   - cashConversionCycle, daysOfInventoryOutstanding, daysOfSalesOutstanding, daysOfPayablesOutstanding",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "   Cash Flow (2):",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "   - freeCashFlow, capitalExpenditure",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "   Capital Returns &amp; Share Data (5):",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendYield, payoutRatio, dividendsPaid, commonStockRepurchased, numberOfShares",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "   Per-Share Metrics (7):",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "   - bookValuePerShare, cashPerShare, operatingCashFlowPerShare, freeCashFlowPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "   - netIncomePerShare, revenuePerShare, tangibleBookValuePerShare",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "   Market Data (1):",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "   - stockPrice",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "   Other (53):",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ebitda, stockBasedCompensation, depreciationAndAmortization, workingCapital, effectiveTaxRate",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "   - marketCapitalization, enterpriseValueMultiple, enterpriseValueOverEBITDA",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "   - pbRatio, pfcfRatio, pocfratio, priceBookValueRatio, priceCashFlowRatio, priceEarningsRatio",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "   - priceEarningsToGrowthRatio, priceFairValue, priceSalesRatio, priceToOperatingCashFlowsRatio, ptbRatio",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "   - roe, returnOnTangibleAssets",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "   - researchAndDdevelopementToRevenue, salesGeneralAndAdministrativeToRevenue, stockBasedCompensationToRevenue",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "   - capexPerShare, capexToDepreciation, capexToOperatingCashFlow, capexToRevenue",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "   - shareholdersEquityPerShare, tangibleAssetValue, investedCapital",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "   - debtToAssets, debtToEquity, netDebtToEBITDA",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "   - operatingCashFlowSalesRatio, freeCashFlowOperatingCashFlowRatio",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "   - cashFlowCoverageRatios, capitalExpenditureCoverageRatio, dividendPaidAndCapexCoverageRatio, shortTermCoverageRatios",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendPayoutRatio, interestDebtPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "   - companyEquityMultiplier, intangiblesToTotalAssets",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "   - daysOfInventoryOnHand, daysPayablesOutstanding, daysSalesOutstanding, operatingCycle",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "   - incomeQuality, grahamNumber, grahamNetNet, netCurrentAssetValue",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "   - averageInventory, averagePayables, averageReceivables",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "   - addTotalDebt, minusCashAndCashEquivalents",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "   METRIC NAME FLEXIBILITY:",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Accepts canonical names: \"peRatio\", \"returnOnEquity\", \"debtEquityRatio\"",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Accepts common aliases: \"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Can handle multiple metrics in one call",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES (same as getAaplFinancialsByMetric):",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Specific year → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Number specified → use that number",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"trend\", \"history\" → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"compare\" with multiple metrics → limit: 10 (show more history for comparisons)",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Default → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's Apple's P/E ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's the price to book ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"price to book\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Show me ROE trend\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"ROE\"], \"limit\": 4}",
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's Apple's free cash flow?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"free cash flow\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"How much did Apple spend on buybacks?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"buybacks\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Show me capex trend\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"capex\"], \"limit\": 4}",
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Compare P/E, ROE, and debt to equity\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"], \"limit\": 10}",
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Compare P/E and ROE\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\", \"ROE\"], \"limit\": 10}",
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Dividend yield for 2023\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"dividend yield\"], \"limit\": 20}",
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"metricNames\": [\"&lt;metric1&gt;\", \"&lt;metric2&gt;\"], \"limit\": &lt;number&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "TOOL SELECTION LOGIC:",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Basic financial metrics (revenue, assets, eps, etc.)? → getAaplFinancialsByMetric",
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Advanced metrics (P/E, ROE, debt ratios, etc.)? → getFinancialMetric",
            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "text": "3. User asks \"what metrics available\"? → listMetrics",
            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Stock price? → getPrices",
            "lineNumber": 373
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Filing metadata ONLY (when/which filings)? → getRecentFilings",
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "6. Filing CONTENT (what they say, quotes, topics)? → searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "⚠️ KEY DISTINCTION for #6 vs #7:",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"When was the latest 10-K filed?\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"What does the latest 10-K say about risks?\" → searchFilings (content)",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"Show me recent filings\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"What are risk factors in the latest 10-K?\" → searchFilings (content)",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"Provide quotes from the 10-K\" → searchFilings (content)",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "Return ONLY JSON - examples:",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"revenue\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"eps\",\"limit\":1}}",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"total_liabilities\",\"limit\":4}}",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getPrices\",\"args\":{\"from\":\"2018-11-15\"}}",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getPrices\",\"args\":{\"from\":\"2025-01-01\",\"to\":\"2025-11-15\"}}",
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getRecentFilings\",\"args\":{\"limit\":3}}",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"AI strategy\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"listMetrics\",\"args\":{\"category\":\"Valuation\"}}",
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"listMetrics\",\"args\":{}}",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\"],\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"ROE\",\"debt to equity\"],\"limit\":10}}",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "CRITICAL EXAMPLES - Filing Content vs Metadata:",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"When was the latest 10-K filed?\"",
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"getRecentFilings\",\"args\":{\"limit\":1}}",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"What about risk factors in their latest 10k? provide quotes.\"",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone sales?\"",
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"iPhone sales\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"Provide quotes from the latest filing about competition\"",
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"competition\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "text": "CRITICAL EXAMPLES - Advanced Metrics:",
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"What is AAPL's debt to equity ratio?\"",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"debt to equity\"],\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"Show me P/E ratio trend\"",
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\"],\"limit\":4}}",
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"What's the ROE in 2023?\"",
            "lineNumber": 419
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"ROE\"],\"limit\":20}}",
            "lineNumber": 420
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 421
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"Compare P/E and PEG ratio\"",
            "lineNumber": 422
          },
          {
            "text": "A: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\",\"PEG\"],\"limit\":10}}&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 423
          },

        "contents": "const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY })\nconst supabase = createClient(\n  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,\n  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY\n)\n\n// Inline prompts from lib/tools.ts (using the updated Phase 0 prompts)\nconst buildToolSelectionPrompt = (userQuestion) =&gt; &#96;You are a router. Choose exactly one tool and return ONLY valid JSON: {\"tool\": string, \"args\": object}. No prose.\n\nAvailable Tools:\n\n1. getAaplFinancialsByMetric - Financial metrics as NUMBERS over time\n\n   SUPPORTED METRICS:\n   - revenue\n   - gross_profit\n   - net_income\n   - operating_income\n   - total_assets\n   - total_liabilities\n   - shareholders_equity\n   - operating_cash_flow\n   - eps\n\n   METRIC MAPPING (with context clues):\n\n   Income/Profitability:\n   - \"sales\", \"revenue\", \"top line\" → revenue\n   - \"profit\", \"earnings\", \"bottom line\", \"profitability\" → net_income\n   - \"EPS\", \"earnings per share\", \"P/E ratio\", \"PE\" → eps\n   - \"operating profit\", \"EBIT\" → operating_income\n   - \"gross profit\", \"gross margin\" → gross_profit\n\n   Balance Sheet:\n   - \"assets\", \"total assets\" → total_assets\n   - \"liabilities\", \"total debt\", \"debt\", \"debt to equity\" → total_liabilities\n   - \"equity\", \"book value\", \"shareholders equity\", \"ROE\", \"return on equity\" → shareholders_equity\n   - \"cash and equivalents\", \"cash on hand\", \"cash position\" (balance sheet) → total_assets\n\n   Cash Flow:\n   - \"cash flow\", \"operating cash\", \"free cash flow\", \"FCF\" → operating_cash_flow\n\n   Other (use closest available):\n   - \"R&amp;D\", \"research\", \"development\", \"capex\", \"buybacks\", \"dividends\", \"margins\", \"ratios\" → operating_income\n\n   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:\n\n   1. If question asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (2020, 2019, 2015, etc.) → limit: 10\n      Why: We only have 10 years (2015-2024). To find any specific year, fetch all.\n      Examples:\n      - \"net income in 2020\" → limit: 10\n      - \"revenue for 2018\" → limit: 10\n      - \"What was EPS in 2015?\" → limit: 10\n\n   2. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:\n      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3\n      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5\n      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1\n      \"10 years\" → limit: 10\n      \"2 years\" → limit: 2\n\n   3. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4\n\n   4. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 10\n\n   5. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"net income in 2020\" → limit: 10 (specific year)\n   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5 (number specified)\n   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 10 (all data)\n\n   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}\n\n2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history\n\n   SUPPORTED RANGES:\n   - 7d (one week)\n   - 30d (one month)\n   - 90d (one quarter)\n\n   RANGE MAPPING - CRITICAL:\n\n   For 7d (use when):\n   - \"today\", \"current price\", \"now\", \"latest\"\n   - \"this week\", \"past week\", \"5 days\"\n   - \"recent\" or \"recently\" (without other context)\n\n   For 30d (use when):\n   - \"month\", \"30 days\", \"this month\", \"past month\"\n   - \"price\" (ambiguous, default to 30d)\n   - \"how's the stock doing\" (ambiguous, default to 30d)\n\n   For 90d (use when):\n   - \"quarter\", \"Q1\", \"90 days\", \"3 months\"\n   - \"6 months\", \"half year\" (closest available)\n   - \"year\", \"YTD\", \"12 months\", \"annual\" (closest available)\n   - \"long term\", \"historical\"\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"What's the price?\" → 30d (ambiguous defaults to month)\n   - \"How's the stock doing?\" → 30d\n   - \"Price today\" → 7d\n   - \"Show me 1 year performance\" → 90d\n   - \"6 month chart\" → 90d\n\n   args: {\"range\": \"7d\" | \"30d\" | \"90d\"}\n\n3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata\n\n   LIMIT RULES:\n\n   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number\n      \"last 3 filings\" → limit: 3\n      \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1\n      \"2 years of filings\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)\n\n   2. If question says \"recent\", \"latest\" (no number) → limit: 5\n\n   3. If question says \"all\", \"available\", \"history\" → limit: 10\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"recent filings\" → limit: 5\n   - \"last 3 10-Ks\" → limit: 3\n   - \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1\n   - \"all available reports\" → limit: 10\n   - \"filing history\" → limit: 10\n\n   args: {\"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}\n\n4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content\n\n   Use for qualitative questions about:\n   - Risks, strategy, operations, business model\n   - Management commentary, outlook\n   - Products, markets, competition\n   - Governance, compensation\n\n   QUERY RULES:\n   - Extract key terms from user's question\n   - Keep it simple (1-3 words usually best)\n   - Don't need full sentences\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"What are the risk factors?\" → query: \"risk factors\"\n   - \"Tell me about competition\" → query: \"competition\"\n   - \"Search for AI mentions\" → query: \"AI\"\n\n   args: {\"query\": \"&lt;keywords&gt;\", \"limit\": 5}\n\nTOOL SELECTION LOGIC:\n\n1. Numbers/metrics over time? → getAaplFinancialsByMetric\n2. Stock price? → getPrices\n3. List filings? → getRecentFilings\n4. Qualitative content search? → searchFilings\n\nUser question: \"${userQuestion}\"\n\nReturn ONLY JSON - examples:\n\n{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"revenue\",\"limit\":5}}\n{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"eps\",\"limit\":1}}\n{\"tool\":\"getPrices\",\"args\":{\"range\":\"30d\"}}\n{\"tool\":\"getRecentFilings\",\"args\":{\"limit\":3}}\n{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "   SUPPORTED RANGES:",

          },
          {
            "text": "   - 7d (one week)",

          },
          {
            "text": "   - 30d (one month)",

          },
          {
            "text": "   - 90d (one quarter)",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "   RANGE MAPPING - CRITICAL:",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "   For 7d (use when):",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"today\", \"current price\", \"now\", \"latest\"",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"this week\", \"past week\", \"5 days\"",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"recent\" or \"recently\" (without other context)",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "   For 30d (use when):",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"month\", \"30 days\", \"this month\", \"past month\"",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"price\" (ambiguous, default to 30d)",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"how's the stock doing\" (ambiguous, default to 30d)",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "   For 90d (use when):",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"quarter\", \"Q1\", \"90 days\", \"3 months\"",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"6 months\", \"half year\" (closest available)",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"year\", \"YTD\", \"12 months\", \"annual\" (closest available)",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"long term\", \"historical\"",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118
          },

          },

          },

          },

        "contents": "export async function askQuestion(\n  userQuestion: string,\n  conversationHistory: ConversationHistory = [],\n  sessionId: string = ''\n): Promise&lt;AskQuestionResponse&gt; {\n\n\n    // Step 3: Generate final answer using the fetched facts and conversation history\n    const answerGenerationStart = Date.now()\n    const answerPrompt = buildFinalAnswerPrompt(userQuestion, factsJson, previousToolResults)\n\n    // Debug logging\n    console.log('🔍 DEBUG - Question:', userQuestion)\n    console.log('🔍 DEBUG - Facts JSON LENGTH:', factsJson.length, 'characters')\n    console.log('🔍 DEBUG - Facts JSON PREVIEW:', factsJson.substring(0, 500))\n    console.log('🔍 DEBUG - Facts JSON FULL:', factsJson)\n    console.log('🔍 DEBUG - Prompt (first 800 chars):', answerPrompt.substring(0, 800))\n\n    // Build messages array with conversation history\n    const formattingInstructions = [\n      'You are Fin Quote analyst assistant.',\n      'Use only the provided facts; never guess or pull in outside data.',\n      'Respond in plain text sentences with no Markdown, bullets, bold, italics, tables, or code blocks.',\n      'If the answer covers more than four data points (years, filings, etc.), write at most two sentences: first sentence includes the earliest year/value, latest year/value, and any notable high or low; second sentence describes the overall trend and reminds the user to check the data table below for the full yearly breakdown.',\n      'Keep answers concise and follow user instructions precisely.',\n    ].join(' ')\n\n    const historyLimit = process.env.OPENAI_MODEL?.includes('gpt-5') ? 4 : 10\n    const recentHistory = conversationHistory.slice(-historyLimit)\n\n    const answerMessages: SimpleMessage[] = [\n      { role: 'system', content: formattingInstructions },\n      // Include a limited slice of prior conversation to reduce prompt size\n      ...recentHistory.map(msg =&gt; ({\n        role: msg.role as 'user' | 'assistant',\n        content: msg.content,\n      })),\n      // Add current question with facts\n      {\n        role: 'user',\n        content: answerPrompt,\n      },\n    ]\n\n    const answerInput = toResponseInputMessages(answerMessages)\n\n    const answerResponse = await openai.responses.create\n\n}",

        "contents": "export async function askQuestion(\n  userQuestion: string,\n  conversationHistory: ConversationHistory = [],\n  sessionId: string = ''\n): Promise&lt;AskQuestionResponse&gt; {\n\n\n    const selectionResponse = await openai.responses.create({\n      model: process.env.OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini', // Fast and cheap for routing\n      input: selectionInput,\n      ...(process.env.OPENAI_MODEL?.includes('gpt-5') ? {} : { temperature: 0 }),\n      // GPT-5 models need more tokens for reasoning + output (reasoning tokens count against limit)\n      // Set to 20,000 to ensure model has enough room for complex reasoning\n      max_output_tokens: process.env.OPENAI_MODEL?.includes('gpt-5') ? 20000 : 150,\n      ...(process.env.OPENAI_MODEL?.includes('gpt-5') ? { reasoning: { effort: 'minimal' } } : {}),\n      text: { format: { type: 'json_object' } },\n    })\n\n    // Capture token usage\n    toolSelectionPromptTokens = selectionResponse.usage?.input_tokens\n    toolSelectionCompletionTokens = selectionResponse.usage?.output_tokens\n    toolSelectionTotalTokens = selectionResponse.usage?.total_tokens\n\n    console.log('🎯 TOOL SELECTION TOKENS:', {\n      input: toolSelectionPromptTokens,\n      output: toolSelectionCompletionTokens,\n      total: toolSelectionTotalTokens\n    })\n\n    // Extract content from Responses API output\n    let selectionContent: string | undefined = extractResponseText(selectionResponse as any)\n\n    if (!selectionContent) {\n      console.error('Tool selection returned empty response:', selectionResponse)\n      return { answer: '', dataUsed: null, chartConfig: null, error: 'Failed to select tool', queryLogId: null }\n    }\n\n    console.log('🔍 DEBUG - Tool selection content:', selectionContent)\n\n    // Parse the JSON response\n    let toolSelection: { tool: string; args: any }\n    try {\n      toolSelection = JSON.parse(selectionContent.trim())\n    } catch (parseError) {\n      console.error('Failed to parse tool selection:', selectionContent)\n      return {\n        answer: '',\n        dataUsed: null,\n        chartConfig: null,\n        error: 'Failed to parse tool selection',\n        queryLogId: null,\n      }\n    }\n\n    toolSelectionLatencyMs = Date.now() - toolSelectionStart\n}",

        "contents": "export const buildFinalAnswerPrompt = \n&#96;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return &#96;You are an analyst. Answer the user using ONLY the provided facts${previousToolResults &amp;&amp; previousToolResults.length &gt; 0 ? ' and previous context' : ''}.\n\nUser question: \"${userQuestion}\"\n\nFacts (JSON rows):\n${factsJson}\n${previousContextSection}\n\nCRITICAL VALIDATION RULES - Follow These Exactly:\n\n1. NUMBERS - Use EXACT numbers from the data with proper formatting:\n   - Copy numbers precisely from the facts JSON\n   - Format large dollar amounts with B (billions) or M (millions)\n   - Example: 383285000000 → \"$383.3B\" (NOT \"$383B\" or \"around $380B\")\n   - Format ratios and percentages with 2 decimal places maximum\n   - Example: 34.092882867601105 → \"34.09\" (NOT \"34.092882867601105\")\n   - NEVER round significantly or estimate, but do round to 2 decimal places for readability\n   - If a number is 383.285B, say \"$383.3B\" not \"$383B\"\n   - For stock prices, ALWAYS add '$' before the price: \"$243.85\" not \"243.85\"\n\n2. YEARS - ONLY mention years that appear in the facts:\n   - Before mentioning any year, verify it exists in the facts JSON\n   - If asked about a year NOT in the facts, say: \"I don't have data for [year].\"\n   - DO NOT extrapolate, estimate, or guess for missing years\n   - Example: If facts have [2024, 2023, 2022, 2021] and user asks for 2020, say \"I don't have 2020 data\"\n\n3. DATES - Use EXACT dates from the data:\n   - For filings, use the exact filing_date from the facts\n   - For periods, use the exact period_end_date from the facts\n   - NEVER invent or approximate dates\n   - Example: If filing_date is \"2024-11-01\", say \"November 1, 2024\" not \"November 2024\"\n\n4. CITATIONS - Use EXACT filing information:\n   - If mentioning a filing, verify its filing_type and filing_date are in the facts\n   - Example: \"According to the 10-K filed November 1, 2024...\" (use exact date from data)\n   - NEVER reference filings not present in the facts\n\n4a. SEC FILING PASSAGES - When facts contain SEC filing content:\n   - The facts JSON contains \"chunk_text\" fields with actual text from SEC filings\n   - ⚠️ CRITICAL: READ ALL PASSAGES COMPLETELY before answering\n   - ⚠️ CRITICAL: Search through ALL passages for the information requested\n\n   When user asks about specific topics (e.g., \"iPhone sales\", \"risk factors\"):\n   1. Scan through ALL passages looking for mentions of that topic\n   2. If you find relevant data (numbers, quotes, facts), EXTRACT IT and provide it\n   3. DO NOT say \"I can provide it if you want\" - JUST PROVIDE IT\n   4. DO NOT be overly cautious - if the data is there, use it\n\n   For DATA in tables or structured format:\n   - Extract the numbers and present them clearly\n   - Example: If passage contains \"iPhone $ 201,183 $ 200,583 $ 205,489\" with headers \"2024 2023 2022\"\n   - Answer: \"According to the 10-K filed November 1, 2024, iPhone net sales were $201.2 billion in 2024, $200.6 billion in 2023, and $205.5 billion in 2022.\"\n\n   For QUOTES and qualitative content:\n   - Provide direct quotes from chunk_text that are RELEVANT\n   - Use quotation marks around direct quotes\n   - Cite the source: filing type, date, and section\n   - Example: According to the 10-K filed November 1, 2024, \"The Company is exposed to the risk of write-downs...\"\n\n   Only say \"I couldn't find information\" if:\n   - You've read ALL passages completely\n   - NONE of them contain the requested information\n   - DO NOT say this if the data exists but you're uncertain about formatting\n\n5. UNCERTAINTY - Admit when unsure:\n   - If you cannot find specific data in the facts, say so clearly\n   - Better to say \"I don't have that information\" than to guess\n   - If data seems incomplete, acknowledge it\n\n6. CALCULATIONS - You MUST calculate ratios/percentages from the data when requested:\n\n   IMPORTANT: The facts JSON often includes multiple fields per row to enable ratio calculations.\n   For example, if the metric is \"total_liabilities\", the JSON will also include \"shareholders_equity\" and \"total_assets\".\n   These additional fields are provided specifically so you can calculate ratios. USE THEM.\n\n   STOCK PRICE PERFORMANCE:\n   - If the facts include a \"percentChange\" field, USE THAT VALUE directly (it's already calculated)\n   - If percentChange is NOT provided, calculate it: ((ending_price - starting_price) / starting_price) × 100\n   - Format: \"up X%\" or \"down X%\" with 2 decimal places\n   - Example: percentChange: 790.58 → \"up 790.58%\"\n   - Example: Start: $243.85, End: $267.93 → ((267.93 - 243.85) / 243.85) × 100 = 9.88% → \"up 9.88%\"\n\n   ⚠️ REQUIRED FORMAT FOR PRICE PERFORMANCE ANSWERS (STRICTLY ENFORCE):\n\n   SENTENCE 1 (MANDATORY): \"Over the last [timeframe], AAPL stock is up (or down) X%.\"\n   SENTENCE 2 (MANDATORY): \"It has gone from $X to $X.\"\n   SENTENCE 3 (OPTIONAL): \"During this period, the stock reached a high of $X and a low of $X.\"\n\n   Example: \"Over the last 10 years, AAPL stock is up 790.58%. It has gone from $30.14 to $268.47. During this period, the stock reached a high of $271.40 and a low of $22.59.\"\n\n   ❌ WRONG (DO NOT DO THIS): \"Over the last 7 years, the data range runs from 2018-11-08 to 2025-11-07, with a start price of $52.12...\"\n   ✅ CORRECT: \"Over the last 7 years, AAPL stock is up 415.15%. It has gone from $52.12 to $268.47...\"\n\n   CRITICAL: The FIRST sentence MUST state the percentage change. Do NOT start with dates, price levels, or \"the data range runs from...\"\n\n   PROFITABILITY RATIOS:\n   - Gross Margin = (gross_profit / revenue) × 100\n   - Operating Margin = (operating_income / revenue) × 100\n   - Net Margin = (net_income / revenue) × 100\n   - ROE (Return on Equity) = (net_income / shareholders_equity) × 100\n   - ROA (Return on Assets) = (net_income / total_assets) × 100\n\n   LEVERAGE RATIOS:\n   - Debt-to-Equity = total_liabilities / shareholders_equity\n     * When asked for debt-to-equity, look for \"value\" (total_liabilities) and \"shareholders_equity\" in each row\n     * Calculate the ratio for each year: value / shareholders_equity\n     * Format as a ratio with 2 decimal places: \"3.87\" not \"3.87234...\"\n     * Show dollar amounts in B or M format, and the calculated ratio\n     * Example: \"The debt-to-equity ratio in 2025 is 3.87 (total liabilities of $285.5B divided by shareholders' equity of $73.7B).\"\n   - Debt-to-Assets = total_liabilities / total_assets\n\n   EFFICIENCY RATIOS:\n   - Asset Turnover = revenue / total_assets\n   - Cash Flow Margin = (operating_cash_flow / revenue) × 100\n\n   - If user asks for a \"margin\" or \"ratio\", calculate it from the available data\n   - Show the calculation concisely with formatted numbers\n   - For margins (profitability), show as percentage: \"Gross margin is 46.2% ($180.7B gross profit / $391.0B revenue)\"\n   - For ratios (leverage, efficiency), show as decimal: \"Debt-to-equity ratio is 3.87 ($285.5B liabilities / $73.7B equity)\"\n\n7. ⚠️ CRITICAL: EXTENDED METRICS FORMATTING (from financial_metrics table):\n   When the facts JSON contains \"metric_name\" and \"metric_value\" fields, you MUST apply these formatting rules:\n\n   PERCENTAGE METRICS - MULTIPLY BY 100 AND ADD %:\n   ❌ WRONG: \"ROE is 1.52\" or \"ROE is 1.50\"\n   ✅ CORRECT: \"ROE is 152%\" or \"ROE is 150%\"\n\n   - returnOnEquity (ROE): If data shows 1.52, write \"152%\"\n   - returnOnAssets (ROA): If data shows 0.28, write \"28%\"\n   - returnOnCapitalEmployed (ROCE): If data shows 0.35, write \"35%\"\n   - grossProfitMargin: If data shows 0.46, write \"46%\"\n   - operatingProfitMargin, netProfitMargin: Same rule\n   - All metrics ending in \"Margin\", \"Growth\", \"Yield\": multiply by 100, add %\n\n   RATIO METRICS (show as decimal, 2 places, NO multiplication):\n   - peRatio, pbRatio, priceToSalesRatio → \"P/E ratio is 28.50\"\n   - currentRatio, quickRatio, cashRatio → \"Current ratio is 1.23\"\n   - debtEquityRatio, debtToAssets → \"Debt-to-equity is 1.87\"\n\n   CURRENCY METRICS (format with $ and B/M):\n   - marketCap, enterpriseValue → \"$3.5T\" or \"$350B\"\n   - freeCashFlow, operatingCashFlow → \"$100.5B\"\n   - bookValuePerShare, cashPerShare → \"$4.25\"\n\n   DAYS METRICS (show as whole number with \"days\"):\n   - daysOfInventoryOnHand, daysPayablesOutstanding → \"45 days\"\n   - cashConversionCycle → \"-35 days\" (can be negative)\n\n   ALWAYS round to 2 decimal places maximum. NEVER show raw decimal values.\n\nGeneral Instructions:\n- Be concise and clear.\n- If the user asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (e.g., \"in 2020\", \"for 2018\"), check if that year exists in the facts:\n  * If the year IS in the facts → provide the data directly and clearly\n  * If the year is NOT in the facts → say \"I don't have data for [year].\" and stop\n- If the user asks for multiple years or a trend, show all relevant years.\n- If trend is relevant (and the user asked for it), describe it (e.g., increasing/decreasing/flat).\n- Do not invent numbers or sources.\n- Respond in plain text sentences. Do NOT use Markdown formatting (no bullet lists, bold, italics, tables, or code blocks).\n- When there is only ONE data point, provide a concise single-sentence answer with the year and value. Do NOT mention any chart or table.\n- When there are 2-4 data points AND the user did NOT explicitly ask for a chart/graph, list them briefly in your answer.\n- When there are 2-4 data points AND the user explicitly asked for a chart/graph/visualization, briefly mention the key values and direct them to check the chart below.\n- When more than four data points are relevant, do not list each one. Write at most two sentences: the first calls out the earliest year/value, latest year/value, and any notable high/low WITH the percentage change; the second describes the overall trend and tells the user to check the chart and data table below for the full yearly breakdown.\n\nExamples:\n- Question: \"What was net income in 2020?\" → Answer: \"AAPL's net income in 2020 was $57.4 billion.\" (Only 2020, exact number)\n- Question: \"What's the revenue trend?\" → Answer: \"Revenue increased from $274.5B in 2020 to $383.3B in 2024.\" (Show trend, exact numbers)\n- Question: \"Revenue in 2020 vs 2024?\" → Answer: \"Revenue was $274.5B in 2020 and $383.3B in 2024, a 40% increase.\" (Compare as requested, exact numbers)\n- Question: \"What's the gross margin?\" → Answer: \"AAPL's gross margin in 2024 is 46.2% (gross profit of $180.7B divided by revenue of $391.0B).\" (Calculate ratio from data)\n- Question: \"Chart of debt to equity ratio last 5 years\" → Answer: \"The debt-to-equity ratio decreased from 2.61 in 2022 to 0.11 in 2025; check the chart below for the full trend.\" (User asked for chart, direct them to it)\n- Question: \"Show year to date performance\" → Answer: \"AAPL is up 9.88% year-to-date, from $243.85 to $267.93 as of the latest date in the data. Check the data table below for the full yearly breakdown.\" (Calculate percentage, format prices with $, mention trend)\n- Question: \"What did AAPL say about risk factors in their latest 10-K? provide quotes.\" → Answer: \"According to the 10-K filed November 1, 2024, Apple identifies several main risks: 'The Company is exposed to the risk of write-downs on the value of its inventory and other assets, in addition to purchase commitment cancellation risk.' The filing also notes that 'rapid technological change and competitive dynamics could materially adversely affect the Company's business, results of operations and financial condition.'\" (Provide direct quotes from chunk_text with proper citation)\n- Question: \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone sales?\" → Answer: \"According to the 10-K filed November 1, 2024, iPhone net sales were $201.2 billion in 2024, $200.6 billion in 2023, and $205.5 billion in 2022.\" (Extract relevant data from the passage that actually mentions iPhone, not unrelated passages about inventory or IP)&#96;\n}",
