                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# CLAUDE.md\\n\\nThis file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.\\n\\n## Project Overview\\n\\n**Fin Quote** is a Next.js-based financial Q&amp;amp;A platform that uses LLMs to answer natural language questions about Apple (AAPL) stock data. The system uses a two-step LLM architecture: (1) tool selection and (2) answer generation with validation.\\n\\n**Core Design Philosophy:**\\n- **Safety First**: LLMs cannot execute arbitrary database queries. Instead, they select from a whitelist of pre-built \\\"tools\\\" (server actions) with validated inputs.\\n- **Server-Side Intelligence**: All LLM calls, database queries, and validation logic run server-side. The browser only handles UI.\\n- **Grounded Answers**: The LLM must use only fetched data; no external knowledge or hallucinations allowed.\\n- **Validation Pipeline**: All answers are validated against source data for number accuracy, year correctness, and citation validity.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Architecture\\n\\n### Two-Step LLM Flow\\n\\nEvery user question follows this pattern:\\n\\n1. **Tool Selection** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:224-313&amp;#96;)\\n   - LLM receives question + conversation history + tool menu\\n   - Returns JSON: &amp;#96;{\\\"tool\\\": \\\"toolName\\\", \\\"args\\\": {...}}&amp;#96;\\n   - Model: Uses &amp;#96;OPENAI_MODEL&amp;#96; (default: &amp;#96;gpt-5-nano&amp;#96;)\\n\\n2. **Tool Execution** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:316-438&amp;#96;)\\n   - Server validates tool + args\\n   - Executes corresponding server action\\n   - Returns structured data (financials, prices, filings, or passages)\\n\\n3. **Answer Generation** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:441-500&amp;#96;)\\n   - LLM receives question + fetched facts + conversation history\\n   - Generates grounded answer using only provided data\\n   - Plain text output (no Markdown)\\n\\n4. **Validation** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:503-658&amp;#96;)\\n   - Validates numbers, years, and filing citations\\n   - If validation fails with high severity, triggers auto-regeneration\\n   - Logs validation results to &amp;#96;query_logs&amp;#96; table\\n\\n### Available Tools\\n\\nDefined in &amp;#96;lib/tools.ts&amp;#96; (TOOL_MENU):\\n\\n1. **getAaplFinancialsByMetric** - Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow metrics\\n   - Core metrics: &amp;#96;revenue&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;gross_profit&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;net_income&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;operating_income&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;total_assets&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;total_liabilities&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;shareholders_equity&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;operating_cash_flow&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;eps&amp;#96;\","

                  "lineNumber": 65877,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"npm run generate:catalog                     # Generate metrics catalog with metadata\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n**SEC Filings (RAG Pipeline):**\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nnpx tsx scripts/fetch-sec-filings.ts         # Fetch metadata from SEC EDGAR\\nnpx tsx scripts/ingest-filings.ts            # Load metadata into filings table\\nnpx tsx scripts/download-filings.ts          # Download HTML files to storage\\nnpx tsx scripts/chunk-filings.ts             # Split filings into semantic chunks\\nnpx tsx scripts/embed-filings.ts             # Generate embeddings for vector search\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n**Data Export:**\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nnpm run export                               # Export financial data to Excel\\nnpm run export:catalog                       # Export metrics catalog to Excel\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n**Testing &amp;amp; Debugging:**\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nnpx tsx scripts/evaluate.ts                  # Run evaluation on golden test set\\nnode scripts/test-*.mjs                      # Various integration tests\\nnode scripts/check-*.mjs                     # Data verification scripts\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Key Files\\n\\n### Server Actions (app/actions/)\\n\\n**AI Chatbot:**\\n- &amp;#96;ask-question.ts&amp;#96; - Main orchestration: tool selection → execution → answer generation → validation → regeneration\\n- &amp;#96;financials.ts&amp;#96; - Core financial metrics (9 metrics from financials_std)\\n- &amp;#96;get-financial-metric.ts&amp;#96; - Extended metrics with alias resolution (139 metrics from financial_metrics)\\n- &amp;#96;list-metrics.ts&amp;#96; - Metrics catalog discovery tool\\n- &amp;#96;prices.ts&amp;#96; - Stock prices from FMP API (custom date ranges)\\n- &amp;#96;filings.ts&amp;#96; - SEC filing metadata\\n- &amp;#96;search-filings.ts&amp;#96; - Semantic search over filing content (RAG)\\n- &amp;#96;conversations.ts&amp;#96; - Conversation persistence and auto-title generation\\n- &amp;#96;get-costs.ts&amp;#96; - Cost tracking analytics\\n- &amp;#96;get-recent-queries.ts&amp;#96; - Recent query history\\n- &amp;#96;review-query.ts&amp;#96; - LLM-based query evaluation\\n\\n**Market Dashboard:**\\n- &amp;#96;market-data.ts&amp;#96; - Index data (S&amp;amp;P 500, NASDAQ, Dow, Russell 2000)\\n- &amp;#96;futures.ts&amp;#96; - Futures contracts\\n- &amp;#96;gainers.ts&amp;#96; - Top gainers (regular hours)\\n- &amp;#96;losers.ts&amp;#96; - Top losers (regular hours)\\n- &amp;#96;scan-extended-hours.ts&amp;#96; - Pre-market/after-hours movers\","

                  "lineNumber": 67336,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- **RAG (Retrieval‑Augmented Generation)**: For document questions (filings/transcripts), retrieve the most relevant passages via a vector store, then answer using those passages. We’ll add this after MVP.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Architecture overview\\n\\n### Frontend (browser)\\n- Next.js app with a simple UI: text box + Ask button + answer display.\\n- No secrets in the browser.\\n- Uses &amp;#96;createBrowserClient()&amp;#96; only for UI‑safe tasks.\\n\\n### Backend (server)\\n- Next.js server actions/API routes handle all sensitive work.\\n- Uses &amp;#96;createServerClient()&amp;#96; to talk to Supabase (read‑only for MVP).\\n- Two LLM steps per question:\\n  1) Selection: model picks exactly one tool from our small menu and provides JSON args.\\n  2) Answering: after we run the tool and get facts, the model writes the final answer using only those facts.\\n\\n### Data (Supabase)\\n- We store standardized financials in &amp;#96;financials_std&amp;#96; and company metadata in &amp;#96;company&amp;#96;.\\n- For MVP, we enforce AAPL‑only and small row limits (1–8) at the tool level.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Current code in the repo (important files)\\n- &amp;#96;lib/supabase/client.ts&amp;#96;: Creates the browser client (uses &amp;#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_*&amp;#96; env vars; no session persistence). For UI only.\\n- &amp;#96;lib/supabase/server.ts&amp;#96;: Creates the server client (same env vars; no session persistence). For server actions and API routes.\\n- &amp;#96;lib/database.types.ts&amp;#96;: Typed Supabase schema for &amp;#96;company&amp;#96; and &amp;#96;financials_std&amp;#96;.\\n- &amp;#96;app/actions/financials.ts&amp;#96;:\\n  - &amp;#96;getCompaniesWithFinancials()&amp;#96;: Example server action that composes companies with financials for display.\\n  - &amp;#96;getAaplFinancialsByMetric({ metric, limit })&amp;#96;: SAFE TOOL (MVP). Allowed metrics: &amp;#96;revenue&amp;#96; or &amp;#96;gross_profit&amp;#96;. Limit clamped to 1..8. Always filters to &amp;#96;AAPL&amp;#96;. Returns an array of &amp;#96;{ year, value, metric }&amp;#96;.\\n- &amp;#96;lib/tools.ts&amp;#96;:\\n  - &amp;#96;TOOL_MENU&amp;#96;: Defines the tool(s) the model can choose from.\","

                  "lineNumber": 73690,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Fin Quote - Company Financial Data Platform\\n\\nA Next.js application that displays company financial data from Supabase.\\n\\n## Tech Stack\\n\\n- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)\\n- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL)\\n- **Authentication**: Firebase Auth (separate)\\n- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS\\n- **Language**: TypeScript\\n\\n## Database Schema\\n\\n### Tables\\n\\n1. **company**\\n   - &amp;#96;id&amp;#96; (uuid, primary key)\\n   - &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96; (timestamptz)\\n   - &amp;#96;symbol&amp;#96; (text, unique)\\n   - &amp;#96;name&amp;#96; (text)\\n   - &amp;#96;sector&amp;#96; (text)\\n   - RLS Policy: Public read access\\n\\n2. **financials_std**\\n   - &amp;#96;id&amp;#96; (uuid, primary key)\\n   - &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96; (timestamptz)\\n   - &amp;#96;symbol&amp;#96; (text, foreign key → company.symbol)\\n   - &amp;#96;year&amp;#96; (int4)\\n   - &amp;#96;revenue&amp;#96; (int8)\\n   - &amp;#96;gross_profit&amp;#96; (int8)\\n   - RLS Policy: Public read access\\n\\n## Setup Instructions\\n\\n### 1. Install Dependencies\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nnpm install\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. Configure Environment Variables\\n\\nCopy the example environment file:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\ncp .env.local.example .env.local\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\nThen edit &amp;#96;.env.local&amp;#96; with your Supabase credentials:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;env\\nNEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co\\nNEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-anon-key\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\nYou can find these values in your Supabase project:\\n1. Go to [Supabase Dashboard](https://app.supabase.com)\\n2. Select your project\\n3. Navigate to Settings → API\\n4. Copy the \\\"Project URL\\\" and \\\"anon/public\\\" key\\n\\n### 3. Run the Development Server\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nnpm run dev\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\nOpen [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) to see the application.\\n\\n## Project Structure\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n├── app/\\n│   ├── actions/\\n│   │   └── financials.ts       # Server action to fetch data\\n│   ├── financials/\\n│   │   └── page.tsx            # Financials display page\\n│   ├── layout.tsx              # Root layout\\n│   ├── page.tsx                # Home page\\n│   └── globals.css             # Global styles\\n├── lib/\\n│   ├── database.types.ts       # TypeScript types for Supabase\\n│   └── supabase/\\n│       ├── client.ts           # Client-side Supabase client\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Testing Setup Guide for Fin Quote\\n\\n## Overview\\n\\nThis guide explains how to add automated testing to the Fin Quote codebase. Tests will catch bugs before users see them and give you confidence to refactor code.\\n\\n**Time to complete**: 2-3 hours for initial setup\\n**Ongoing effort**: 5-10 minutes per new feature\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Why Test This Codebase?\\n\\n**You're building a financial accuracy system** where wrong answers can cause:\\n- Users making bad investment decisions based on incorrect data\\n- Loss of trust and reputation\\n- Hours debugging production issues\\n\\n**Three types of quality control you need**:\\n1. ✅ **Validators** (you have) - Runtime checks on LLM outputs\\n2. ❌ **Tests** (you need) - Verify YOUR code works correctly\\n3. ✅ **Evals** (you have) - Measure overall system performance\\n\\n---\\n\\n## What to Test (Priority Order)\\n\\n### **Priority 1: Validators** (CRITICAL)\\n- File: &amp;#96;lib/validators.ts&amp;#96;\\n- Why: Core accuracy logic - bugs here = wrong answers to users\\n- Test coverage goal: 90%+\\n\\n### **Priority 2: Metric Resolver** (HIGH)\\n- File: &amp;#96;lib/metric-resolver.ts&amp;#96;\\n- Why: Maps user phrases to database metrics (\\\"P/E\\\" → &amp;#96;peRatio&amp;#96;)\\n- Test coverage goal: 90%+\\n\\n### **Priority 3: Server Actions** (MEDIUM)\\n- Files: &amp;#96;app/actions/*.ts&amp;#96;\\n- Why: API boundaries, database interactions\\n- Test coverage goal: 60%+\\n\\n### **Priority 4: Chart Helpers** (LOW)\\n- File: &amp;#96;lib/chart-helpers.ts&amp;#96;\\n- Why: Data transformation for visualizations\\n- Test coverage goal: 50%+\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Phase 1: Initial Setup (30 minutes)\\n\\n### Step 1: Install Testing Framework\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# Install vitest (modern, fast test runner)\\nnpm install -D vitest @vitest/ui\\n\\n# Install testing utilities\\nnpm install -D @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom\\n\\n# For React component testing (optional, later)\\nnpm install -D @vitejs/plugin-react jsdom\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 2: Create Vitest Config\\n\\nCreate &amp;#96;vitest.config.ts&amp;#96; in project root:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nimport { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'\\nimport react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'\\nimport path from 'path'\","

Choose exactly one tool and return ONLY valid JSON: {\\\"tool\\\": string, \\\"args\\\": object}. No prose.\\n\\nAvailable Tools:\\n\\n1. getAaplFinancialsByMetric - Financial metrics as NUMBERS over time\\n\\n   SUPPORTED METRICS:\\n\\n   Raw Metrics:\\n   - revenue, gross_profit, net_income, operating_income\\n   - total_assets, total_liabilities, shareholders_equity\\n   - operating_cash_flow, eps\\n\\n   Calculated Metrics (✨ Native Support):\\n   - debt_to_equity_ratio  (total_liabilities / shareholders_equity)\\n   - gross_margin          (gross_profit / revenue × 100)\\n   - roe                   (net_income / shareholders_equity × 100)\\n\\n   METRIC MAPPING (with context clues):\\n\\n   Income/Profitability:\\n   - \\\"sales\\\", \\\"revenue\\\", \\\"top line\\\" → revenue\\n   - \\\"profit\\\", \\\"earnings\\\", \\\"bottom line\\\", \\\"profitability\\\" → net_income\\n   - \\\"EPS\\\", \\\"earnings per share\\\" → eps\\n   - \\\"operating profit\\\", \\\"EBIT\\\" → operating_income\\n\\n   Valuation Ratios (use getFinancialMetric tool):\\n   - \\\"P/E ratio\\\", \\\"PE ratio\\\", \\\"price to earnings\\\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\\\"P/E\\\"]\\n   - \\\"P/B ratio\\\", \\\"price to book\\\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\\\"P/B\\\"]\\n   - \\\"PEG ratio\\\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\\\"PEG\\\"]\\n\\n   Calculated Ratios (✨ NOW NATIVE - use directly):\\n   - \\\"gross margin\\\", \\\"gross profit margin\\\" → gross_margin\\n   - \\\"ROE\\\", \\\"return on equity\\\" → roe\\n   - \\\"debt to equity\\\", \\\"debt-to-equity\\\", \\\"D/E ratio\\\", \\\"leverage ratio\\\" → debt_to_equity_ratio\\n\\n   Balance Sheet (Raw):\\n   - \\\"assets\\\", \\\"total assets\\\" → total_assets\\n   - \\\"liabilities\\\", \\\"total debt\\\", \\\"debt\\\" → total_liabilities\\n   - \\\"equity\\\", \\\"book value\\\", \\\"shareholders equity\\\" → shareholders_equity\\n\\n   Cash Flow:\\n   - \\\"operating cash flow\\\", \\\"cash from operations\\\", \\\"OCF\\\" → operating_cash_flow\\n   - \\\"free cash flow\\\", \\\"FCF\\\", \\\"unlevered free cash flow\\\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\\n   - \\\"capex\\\", \\\"capital expenditures\\\", \\\"buybacks\\\", \\\"dividends paid\\\", \\\"stock-based compensation\\\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\\n\\n   Research &amp;amp; Development:\\n   - \\\"R&amp;amp;D\\\", \\\"research and development\\\", \\\"R&amp;amp;D spending\\\", \\\"R&amp;amp;D expense\\\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\\\"R&amp;amp;D to revenue\\\"] or [\\\"research and development\\\"]\\n\\n   Other (use closest available):\\n   - \\\"margins\\\", \\\"ratios\\\" (when not specific) → operating_income\\n\\n   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:\\n\\n   1. If question asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (2020, 2019, 2015, 2006, etc.) → limit: 20\\n      Why: We have 20 years (2006-2025). To find any specific year, fetch all.\\n      Examples:\\n      - \\\"net income in 2020\\\" → limit: 20\\n      - \\\"revenue for 2018\\\" → limit: 20\\n      - \\\"What was EPS in 2006?\\\" → limit: 20\\n\\n   2. If question asks for a YEAR RANGE (2008 to 2020, 2015 to present, etc.) → limit: 20\\n      Why: Need all data to filter to the specific range.\\n      Examples:\\n      - \\\"net income 2008 to present\\\" → limit: 20\\n      - \\\"revenue from 2015 to 2020\\\" → limit: 20\\n      - \\\"EPS between 2010 and 2018\\\" → limit: 20\\n\\n   3. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:\\n      \\\"last 3 years\\\" → limit: 3\\n      \\\"past 5 years\\\" → limit: 5\\n      \\\"last year\\\" or \\\"most recent year\\\" → limit: 1\\n      \\\"10 years\\\" → limit: 10\\n      \\\"20 years\\\" → limit: 20\\n      \\\"2 years\\\" → limit: 2\\n\\n   4. If question says \\\"trend\\\", \\\"history\\\", \\\"over time\\\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4\\n\\n   5. If question says \\\"all\\\", \\\"complete\\\", \\\"full history\\\" → limit: 20\\n\\n   6. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4\\n\\n   Examples:\\n   - \\\"net income in 2006\\\" → limit: 20 (specific year)\\n   - \\\"revenue over 5 years\\\" → limit: 5 (number specified)\\n   - \\\"show me net income trend\\\" → limit: 4 (no number)\\n   - \\\"EPS history\\\" → limit: 4 (no number)\\n   - \\\"gross profit\\\" → limit: 4 (no number)\\n   - \\\"all historical data\\\" → limit: 20 (all data)\\n\\n   args: {\\\"metric\\\": &amp;lt;exact name&amp;gt;, \\\"limit\\\": &amp;lt;number 1-20&amp;gt;}\\n\\n2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history\\n\\n   ALWAYS use custom date ranges. Calculate the \\\"from\\\" date based on the user's request.\\n   Today's date is {{TODAY_DATE}} (use this for calculations).\\n\\n   Date format: YYYY-MM-DD\\n   \\\"to\\\" is optional (defaults to today)\\n\\n   CALCULATION EXAMPLES:\\n   - \\\"last 7 days\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2025-11-01\\\"} (7 days ago)\\n   - \\\"past month\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2025-10-08\\\"} (30 days ago)\\n   - \\\"last 3 months\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2025-08-08\\\"} (90 days ago)\\n   - \\\"past year\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2024-11-08\\\"} (365 days ago)\\n   - \\\"YTD\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2025-01-01\\\"} (start of current year)\\n   - \\\"last 3 years\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2022-11-08\\\"} (3 years ago)\\n   - \\\"past 5 years\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2020-11-08\\\"} (5 years ago)\\n   - \\\"last 7 years\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2018-11-08\\\"} (7 years ago)\\n   - \\\"past 10 years\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2015-11-08\\\"} (10 years ago)\\n   - \\\"last 15 years\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2010-11-08\\\"} (15 years ago)\\n   - \\\"past 20 years\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2005-11-08\\\"} (20 years ago)\\n   - \\\"all time\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2005-11-08\\\"} (20 years ago, max available)\\n\\n   EXACT DATE RANGES:\\n   - \\\"from Jan 2020 to June 2023\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2020-01-01\\\", \\\"to\\\": \\\"2023-06-30\\\"}\\n   - \\\"prices between 2015 and 2020\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2015-01-01\\\", \\\"to\\\": \\\"2020-12-31\\\"}\\n   - \\\"from March 2018 to now\\\" → args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"2018-03-01\\\"}\\n\\n   args: {\\\"from\\\": \\\"&amp;lt;YYYY-MM-DD&amp;gt;\\\", \\\"to\\\": \\\"&amp;lt;YYYY-MM-DD&amp;gt;\\\"}  (to is optional)\\n\\n3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata ONLY\\n\\n   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool returns ONLY metadata (filing type, date, URL).\\n   It does NOT return filing CONTENT or text.\\n\\n   Use ONLY when:\\n   - User wants to know WHEN filings were submitted\\n   - User wants to know WHICH filings exist\\n   - User wants filing dates/types/URLs\\n\\n   DO NOT USE when:\\n   - User asks WHAT the filing says\\n   - User wants content, quotes, or information FROM the filing\\n   - User asks about topics like risks, strategy, etc.\\n   → Use searchFilings instead for content questions!\\n\\n   LIMIT RULES:\\n\\n   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number\\n      \\\"last 3 filings\\\" → limit: 3\\n      \\\"most recent filing\\\" → limit: 1\\n      \\\"2 years of filings\\\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)\\n\\n   2. If question says \\\"recent\\\", \\\"latest\\\" (no number) → limit: 5\\n\\n   3. If question says \\\"all\\\", \\\"available\\\", \\\"history\\\" → limit: 10\\n\\n   Examples (metadata questions):\\n   - \\\"when was the most recent filing?\\\" → limit: 1\\n   - \\\"what filings do you have?\\\" → limit: 5\\n   - \\\"show me filing dates\\\" → limit: 5\\n\\n   args: {\\\"limit\\\": &amp;lt;number 1-10&amp;gt;}\\n\\n4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content (for WHAT they say)\\n\\n   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Use this when user asks about CONTENT, not just dates!\\n\\n   Use for ANY question about WHAT the filings say:\\n   - Risk factors, strategy, operations, business model\\n   - Management commentary, outlook, quotes\\n   - Products, markets, competition\\n   - Governance, compensation\\n   - ANY question asking \\\"what did they say\\\", \\\"provide quotes\\\", etc.\\n\\n   Even if they mention \\\"latest 10-K\\\" or specific filing:\\n   - \\\"What are risk factors in latest 10-K?\\\" → USE searchFilings\\n   - \\\"What does the 10-K say about AI?\\\" → USE searchFilings\\n   - \\\"Provide quotes from recent filing\\\" → USE searchFilings\\n\\n   QUERY RULES:\\n   - Extract key terms from user's question\\n   - Keep it simple (1-3 words usually best)\\n   - Don't need full sentences\\n\\n   Examples:\\n   - \\\"What are the risk factors?\\\" → {\\\"query\\\": \\\"risk factors\\\", \\\"limit\\\": 5}\\n   - \\\"What about risk factors in latest 10-K?\\\" → {\\\"query\\\": \\\"risk factors\\\", \\\"limit\\\": 5}\\n   - \\\"Tell me about competition\\\" → {\\\"query\\\": \\\"competition\\\", \\\"limit\\\": 5}\\n   - \\\"Provide quotes about AI strategy\\\" → {\\\"query\\\": \\\"AI strategy\\\", \\\"limit\\\": 5}\\n   - \\\"What does the 10-K say about iPhone?\\\" → {\\\"query\\\": \\\"iPhone\\\", \\\"limit\\\": 5}\\n\\n   args: {\\\"query\\\": \\\"&amp;lt;keywords&amp;gt;\\\", \\\"limit\\\": 5}\\n\\n5. listMetrics - DISCOVER available financial metrics\\n\\n   Use when:\\n   - User asks \\\"what metrics do you have?\\\"\\n   - User wants to browse metrics by category\\n   - Uncertain which metric name to use for getFinancialMetric\\n\\n   CATEGORY FILTER (optional):\\n   - Filing CONTENT (what they say, quotes, topics)? → searchFilings\\n\\n⚠️ KEY DISTINCTION for #6 vs #7:\\n- \\\"When was the latest 10-K filed?\\\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)\\n- \\\"What does the latest 10-K say about risks?\\\" → searchFilings (content)\\n- \\\"Show me recent filings\\\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)\\n- \\\"What are risk factors in the latest 10-K?\\\" → searchFilings (content)\\n- \\\"Provide quotes from the 10-K\\\" → searchFilings (content)\\n\\nReturn ONLY JSON - examples:\\n\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"metric\\\":\\\"revenue\\\",\\\"limit\\\":5}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"metric\\\":\\\"eps\\\",\\\"limit\\\":1}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"metric\\\":\\\"total_liabilities\\\",\\\"limit\\\":4}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getPrices\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"from\\\":\\\"2018-11-15\\\"}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getPrices\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"from\\\":\\\"2025-01-01\\\",\\\"to\\\":\\\"2025-11-15\\\"}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getRecentFilings\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"limit\\\":3}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"searchFilings\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"query\\\":\\\"risk factors\\\",\\\"limit\\\":5}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"searchFilings\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"query\\\":\\\"AI strategy\\\",\\\"limit\\\":5}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"listMetrics\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"category\\\":\\\"Valuation\\\"}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"listMetrics\\\",\\\"args\\\":{}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getFinancialMetric\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"metricNames\\\":[\\\"P/E\\\"],\\\"limit\\\":5}}\\n{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getFinancialMetric\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"metricNames\\\":[\\\"ROE\\\",\\\"debt to equity\\\"],\\\"limit\\\":10}}\\n\\nCRITICAL EXAMPLES - Filing Content vs Metadata:\\nQ: \\\"When was the latest 10-K filed?\\\"\\nA: {\\\"tool\\\":\\\"getRecentFilings\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"limit\\\":1}}\\n\\nQ: \\\"What about risk factors in their latest 10k?                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"# CLAUDE.md\\n\\nThis file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.\\n\\n## Project Overview\\n\\n**Fin Quote** is a Next.js-based financial data platform with an AI-powered Q&amp;amp;A chatbot that answers natural language questions about Apple (AAPL) stock. The system uses a two-step LLM architecture with tool selection, data execution, answer generation, and validation.\\n\\n**Core Design Philosophy:**\\n- **Safety First**: LLMs cannot execute arbitrary database queries. Instead, they select from a whitelist of pre-built \\\"tools\\\" (server actions) with validated inputs.\\n- **Server-Side Intelligence**: All LLM calls, database queries, and validation logic run server-side. The browser only handles UI.\\n- **Grounded Answers**: The LLM must use only fetched data; no external knowledge or hallucinations allowed.\\n- **Validation Pipeline**: All answers are validated against source data for number accuracy, year correctness, and citation validity, with auto-regeneration on failures.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Architecture\\n\\n### Two-Step LLM Flow\\n\\nEvery user question follows this pattern (implemented in &amp;#96;app/actions/ask-question.ts&amp;#96;):\\n\\n1. **Tool Selection** (lines 258-330)\\n   - LLM receives question + conversation history + tool menu\\n   - Returns JSON: &amp;#96;{\\\"tool\\\": \\\"toolName\\\", \\\"args\\\": {...}}&amp;#96;\\n   - Model: Uses &amp;#96;OPENAI_MODEL&amp;#96; (default: &amp;#96;gpt-5-nano&amp;#96;)\\n   - Tokens tracked for cost analysis\\n\\n2. **Tool Execution** (lines 332-575)\\n   - Server validates tool + args\\n   - Executes corresponding server action\\n   - Returns structured data (financials, prices, filings, passages, or metrics)\\n\\n3. **Answer Generation** (lines 579-650)\\n   - LLM receives question + fetched facts + conversation history\\n   - Generates grounded answer using only provided data\\n   - Plain text output (no Markdown, bullets, or tables)\\n   - Context: Last 10 messages (tool selection) or 4 messages (answer generation for gpt-5)\\n\\n4. **Validation &amp;amp; Auto-Correction** (lines 653-796)\\n   - Validates numbers, years, and filing citations\","

Instead, they select from a whitelist of pre-built \\\"tools\\\" (server actions) with validated inputs.\\n- **Server-Side Intelligence**: All LLM calls, database queries, and validation logic run server-side. The browser only handles UI.\\n- **Grounded Answers**: The LLM must use only fetched data; no external knowledge or hallucinations allowed.\\n- **Validation Pipeline**: All answers are validated against source data for number accuracy, year correctness, and citation validity.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Architecture\\n\\n### Two-Step LLM Flow\\n\\nEvery user question follows this pattern:\\n\\n1. **Tool Selection** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:224-313&amp;#96;)\\n   - LLM receives question + conversation history + tool menu\\n   - Returns JSON: &amp;#96;{\\\"tool\\\": \\\"toolName\\\", \\\"args\\\": {...}}&amp;#96;\\n   - Model: Uses &amp;#96;OPENAI_MODEL&amp;#96; (default: &amp;#96;gpt-5-nano&amp;#96;)\\n\\n2. **Tool Execution** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:316-438&amp;#96;)\\n   - Server validates tool + args\\n   - Executes corresponding server action\\n   - Returns structured data (financials, prices, filings, or passages)\\n\\n3. **Answer Generation** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:441-500&amp;#96;)\\n   - LLM receives question + fetched facts + conversation history\\n   - Generates grounded answer using only provided data\\n   - Plain text output (no Markdown)\\n\\n4. **Validation** (&amp;#96;ask-question.ts:503-658&amp;#96;)\\n   - Validates numbers, years, and filing citations\\n   - If validation fails with high severity, triggers auto-regeneration\\n   - Logs validation results to &amp;#96;query_logs&amp;#96; table\\n\\n### Available Tools\\n\\nDefined in &amp;#96;lib/tools.ts&amp;#96; (TOOL_MENU):\\n\\n1. **getAaplFinancialsByMetric** - Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow metrics\\n   - Core metrics: &amp;#96;revenue&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;gross_profit&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;net_income&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;operating_income&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;total_assets&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;total_liabilities&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;shareholders_equity&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;operating_cash_flow&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;eps&amp;#96;\","

                  "lineNumber": 1930,
                  "content": "        &amp;quot;diffString&amp;quot;: &amp;quot;- \\n+ ## Reasoning Visibility Implementation Plan (Reasoning Summary, Tool Trace, Scratchpad)\\n+ \\n+ ### Why we’re adding this\\n+ - Improve trust and debuggability: Users (and admins) can see how an answer was produced without exposing sensitive internal prompts or raw chain-of-thought.\\n+ - Faster iteration: Tool traces reveal where latency comes from and which retrievals/citations drive answers.\\n+ - Safer transparency: Show a short Reasoning Summary to users; keep deeper internal notes (Scratchpad) behind an admin-only toggle and never persist them.\\n+ \\n+ ### Goals (what success looks like)\\n+ - Reasoning Summary (2–5 bullets) appears under each assistant response by default.\\n+ - Tool Trace shows tools executed, inputs (redacted), durations, and top citations; collapsible by default.\\n+ - Scratchpad (hidden chain-of-thought) is viewable only by admins, behind a toggle, and never saved to the database or logs.\\n+ - No PII/secrets leakage; token overhead capped; negligible latency impact (&amp;lt;150 ms CPU for parsing/instrumentation).\\n+ \\n+ ### Non‑Goals\\n+ - Do not expose or store long chain-of-thought for non-admin users.\\n+ - Do not change retrieval ranking logic or embeddings configuration as part of this feature.\\n+ - Do not introduce new analytics dependencies; we will reuse existing logging where possible.\\n+ \\n+ ---\\n+ \\n+ ## UX and UI\\n+ \\n+ ### Surfaces\\n+ - Chat message detail block (beneath each assistant message):\\n+   - Reasoning Summary: bullet list, always visible when “Show reasoning” is on (default on).\\n+   - Tool Trace: collapsible details (default collapsed). Shows each step with name, duration, and high-level result info.\\n+   - Scratchpad: Admin-only sub-toggle “Show scratchpad (debug)”. Hidden by default; visible only if current user is admin.\\n+ \\n+ ### Controls\\n+ - Global toggle in chat UI header or settings pane:\\n+   - “Show reasoning” (on/off). On shows Reasoning Summary + Tool Trace.\\n+   - If user.isAdmin: nested “Show scratchpad (debug)” toggle; default off.\\n+ \\n+ ### Presentation\\n+ - Reasoning Summary: 2–5 short bullets, plain text. No secrets, no prompts, no identifiers.\\n+ - Tool Trace (collapsible):\\n+   - Step list with: tool name, args (redacted), durationMs, resultCount or top citations.\\n+   - For search results: show filing type/date/section and a short snippet. Avoid long payloads.\\n+ - Scratchpad (admin-only, collapsible):\\n+   - Monospace preformatted block, limited to ~200 tokens.\\n+   - Display a caution banner (“Debug view — not user facing. Not stored.”).\\n+ \\n+ ---\\n+ \\n+ ## API and Data Model\\n+ \\n+ ### Response envelope (server → client)\\n+ &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;json\\n+ {\\n+   \\&amp;quot;answer\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;final text\\&amp;quot;,\\n+   \\&amp;quot;reasoningSummary\\&amp;quot;: [\\&amp;quot;Selected filing content search\\&amp;quot;, \\&amp;quot;Filtered to 2024 10‑K\\&amp;quot;, \\&amp;quot;Quoted Item 1A\\&amp;quot;],\\n+   \\&amp;quot;toolTrace\\&amp;quot;: [\\n+     {\\n+       \\&amp;quot;tool\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;searchFilings\\&amp;quot;,\\n+       \\&amp;quot;args\\&amp;quot;: {\\&amp;quot;query\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;risk factors\\&amp;quot;},       // redact sensitive fields\\n+       \\&amp;quot;durationMs\\&amp;quot;: 412,\\n+       \\&amp;quot;results\\&amp;quot;: 5,\\n+       \\&amp;quot;topCitations\\&amp;quot;: [\\n+         {\\&amp;quot;filing\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;10-K\\&amp;quot;, \\&amp;quot;date\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;2024-11-01\\&amp;quot;, \\&amp;quot;section\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;Item 1A\\&amp;quot;}\\n+       ]\\n+     }\\n+   ],\\n+   \\&amp;quot;scratchpad\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;&amp;lt;private notes&amp;gt;\\&amp;quot;,             // only included if admin + flag\\n+   \\&amp;quot;citations\\&amp;quot;: [\\n+     {\\&amp;quot;filing\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;10-K\\&amp;quot;, \\&amp;quot;date\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;2024-11-01\\&amp;quot;, \\&amp;quot;section\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;Item 1A\\&amp;quot;, \\&amp;quot;anchor\\&amp;quot;: \\&amp;quot;#risk-factors\\&amp;quot;}\\n+   ]\\n+ }\\n+ &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n+ \\n+ Notes:\\n+ - &amp;#96;scratchpad&amp;#96; must never be persisted. It’s only added to the API response for admins when an explicit dev flag is enabled.\\n+ - &amp;#96;toolTrace.args&amp;#96; should pass through a redaction layer before returning to client (e.g., mask long strings, strip tokens/keys).\\n+ \\n+ ### Tool Trace step shape (TypeScript)\\n+ &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;ts\\n+ type ToolTraceStep = {\\n+   tool: string;\\n+   args: Record&amp;lt;string, unknown&amp;gt;;\\n+   durationMs: number;\\n+   results?: number;\\n+   topCitations?: Array&amp;lt;{\\n+     filing: string;\\n+     date: string;\\n+     section?: string;\\n+     anchor?: string;\\n+   }&amp;gt;;\\n+ };\\n+ &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n+ \\n+ ---\\n+ \\n+ ## Prompt Design\\n+ \\n+ ### Pattern\\n+ Ask the model for three sections: “Reasoning Summary”, “Final Answer”, and a private “&amp;lt;scratchpad&amp;gt;”. Instruct the model not to reveal scratchpad content to the user.\\n+ \\n+ Example (conceptual):\\n+ &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n+ You may think step-by-step in &amp;lt;scratchpad&amp;gt; (max 200 tokens). We keep this intact.\\n- **Low-risk spike**: This trial checks whether ChatKit can act as a purely visual layer with a custom transport; if it can’t, we revert without backend changes.\\n\\n### Current state (baseline)\\nOur server endpoint &amp;#96;app/api/ask/route.ts&amp;#96; streams Server-Sent Events (SSE) with these event types:\\n- &amp;#96;status&amp;#96;: progress updates (selecting, fetching, generating, suggestions)\\n- &amp;#96;data&amp;#96;: payload describing &amp;#96;dataUsed&amp;#96; and optional &amp;#96;chartConfig&amp;#96;\\n- &amp;#96;answer&amp;#96;: streamed assistant text deltas (final answer content)\\n- &amp;#96;validation&amp;#96;: server-side validation results\\n- &amp;#96;followup&amp;#96;: array of suggested follow-up questions\\n- &amp;#96;complete&amp;#96;: final timing/metrics, includes &amp;#96;answer&amp;#96;\\n- &amp;#96;error&amp;#96;: error message\\n\\nOn the client, &amp;#96;components/AssistantChat.tsx&amp;#96; renders the chat, consumes the SSE stream, shows the streamed answer, renders charts from &amp;#96;chartConfig&amp;#96;, and displays follow-up suggestions.\\n\\n### Goal of this trial\\n- Replace the custom chat UI in &amp;#96;components/AssistantChat.tsx&amp;#96; with ChatKit components while continuing to consume our existing SSE stream without changing the backend protocol.\\n- Map our SSE events to ChatKit’s message/data model as closely as possible.\\n\\n### Scope\\n- In-scope: Add ChatKit UI components, create an adapter that feeds ChatKit from our SSE, wire user input → our &amp;#96;/api/ask&amp;#96; SSE, render streamed deltas, keep charts and follow-ups.\\n- Out-of-scope: Migrating to OpenAI Sessions/Agents/Workflows; changing &amp;#96;app/api/ask/route.ts&amp;#96; logic; altering tool selection, validation, or data fetching.\\n\\n### Assumptions to validate (first)\\n1.         "contents": "async function setup() {\n  console.log('🚀 Setting up financial_metrics system...\\n')\n\n  // Step 1: Check if table exists\n  console.log('1️⃣  Checking if financial_metrics table exists...')\n  const { error: tableError } = await supabase\n    .from('financial_metrics')\n    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n\n  if (tableError) {\n    console.error('❌ Table does not exist!')\n    console.log('\\n📋 Please run the migration first:')\n    console.log('   npx tsx scripts/apply-migration.ts')\n    console.log('\\n   Or manually in Supabase Dashboard:\\n')\n    console.log('   https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/hccwmbmnmbmhuslmbymq/sql\\n')\n    process.exit(1)\n  }\n\n  console.log('✅ Table exists!\\n')\n\n  // Step 2: Check if data file exists, if not fetch it\n  const dataPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data/aapl-fmp-metrics.json')\n  let needsFetch = false\n\n  try {\n    await fs.access(dataPath)\n    console.log('2️⃣  Found existing data file: data/aapl-fmp-metrics.json')\n  } catch {\n    console.log('2️⃣  Data file not found, fetching from FMP API...')\n    needsFetch = true\n  }\n\n  if (needsFetch) {\n    console.log('   Running fetch-fmp-metrics.ts...\\n')\n    try {\n      const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync('npx tsx scripts/fetch-fmp-metrics.ts')\n      console.log(stdout)\n      if (stderr) console.error(stderr)\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      console.error('❌ Fetch failed:', err.message)\n      process.exit(1)\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Step 3: Load and ingest data\n  console.log('\\n3️⃣  Loading metrics data...')\n  const fileContent = await fs.readFile(dataPath, 'utf-8')\n  const metrics: MetricRecord[] = JSON.parse(fileContent)\n\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Loaded ${metrics.length} metric records&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;📅 Years: ${Math.min(...metrics.map((m) =&gt; m.year))} - ${Math.max(...metrics.map((m) =&gt; m.year))}&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;🔢 Unique metrics: ${new Set(metrics.map((m) =&gt; m.metric_name)).size}\\n&#96;)\n\n  // Step 4: Check existing data\n  const { count: existingCount } = await supabase\n    .from('financial_metrics')\n    .select\n}",

        "contents": "# Chatbot Technical Overview &amp; Improvement Ideas\n\n## Technical Architecture\n\n### High-Level Flow\n\nThe chatbot uses a **three-step LLM orchestration pattern**:\n\n1. **Tool Selection** → LLM picks which data tool to use\n2. **Tool Execution** → Fetch data from Supabase\n3. **Answer Generation** → LLM generates final answer from facts\n\n### Core Components\n\n#### 1. **Frontend Entry Points**\n- **&#96;app/page.tsx&#96;** - Home page with streaming chatbot (uses &#96;/api/ask&#96; route)\n- **&#96;app/chatbot/page.tsx&#96;** - Dedicated chatbot page (uses &#96;askQuestion&#96; server action)\n\n#### 2. **API Layer**\n- **&#96;app/api/ask/route.ts&#96;** - Streaming API endpoint (Server-Sent Events)\n  - Streams: &#96;flow&#96;, &#96;data&#96;, &#96;answer&#96;, &#96;validation&#96;, &#96;followup&#96;, &#96;complete&#96; events\n  - Real-time progress updates via Flow Visualization\n  - Edge runtime for low latency\n\n#### 3. **Server Actions**\n- **&#96;app/actions/ask-question.ts&#96;** - Main orchestration function\n  - Non-streaming version (used by chatbot page)\n  - Handles tool selection, execution, answer generation\n  - Includes validation and regeneration logic\n\n#### 4. **Tool System** (&#96;lib/tools.ts&#96;)\nAvailable tools:\n- &#96;getAaplFinancialsByMetric&#96; - Basic financial metrics (revenue, profit, assets, etc.)\n- &#96;getPrices&#96; - Stock price history with custom date ranges\n- &#96;getRecentFilings&#96; - SEC filing metadata (dates, types, URLs)\n- &#96;searchFilings&#96; - Semantic search through filing content\n- &#96;listMetrics&#96; - Browse available metrics catalog\n- &#96;getFinancialMetric&#96; - Advanced metrics (P/E, ROE, debt ratios, 139+ metrics)\n\n#### 5. **Data Layer**\n- **Supabase** - PostgreSQL database with:\n  - &#96;financials_std&#96; - Standardized financial statements\n  - &#96;prices&#96; - Historical stock prices\n  - &#96;filings&#96; - SEC filing metadata\n  - &#96;filing_chunks&#96; - Vector embeddings for semantic search\n  - &#96;query_logs&#96; - Analytics and feedback tracking\n  - &#96;conversations&#96; / &#96;messages&#96; - Persistent chat history\n\n#### 6. **LLM Integration**\n- **OpenAI Responses API** (gpt-4o-mini or gpt-5-nano)\n- **Two-stage prompting**:\n  - Tool selection: JSON-structured output (&#96;{\"tool\": string, \"args\": object}&#96;)",

        "contents": "async function chunkFilings() {\n\n\n  for (const file of files) {\n    if (!file.name.endsWith('.html')) continue\n\n    console.log(&#96;Processing: ${file.name}&#96;)\n\n    // Download HTML from storage\n    const { data: htmlBlob, error: downloadError } = await supabase.storage\n      .from('filings')\n      .download(&#96;html/${file.name}&#96;)\n\n    if (downloadError || !htmlBlob) {\n      console.error(&#96;  ✗ Error downloading: ${downloadError?.message}&#96;)\n      continue\n    }\n\n    const html = await htmlBlob.text()\n\n    // Parse filename to get filing info\n    // Format: aapl-10-k-2024.html or aapl-10-q-2024-q1.html\n    const fileNameMatch = file.name.match(/(\\w+)-(\\d+)-?([kq])-(\\d{4})(?:-q(\\d))?\\.html/)\n    if (!fileNameMatch) {\n      console.error(&#96;  ✗ Could not parse filename: ${file.name}&#96;)\n      continue\n    }\n\n    const [, ticker, , filingTypeLetter, fiscalYear, fiscalQuarter] = fileNameMatch\n    const filingType = filingTypeLetter === 'k' ? '10-K' : '10-Q'\n\n    // Find filing in database\n    const { data: filings, error: filingError } = await supabase\n      .from('filings')\n      .select('id')\n      .eq('ticker', ticker.toUpperCase())\n      .eq('filing_type', filingType)\n      .eq('fiscal_year', parseInt(fiscalYear))\n\n    if (filingError || !filings || filings.length === 0) {\n      console.error(&#96;  ✗ Could not find filing in database&#96;)\n      continue\n    }\n\n    const filingId = filings[0].id\n\n    // Check if already chunked\n    const { data: existingChunks } = await supabase\n      .from('filing_chunks')\n      .select('id')\n      .eq('filing_id', filingId)\n      .limit(1)\n\n    if (existingChunks &amp;&amp; existingChunks.length &gt; 0) {\n      console.log(&#96;  ⊘ Already chunked&#96;)\n      continue\n    }\n\n    // Extract clean text from HTML\n    const cleanText = extractTextFromHtml(html)\n    console.log(&#96;  ✓ Extracted ${cleanText.length.toLocaleString()} characters&#96;)\n\n    // Split into chunks\n    const chunks = createChunks(cleanText, CHUNK_SIZE, CHUNK_OVERLAP)\n    console.log(&#96;  ✓ Created ${chunks.length} chunks&#96;)\n\n    // Insert chunks into database (without embeddings for now)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Ingestion script: Loads AAPL SEC filings from seed file into Supabase\n * Run with: npx tsx scripts/ingest-filings.ts\n */\n\nimport { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'\nimport * as fs from 'fs/promises'\nimport * as path from 'path'\n\nasync function ingestFilings() {\n  const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL\n  const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY\n\n  if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) {\n    console.error('Error: Missing Supabase credentials in .env.local')\n    console.error('SUPABASE_URL:', SUPABASE_URL ? 'Found' : 'Missing')\n    console.error('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:', SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ? 'Found' : 'Missing')\n    return\n  }\n  console.log('Starting AAPL filings ingestion...\\n')\n\n  // Read seed data\n  const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'aapl-filings.json')\n  const fileContent = await fs.readFile(filePath, 'utf-8')\n  const filings = JSON.parse(fileContent)\n\n  console.log(&#96;✓ Loaded ${filings.length} filings from seed file\\n&#96;)\n\n  // Create Supabase client\n  const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)\n\n  // Get existing filings by accession number (unique identifier)\n  const { data: existingFilings, error: fetchError } = await supabase\n    .from('filings')\n    .select('accession_number')\n    .eq('ticker', 'AAPL')\n\n  if (fetchError) {\n    console.error('Error fetching existing filings:', fetchError)\n    console.error('\\nNote: If table does not exist, run the SQL in data/create-filings-table.sql in Supabase SQL Editor first.')\n    return\n  }\n\n  const existingAccessionNumbers = new Set(\n    existingFilings?.map((f) =&gt; f.accession_number) || []\n  )\n\n  console.log(&#96;Found ${existingAccessionNumbers.size} existing filings in database\\n&#96;)\n\n  let inserted = 0\n  let skipped = 0\n  let errors = 0\n\n  for (const filing of filings)\n}",

        "contents": "'use server'\n\nimport { createServerClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'\n\n// Safe, purpose-built tool for fetching recent SEC filings for AAPL only\n// This is designed to be called by server code (e.g., an LLM routing step) and returns\n// a minimal, predictable shape for easy prompting and display.\nexport async function getRecentFilings(params: {\n  ticker?: string // AAPL only for MVP\n  limit?: number // number of most recent filings to fetch\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: Array&lt;{\n    filing_type: string\n    filing_date: string\n    period_end_date: string\n    fiscal_year: number\n    fiscal_quarter: number | null\n    document_url: string\n  }&gt; | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n  const ticker = params.ticker ?? 'AAPL'\n  const requestedLimit = params.limit ?? 5\n\n  // Enforce AAPL-only for MVP\n  if (ticker !== 'AAPL') {\n    return { data: null, error: 'Only AAPL ticker is supported in MVP' }\n  }\n\n  // Limit rows to a small, safe window (1..10)\n  const safeLimit = Math.min(Math.max(requestedLimit, 1), 10)\n\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient()\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('filings')\n      .select('filing_type, filing_date, period_end_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, document_url')\n      .eq('ticker', ticker)\n      .order('filing_date', { ascending: false })\n      .limit(safeLimit)\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching filings:', error)\n      return { data: null, error: error.message }\n    }\n\n    return { data: data ?? [], error: null }\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error('Unexpected error (getRecentFilings):', err)\n    return {\n      data: null,\n      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An unexpected error occurred',\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "else if (toolSelection.tool === 'getFinancialMetric') {\n  const metricName = toolSelection.args.metricName\n  const limit = toolSelection.args.limit || 5\n\n  const toolResult = await getFinancialMetric({\n    symbol: 'AAPL',\n    metricName,\n    limit\n  })\n\n  if (toolResult.error || !toolResult.data) {\n    toolError = toolResult.error || 'Failed to fetch metric'\n    return { ... }\n  }\n\n  factsJson = JSON.stringify(toolResult.data, null, 2)\n  dataUsed = { type: 'financial_metric', data: toolResult.data }\n\n  // Optional: Generate chart for metric over time\n  chartConfig = generateMetricChart(toolResult.data, metricName)\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4.         "contents": "- **RAG (Retrieval‑Augmented Generation)**: For document questions (filings/transcripts), retrieve the most relevant passages via a vector store, then answer using those passages. We’ll add this after MVP.\n\n---\n\n## Architecture overview\n\n### Frontend (browser)\n- Next.js app with a simple UI: text box + Ask button + answer display.\n- No secrets in the browser.\n- Uses &#96;createBrowserClient()&#96; only for UI‑safe tasks.\n\n### Backend (server)\n- Next.js server actions/API routes handle all sensitive work.\n- Uses &#96;createServerClient()&#96; to talk to Supabase (read‑only for MVP).\n- Two LLM steps per question:\n  1) Selection: model picks exactly one tool from our small menu and provides JSON args.\n  2) Answering: after we run the tool and get facts, the model writes the final answer using only those facts.\n\n### Data (Supabase)\n- We store standardized financials in &#96;financials_std&#96; and company metadata in &#96;company&#96;.\n- For MVP, we enforce AAPL‑only and small row limits (1–8) at the tool level.\n\n---\n\n## Current code in the repo (important files)\n- &#96;lib/supabase/client.ts&#96;: Creates the browser client (uses &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_*&#96; env vars; no session persistence). For UI only.\n- &#96;lib/supabase/server.ts&#96;: Creates the server client (same env vars; no session persistence). For server actions and API routes.\n- &#96;lib/database.types.ts&#96;: Typed Supabase schema for &#96;company&#96; and &#96;financials_std&#96;.\n- &#96;app/actions/financials.ts&#96;:\n  - &#96;getCompaniesWithFinancials()&#96;: Example server action that composes companies with financials for display.\n  - &#96;getAaplFinancialsByMetric({ metric, limit })&#96;: SAFE TOOL (MVP). Allowed metrics: &#96;revenue&#96; or &#96;gross_profit&#96;. Limit clamped to 1..8. Always filters to &#96;AAPL&#96;. Returns an array of &#96;{ year, value, metric }&#96;.\n- &#96;lib/tools.ts&#96;:\n  - &#96;TOOL_MENU&#96;: Defines the tool(s) the model can choose from.",

        "contents": "async function ingestDirect() {\n  console.log('📥 Loading metrics from file...\\n')\n\n  const dataPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data/aapl-fmp-metrics.json')\n  const fileContent = await fs.readFile(dataPath, 'utf-8')\n  const metrics: MetricRecord[] = JSON.parse(fileContent)\n\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Loaded ${metrics.length} records\\n&#96;)\n\n  // Build bulk INSERT statement\n  console.log('🔧 Building SQL INSERT statement...')\n\n  const values = metrics.map((m) =&gt; {\n    const symbol = m.symbol.replace(/'/g, \"''\")\n    const metricName = m.metric_name.replace(/'/g, \"''\")\n    const period = m.period?.replace(/'/g, \"''\") || 'FY'\n    const category = m.metric_category?.replace(/'/g, \"''\") || 'Other'\n    const source = m.data_source?.replace(/'/g, \"''\") || 'FMP'\n    const value = m.metric_value || 'NULL'\n\n    return &#96;('${symbol}', ${m.year}, '${period}', '${metricName}', ${value}, '${category}', '${source}')&#96;\n  })\n\n  // Split into batches (PostgreSQL has limits)\n  const BATCH_SIZE = 500\n  let inserted = 0\n\n  console.log(&#96;📦 Inserting in ${Math.ceil(values.length / BATCH_SIZE)} batches...\\n&#96;)\n\n  for (let i = 0; i &lt; values.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {\n    const batch = values.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE)\n  }\n}",

Update Database Types\n**File:** &#96;lib/database.types.ts&#96;\n\nAdd &#96;filings&#96; table type definition\n\n### Example Flow\n\n**User Question:** \"Show me AAPL's last 3 quarterly filings\"\n\n**Step 1 - Selection:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\"tool\": \"getRecentFilings\", \"args\": {\"limit\": 3}}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Step 2 - Execution:**\n- Queries Supabase for 3 most recent filings\n- Returns filing metadata\n\n**Step 3 - Answer:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nAAPL's last 3 quarterly filings are:\n1. 10-Q for Q4 2024, filed on 2024-11-01\n2. 10-Q for Q3 2024, filed on 2024-08-01\n3. 10-Q for Q2 2024, filed on 2024-05-02\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Data Used Display:**\nTable with filing type, dates, and clickable links to SEC\n\n### Testing Criteria\n- ✅ Questions about filings route to &#96;getRecentFilings&#96; tool\n- ✅ Filings display with correct metadata\n- ✅ Links to SEC EDGAR work\n- ✅ No duplicate filings in database\n- ✅ Handles 10-K vs 10-Q correctly\n\n### Data Scope\n- AAPL only for MVP\n- Last 5-10 years of filings\n- 10-K (annual) and 10-Q (quarterly) only\n- Approximately 40-50 filings total\n\n### Next After This\nOnce filings work:\n- ✅ Phase 4: Add RAG for full-text document Q&amp;A (COMPLETE)\n- OR expand to multi-ticker support\n- OR add multi-hop reasoning for complex questions\n\n---\n\n## Phase 4 — ✅ COMPLETE: RAG for SEC Filings (Semantic Document Search)",

        "contents": "# CLAUDE.md\n\nThis file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.\n\n## Project Overview\n\n**Fin Quote** is a Next.js-based financial data platform with an AI-powered Q&amp;A chatbot that answers natural language questions about Apple (AAPL) stock. The system uses a two-step LLM architecture with tool selection, data execution, answer generation, and validation.\n\n**Core Design Philosophy:**\n- **Safety First**: LLMs cannot execute arbitrary database queries.         "contents": "# CLAUDE.md\n\nThis file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.\n\n## Project Overview\n\n**Fin Quote** is a Next.js-based financial Q&amp;A platform that uses LLMs to answer natural language questions about Apple (AAPL) stock data. The system uses a two-step LLM architecture: (1) tool selection and (2) answer generation with validation.\n\n**Core Design Philosophy:**\n- **Safety First**: LLMs cannot execute arbitrary database queries. Instead, they select from a whitelist of pre-built \"tools\" (server actions) with validated inputs.\n- **Server-Side Intelligence**: All LLM calls, database queries, and validation logic run server-side. The browser only handles UI.\n- **Grounded Answers**: The LLM must use only fetched data; no external knowledge or hallucinations allowed.\n- **Validation Pipeline**: All answers are validated against source data for number accuracy, year correctness, and citation validity.\n\n---\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Two-Step LLM Flow\n\nEvery user question follows this pattern:\n\n1. **Tool Selection** (&#96;ask-question.ts:224-313&#96;)\n   - LLM receives question + conversation history + tool menu\n   - Returns JSON: &#96;{\"tool\": \"toolName\", \"args\": {...}}&#96;\n   - Model: Uses &#96;OPENAI_MODEL&#96; (default: &#96;gpt-5-nano&#96;)\n\n2. **Tool Execution** (&#96;ask-question.ts:316-438&#96;)\n   - Server validates tool + args\n   - Executes corresponding server action\n   - Returns structured data (financials, prices, filings, or passages)\n\n3. **Answer Generation** (&#96;ask-question.ts:441-500&#96;)\n   - LLM receives question + fetched facts + conversation history\n   - Generates grounded answer using only provided data\n   - Plain text output (no Markdown)\n\n4. **Validation** (&#96;ask-question.ts:503-658&#96;)\n   - Validates numbers, years, and filing citations\n   - If validation fails with high severity, triggers auto-regeneration\n   - Logs validation results to &#96;query_logs&#96; table\n\n### Available Tools\n\nDefined in &#96;lib/tools.ts&#96; (TOOL_MENU):\n\n1. **getAaplFinancialsByMetric** - Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow metrics\n   - Core metrics: &#96;revenue&#96;, &#96;gross_profit&#96;, &#96;net_income&#96;, &#96;operating_income&#96;, &#96;total_assets&#96;, &#96;total_liabilities&#96;, &#96;shareholders_equity&#96;, &#96;operating_cash_flow&#96;, &#96;eps&#96;",

        "contents": "async function downloadFilings() {\n\n\n  for (const filing of filings) {\n    const fileName = &#96;${filing.ticker.toLowerCase()}-${filing.filing_type.toLowerCase()}-${filing.fiscal_year}${filing.fiscal_quarter ? '-q' + filing.fiscal_quarter : ''}.html&#96;\n    const storagePath = &#96;html/${fileName}&#96;\n\n    console.log(&#96;Processing: ${filing.filing_type} ${filing.filing_date} (FY${filing.fiscal_year})&#96;)\n\n    // Check if already downloaded\n    const { data: existingFile } = await supabase.storage\n      .from('filings')\n      .list('html', {\n        search: fileName,\n      })\n\n    if (existingFile &amp;&amp; existingFile.length &gt; 0) {\n      console.log(&#96;  ⊘ Already downloaded: ${fileName}&#96;)\n      skipped++\n      continue\n    }\n\n    // Download from SEC with required User-Agent\n    try {\n      console.log(&#96;  ↓ Downloading from SEC...&#96;)\n      const response = await fetch(filing.document_url, {\n        headers: {\n          'User-Agent': 'Fin Quote App contact@example.com', // SEC requires this\n          Accept: 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml',\n        },\n      })\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}&#96;)\n      }\n\n      const html = await response.text()\n      const fileSizeMB = (html.length / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)\n      console.log(&#96;  ✓ Downloaded ${fileSizeMB} MB&#96;)\n\n      // Upload to Supabase Storage\n      const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage\n        .from('filings')\n        .upload(storagePath, html, {\n          contentType: 'text/html',\n          upsert: false,\n        })\n\n      if (uploadError) {\n        throw uploadError\n      }\n\n      console.log(&#96;  ✓ Uploaded to storage: ${storagePath}&#96;)\n\n      // Update filing record to mark as downloaded\n      const { error: updateError } = await supabase\n        .from('filings')\n        .update({\n          // We'll add a 'downloaded' column later, for now just log\n        })\n        .eq('id', filing.id)\n\n      downloaded++\n\n      // Rate limit: wait 1 second between SEC requests (be polite)\n      await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 1000))\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\n        &#96;  ✗ Error downloading \n\n}",

        "contents": "- &#96;financials_std&#96; - Core financial metrics by year (9 metrics with 20-year history)\n- &#96;financial_metrics&#96; - Extended metrics (139 metrics from FMP, 2006-2025)\n- &#96;filings&#96; - SEC filing metadata with fiscal year/quarter\n- &#96;filing_chunks&#96; - Text chunks with embeddings for semantic search (1536-dim vectors via pgvector)\n- &#96;price_history&#96; - Historical daily stock prices (not currently used; prices fetched from FMP API)\n- &#96;query_logs&#96; - Query logging for accuracy tracking, validation results, and cost analysis\n- &#96;conversations&#96; - User conversation history (with auto-generated titles)\n- &#96;messages&#96; - Individual messages within conversations (with chart configs and follow-up questions)\n\n**Storage:**\n- &#96;filings&#96; bucket - Original SEC filing HTML files from EDGAR\n\n**Key Functions:**\n- &#96;search_filing_chunks()&#96; No prose.\n\nAvailable Tools:\n\n1. getAaplFinancialsByMetric - Financial metrics as NUMBERS over time\n\n   SUPPORTED METRICS:\n\n   Raw Metrics:\n   - revenue, gross_profit, net_income, operating_income\n   - total_assets, total_liabilities, shareholders_equity\n   - operating_cash_flow, eps\n\n   Calculated Metrics (✨ Native Support):\n   - debt_to_equity_ratio  (total_liabilities / shareholders_equity)\n   - gross_margin          (gross_profit / revenue × 100)\n   - roe                   (net_income / shareholders_equity × 100)\n\n   METRIC MAPPING (with context clues):\n\n   Income/Profitability:\n   - \"sales\", \"revenue\", \"top line\" → revenue\n   - \"profit\", \"earnings\", \"bottom line\", \"profitability\" → net_income\n   - \"EPS\", \"earnings per share\" → eps\n   - \"operating profit\", \"EBIT\" → operating_income\n\n   Valuation Ratios (use getFinancialMetric tool):\n   - \"P/E ratio\", \"PE ratio\", \"price to earnings\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/E\"]\n   - \"P/B ratio\", \"price to book\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/B\"]\n   - \"PEG ratio\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"PEG\"]\n\n   Calculated Ratios (✨ NOW NATIVE - use directly):\n   - \"gross margin\", \"gross profit margin\" → gross_margin\n   - \"ROE\", \"return on equity\" → roe\n   - \"debt to equity\", \"debt-to-equity\", \"D/E ratio\", \"leverage ratio\" → debt_to_equity_ratio\n\n   Balance Sheet (Raw):\n   - \"assets\", \"total assets\" → total_assets\n   - \"liabilities\", \"total debt\", \"debt\" → total_liabilities\n   - \"equity\", \"book value\", \"shareholders equity\" → shareholders_equity\n\n   Cash Flow:\n   - \"operating cash flow\", \"cash from operations\", \"OCF\" → operating_cash_flow\n   - \"free cash flow\", \"FCF\", \"unlevered free cash flow\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\n   - \"capex\", \"capital expenditures\", \"buybacks\", \"dividends paid\", \"stock-based compensation\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\n\n   Research &amp; Development:\n   - \"R&amp;D\", \"research and development\", \"R&amp;D spending\", \"R&amp;D expense\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"R&amp;D to revenue\"] or [\"research and development\"]\n\n   Other (use closest available):\n   - \"margins\", \"ratios\" (when not specific) → operating_income\n\n   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:\n\n   1. If question asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (2020, 2019, 2015, 2006, etc.) → limit: 20\n      Why: We have 20 years (2006-2025). To find any specific year, fetch all.\n      Examples:\n      - \"net income in 2020\" → limit: 20\n      - \"revenue for 2018\" → limit: 20\n      - \"What was EPS in 2006?\" → limit: 20\n\n   2. If question asks for a YEAR RANGE (2008 to 2020, 2015 to present, etc.) → limit: 20\n      Why: Need all data to filter to the specific range.\n      Examples:\n      - \"net income 2008 to present\" → limit: 20\n      - \"revenue from 2015 to 2020\" → limit: 20\n      - \"EPS between 2010 and 2018\" → limit: 20\n\n   3. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:\n      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3\n      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5\n      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1\n      \"10 years\" → limit: 10\n      \"20 years\" → limit: 20\n      \"2 years\" → limit: 2\n\n   4. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4\n\n   5. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 20\n\n   6. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"net income in 2006\" → limit: 20 (specific year)\n   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5 (number specified)\n   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 20 (all data)\n\n   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-20&gt;}\n\n2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history\n\n   ALWAYS use custom date ranges. Calculate the \"from\" date based on the user's request.\n   Today's date is {{TODAY_DATE}} (use this for calculations).\n\n   Date format: YYYY-MM-DD\n   \"to\" is optional (defaults to today)\n\n   CALCULATION EXAMPLES:\n   - \"last 7 days\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-11-01\"} (7 days ago)\n   - \"past month\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-10-08\"} (30 days ago)\n   - \"last 3 months\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-08-08\"} (90 days ago)\n   - \"past year\" → args: {\"from\": \"2024-11-08\"} (365 days ago)\n   - \"YTD\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-01-01\"} (start of current year)\n   - \"last 3 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2022-11-08\"} (3 years ago)\n   - \"past 5 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-11-08\"} (5 years ago)\n   - \"last 7 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-11-08\"} (7 years ago)\n   - \"past 10 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-11-08\"} (10 years ago)\n   - \"last 15 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2010-11-08\"} (15 years ago)\n   - \"past 20 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago)\n   - \"all time\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago, max available)\n\n   EXACT DATE RANGES:\n   - \"from Jan 2020 to June 2023\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-01-01\", \"to\": \"2023-06-30\"}\n   - \"prices between 2015 and 2020\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-01-01\", \"to\": \"2020-12-31\"}\n   - \"from March 2018 to now\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-03-01\"}\n\n   args: {\"from\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\", \"to\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\"}  (to is optional)\n\n3. getRecentFilings - provide quotes.\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}\n\nQ: \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone sales?\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"iPhone sales\",\"limit\":5}}\n\nQ: \"Provide quotes from the latest filing about competition\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"competition\",\"limit\":5}}\n\nCRITICAL EXAMPLES - Advanced Metrics:\nQ: \"What is AAPL's debt to equity ratio?\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"debt to equity\"],\"limit\":5}}\n\nQ: \"Show me P/E ratio trend\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\"],\"limit\":4}}\n\nQ: \"What's the ROE in 2023?\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"ROE\"],\"limit\":20}}\n\nQ: \"Compare P/E and PEG ratio\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\",\"PEG\"],\"limit\":10}}&#96;\n\n// New function that returns structured messages for caching\nexport const buildToolSelectionMessages = (userQuestion: string)",
