        "contents": "# Financial Metrics System - Implementation Summary\n\n**Branch:** &#96;feature/add-financial-metrics&#96;\n**Date:** 2025-11-06\n**Status:** ✅ **Phase 1 Complete** (Database + Data Loading)\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 What We Built\n\nAdded **139 financial metrics** from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API to the Supabase database, expanding beyond the original 9 metrics to include comprehensive valuation, profitability, growth, and leverage ratios.\n\n---\n\n## ✅ Completed\n\n### 1. Database Schema\n\n**Table:** &#96;financial_metrics&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE financial_metrics (\n  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,\n  year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  period TEXT, -- 'FY', 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'\n  metric_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  metric_value NUMERIC,\n  metric_category TEXT,\n  data_source TEXT DEFAULT 'FMP',\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n  CONSTRAINT unique_metric_per_period UNIQUE (symbol, year, period, metric_name)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Indexes:**\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year&#96; - Fast lookup by company/year\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_metric_name&#96; - Fast lookup by metric\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_category&#96; - Fast category queries\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year_metric&#96; - Composite for specific queries\n\n**RLS:** Public read access enabled\n\n---\n\n### 2. Data Coverage\n\n| Metric | Count | Description |\n|--------|-------|-------------|\n| **Total Records** | 2,780 | All metrics across all years |\n| **Unique Metrics** | 139 | Distinct metric types |\n| **Years Covered** | 2006-2025 | 20 years of data |\n| **Symbol** | AAPL | Apple Inc. (MVP) |\n\n---\n\n### 3. Metrics by Category\n\n| Category | Records | Example Metrics |\n|----------|---------|----------------|\n| **Valuation** | 77 | P/E Ratio, P/B Ratio, EV/EBITDA, Market Cap |\n| **Profitability &amp; Returns** | 77 | ROE, ROA, ROIC, Gross Margin, Net Margin |\n| **Growth** | 240 | Revenue Growth, EPS Growth, 3Y/5Y/10Y CAGRs |\n| **Leverage &amp; Solvency** | 67 | Debt-to-Equity, Current Ratio, Quick Ratio |\n| **Efficiency &amp; Working Capital** | 68 | Asset Turnover, Inventory Turnover, Cash Conversion Cycle |\n| **Per-Share Metrics** | 51 | Book Value per Share, FCF per Share, Revenue per Share |",

table (latest year)\n- Fetches from &#96;financials_std&#96; table (latest year for core metrics)\n- Fetches from FMP API for real-time metrics (52-week high/low, volume, etc.)\n\n**3. &#96;app/actions/get-all-financials.ts&#96;**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nexport async function getAllFinancials(): Promise&lt;{\n  incomeStatement: Array&lt;{year: number;         },
        "contents": "/**\n * Get all financial metrics grouped by category for the last 5 years\n * Returns data for current year, 1Y ago, 3Y ago, and 5Y ago\n * Currently hardcoded to AAPL\n */\nexport async function getAllMetrics(): Promise&lt;AllMetrics&gt; {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient();\n\n    // Get current year\n    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();\n    const targetYears = [\n      &#96;${currentYear}-01-01&#96;,      // Current (approximate)\n      &#96;${currentYear - 1}-01-01&#96;,  // 1Y ago\n      &#96;${currentYear - 3}-01-01&#96;,  // 3Y ago\n      &#96;${currentYear - 5}-01-01&#96;,  // 5Y ago\n    ];\n\n    // Fetch all metrics for relevant years (key-value format)\n    const { data: metricsData, error } = await supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .select('metric_name, metric_value, year')\n      .eq('symbol', 'AAPL')\n      .order('year', { ascending: false });\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching metrics:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (!metricsData || metricsData.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        valuation: [],\n        profitability: [],\n        leverage: [],\n        efficiency: [],\n        growth: [],\n        perShare: [],\n        capitalReturns: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Group metrics by year\n    const metricsByYear = new Map&lt;number, Map&lt;string, number&gt;&gt;();\n    metricsData.forEach((row) =&gt; {\n      if (!metricsByYear.has(row.year)) {\n        metricsByYear.set(row.year, new Map());\n      }\n      metricsByYear.get(row.year)!.set(row.metric_name, row.metric_value);\n    });\n\n    // Get sorted years\n    const sortedYears = Array.from(metricsByYear.keys()).sort((a, b) =&gt; b - a);\n\n    // Helper function to get metric value by year offset\n    const getMetricValue = (metricKey: string, yearOffset: number): number =&gt; {\n      const targetYearIndex = Math.min(yearOffset, sortedYears.length - 1);\n      if (targetYearIndex &lt; 0) return 0;\n\n      const year = sortedYears[targetYearIndex];\n      const yearMetrics = metricsByYear.get(year);\n      return yearMetrics?.get(metricKey) || 0;\n    };\n\n    // Helper function to transform category metrics\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getAaplFinancialsByMetric(params: {\n  metric: FinancialMetric\n  limit?: number // number of most recent years to fetch\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricDataPoint[] | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n\n\n    // ===============================================\n    // HANDLE RAW METRICS\n    // ===============================================\n\n    const allowedRawMetrics: RawFinancialMetric[] = [\n      'revenue',\n      'gross_profit',\n      'net_income',\n      'operating_income',\n      'total_assets',\n      'total_liabilities',\n      'shareholders_equity',\n      'operating_cash_flow',\n      'eps',\n    ]\n    if (!allowedRawMetrics.includes(metric as RawFinancialMetric)) {\n      return { data: null, error: 'Unsupported metric' }\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('financials_std')\n      .select(\n        'year, revenue, gross_profit, net_income, operating_income, total_assets, total_liabilities, shareholders_equity, operating_cash_flow, eps'\n      )\n      .eq('symbol', 'AAPL')\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n      .limit(safeLimit)\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching AAPL financials by metric:', error)\n      return { data: null, error: error.message }\n    }\n\n    // For margin/ratio calculations, include related metrics\n    type RawRow = Pick&lt;\n      Financial,\n      | 'year'\n      | 'revenue'\n      | 'gross_profit'\n      | 'net_income'\n      | 'operating_income'\n      | 'total_assets'\n      | 'total_liabilities'\n      | 'shareholders_equity'\n      | 'operating_cash_flow'\n      | 'eps'\n    &gt;\n\n    const rows: RawRow[] = (data ??         "contents": "| **Asset Turnover** | &#96;revenue / total_assets&#96; | &#96;revenue&#96;, &#96;total_assets&#96; | How efficiently assets generate revenue |\n\n---\n\n## Metric Type Definitions (TypeScript)\n\n### Raw Metrics\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nexport type RawFinancialMetric =\n  | 'revenue'\n  | 'gross_profit'\n  | 'net_income'\n  | 'operating_income'\n  | 'total_assets'\n  | 'total_liabilities'\n  | 'shareholders_equity'\n  | 'operating_cash_flow'\n  | 'eps'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Calculated Metrics\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nexport type CalculatedFinancialMetric =\n  | 'debt_to_equity_ratio'\n  | 'gross_margin'\n  | 'roe'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Combined\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nexport type FinancialMetric = RawFinancialMetric | CalculatedFinancialMetric\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Data Point Structure\n\nEach metric data point returned by the API includes:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nexport type FinancialMetricDataPoint = {\n  year: number                    // Fiscal year\n  value: number                   // The metric value\n  metric: FinancialMetric         // Metric name\n  revenue?: number | null         // Included for margin calculations\n  shareholders_equity?: number | null  // Included for ROE/debt calculations\n  total_assets?: number | null    // Included for ROA calculations\n  total_liabilities?: number | null   // Included for leverage calculations\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Server Action API\n\n### Function: &#96;getAaplFinancialsByMetric&#96;\n\n**Purpose**: Fetch financial data for AAPL by metric type (raw or calculated)\n\n**Parameters**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  metric: FinancialMetric  // The metric to fetch\n  limit?: number           // Number of years (default: 4, max: 20)\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Returns**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  data: FinancialMetricDataPoint[] | null\n  error: string | null\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Example Usage**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Fetch revenue for last 10 years\nconst result = await getAaplFinancialsByMetric({\n  metric: 'revenue',\n  limit: 10\n})\n\n// Fetch ROE for last 5 years (calculated on-the-fly)\nconst roeResult = await getAaplFinancialsByMetric({\n  metric: 'roe',\n  limit: 5\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Query Constraints\n\n- **Limit**: 1-20 years (enforced by server action)\n- **Symbol**: Hardcoded to AAPL only (MVP constraint)",

        "contents": "/**\n * Get multiple metrics for a single year (useful for comparisons)\n * NOW WITH ALIAS SUPPORT - accepts flexible metric names\n *\n * @example\n * getFinancialMetrics({\n *   symbol: 'AAPL',\n *   metricNames: ['P/E', 'ROE', 'debt to equity'], // Aliases work!\n *   limit: 5\n * })\n */\nexport async function getFinancialMetrics(params: {\n  symbol: string\n  metricNames: string[] // Array of metric names (canonical OR aliases)\n  year?: number\n  yearStart?: number\n  yearEnd?: number\n  limit?: number // Number of years per metric (default: 5, max: 20)\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[] | null\n  error: string | null\n  unresolved?: string[] // Metrics that couldn't be resolved\n}&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 1. Resolve all metric names (aliases → canonical)\n    const { resolved, unresolved } = await resolveMetricNames(params.metricNames)\n\n    // 2. If any metrics couldn't be resolved, return error with suggestions\n    if (unresolved.length &gt; 0) {\n      return {\n        data: null,\n        error: &#96;Could not resolve these metrics: ${unresolved.join(', ')}. Use listMetrics to see available metrics.&#96;,\n        unresolved\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 3. Query database with resolved canonical names\n    const supabase = await createServerClient()\n\n    let query = supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .select('year, metric_name, metric_value, metric_category, data_source')\n      .eq('symbol', params.symbol)\n      .in('metric_name', resolved) // Use resolved canonical names\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n      .order('metric_name', { ascending: true })\n\n    // 4. Apply year filters\n    if (params.year) {\n      query = query.eq('year', params.year)\n    } else {\n      if (params.yearStart) {\n        query = query.gte('year', params.yearStart)\n      }\n      if (params.yearEnd) {\n        query = query.lte('year', params.yearEnd)\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 5. Apply limit (default: 5 years per metric, max: 20)\n    const limit = Math.min(params.limit || 5, 20)\n    query = query.limit(limit * resolved.length)\n\n    const { data, error } = await query\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('[getFinancialMetrics] Error:', error)\n      return { data: null, error: error.message }\n    }\n\n    return { data, error: null }\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    console.error('[getFinancialMetrics] Exception:', err)\n    return { data: null, error: err.message }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Search metrics by category (e.g., all \"Valuation\" metrics)\n */\nexport async function getMetricsByCategory(params: {\n  symbol: string\n  category: string // 'Valuation', 'Profitability &amp; Returns', 'Growth', etc.\n  year?: number\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[] | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "# Missing FMP API Data\n\n## Current State\n\nWe're currently fetching from **5 endpoints**:\n1. ✅ &#96;key-metrics&#96; - Key financial metrics (P/E, ROE, book value, etc.)\n2. ✅ &#96;ratios&#96; - Financial ratios (current ratio, debt ratios, turnover ratios)\n3. ✅ &#96;financial-growth&#96; - Growth rates (revenue growth, EPS growth, etc.)\n4. ✅ &#96;enterprise-values&#96; - Enterprise value components (market cap, debt, cash)\n5. ✅ &#96;income-statement&#96; - Revenue, expenses, EBITDA, margins (NEWLY ADDED)\n\n## Missing Endpoints with Valuable Data\n\n### 1. Balance Sheet Statement (&#96;/balance-sheet-statement&#96;)\n\n**What it provides:**\n- **Assets**: Cash, receivables, inventory, PP&amp;E, investments, intangibles, goodwill\n- **Liabilities**: Payables, short-term debt, long-term debt, deferred revenue\n- **Equity**: Common stock, retained earnings, accumulated OCI\n- **Calculated fields**: Total debt, net debt, total investments\n\n**Why it's important:**\n- We currently have basic balance sheet items (total_assets, total_liabilities, shareholders_equity) from &#96;financials_std&#96; table\n- But we're missing detailed breakdowns like:\n  - Current vs non-current assets/liabilities\n  - PP&amp;E (property, plant, equipment)\n  - Working capital components (inventory, receivables, payables - detailed values, not just turnover ratios)\n  - Debt structure (short-term vs long-term debt)\n  - Cash vs investments breakdown\n\n**Example data (AAPL 2025):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncashAndCashEquivalents: $33.5B\ninventory: $5.7B\npropertyPlantEquipmentNet: $61.0B\nshortTermDebt: $22.4B\nlongTermDebt: $89.9B\ntotalDebt: $112.4B\nnetDebt: $78.8B\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Cash Flow Statement (&#96;/cash-flow-statement&#96;)\n\n**What it provides:**\n- **Operating Activities**: Net income adjustments, working capital changes, D&amp;A, stock-based comp\n- **Investing Activities**: Capex, acquisitions, investment purchases/sales\n- **Financing Activities**: Debt repayment, stock repurchases, dividends\n- **Calculated fields**: Free cash flow, operating cash flow, capex\n\n**Why it's important:**\n- We currently only have &#96;operating_cash_flow&#96; from &#96;financials_std&#96; table\n- But we're missing:\n  - **Free cash flow** (operating cash flow - capex) - critical metric!",

        "contents": "async function fetchFMPData() {\n  console.log('📊 Fetching financial metrics from FMP API...\\\\n')\n\n  const endpoints = {\n    keyMetrics: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/key-metrics/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    ratios: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/ratios/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    growth: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/financial-growth/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    enterpriseValue: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/enterprise-values/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    incomeStatement: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/income-statement/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    cashFlowStatement: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/cash-flow-statement/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n  }\n\n  // Fetch all endpoints in parallel\n  const [keyMetrics, ratios, growth, enterpriseValues, incomeStatements, cashFlowStatements] = await Promise.all([\n    fetch(endpoints.keyMetrics).then((r) =&gt;         "contents": "4. **Validation &amp; Auto-Correction** (lines 653-796)\n   - Validates numbers, years, and filing citations\n   - If validation fails with medium+ severity, triggers auto-regeneration\n   - May refetch data with corrected args if needed\n   - Logs all attempts and results to &#96;query_logs&#96; table\n\n### Available Tools\n\nDefined in &#96;lib/tools.ts&#96; (TOOL_MENU):\n\n1. **getAaplFinancialsByMetric** - Core financial metrics from &#96;financials_std&#96; table\n   - Raw metrics: &#96;revenue&#96;, &#96;gross_profit&#96;, &#96;net_income&#96;, &#96;operating_income&#96;, &#96;total_assets&#96;, &#96;total_liabilities&#96;, &#96;shareholders_equity&#96;, &#96;operating_cash_flow&#96;, &#96;eps&#96;\n   - Calculated metrics (native support): &#96;gross_margin&#96;, &#96;roe&#96;, &#96;debt_to_equity_ratio&#96;\n   - Returns time-series data with related metrics for ratio calculations\n\n2. **getFinancialMetric** - Extended metrics from &#96;financial_metrics&#96; table (139 metrics)\n   - Supports flexible aliases: \"P/E\" → &#96;peRatio&#96;, \"return on equity\" → &#96;returnOnEquity&#96;\n   - Categories: Valuation, Profitability, Growth, Leverage, Efficiency, Per-Share Metrics\n   - Multi-metric queries: fetch multiple metrics in one call\n\n3. **listMetrics** - Browse available metrics catalog\n   - Optional category filter\n   - Returns metric names, descriptions, units, and common aliases\n   - Use when uncertain which metrics are available\n\n4. **getPrices** - Stock price history from FMP API\n   - Custom date ranges: &#96;from&#96; (required), &#96;to&#96; (optional, defaults to today)\n   - Supports multi-year ranges (up to 20 years)\n   - Returns daily OHLCV data\n\n5. **getRecentFilings** - SEC filing metadata (10-K, 10-Q)\n   - Returns filing type, date, period, fiscal year/quarter, URL\n   - Limit: 1-10 filings\n\n6. **searchFilings** - Semantic search over SEC filing content (RAG)\n   - Uses pgvector for embedding-based search\n   - Returns relevant text passages with citations\n   - Query: natural language, Limit: 1-10 passages\n\n### Data Storage (Supabase)\n\n**Core Tables:**\n- &#96;company&#96; - Company metadata (symbol, name, sector)\n- &#96;financials_std&#96; - Core financial metrics by year (9 metrics with 20-year history)\n- &#96;financial_metrics&#96; - Extended metrics (139 metrics from FMP, 2006-2025)",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/actions/get-all-financials.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 44,
            "column": 1
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 146,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Get all financial statements for the last 5 years\n * Returns income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow data\n * Currently hardcoded to AAPL\n */\nexport async function getAllFinancials(): Promise&lt;AllFinancials&gt; {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient();\n\n    // Fetch last 5 years of financial data\n    const { data: financialsData, error } = await supabase\n      .from('financials_std')\n      .select('*')\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n      .limit(5);\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching financials:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (!financialsData || financialsData.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        incomeStatement: [],\n        balanceSheet: [],\n        cashFlow: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Transform data into separate statement arrays\n    const incomeStatement: FinancialYear[] = financialsData.map((row) =&gt; {\n      const revenue = row.revenue || 0;\n      const costOfRevenue = row.cost_of_revenue || 0;\n      const grossProfit = row.gross_profit || 0;\n      const operatingIncome = row.operating_income || 0;\n      const netIncome = row.net_income || 0;\n\n      return {\n        year: row.year,\n        revenue,\n        costOfRevenue,\n        grossProfit,\n        grossMargin: revenue &gt; 0 ? (grossProfit / revenue) * 100 : 0,\n        operatingExpenses: grossProfit - operatingIncome, // Derived\n        operatingIncome,\n        operatingMargin: revenue &gt; 0 ? (operatingIncome / revenue) * 100 : 0,\n        netIncome,\n        netMargin: revenue &gt; 0 ?         "contents": "-- Create financial_metrics table for key-value metric storage\n-- This table stores ~96 financial metrics from FMP API for AAPL\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS financial_metrics (\n  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,\n  year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  period TEXT, -- 'FY' for annual, 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4' for quarterly\n  metric_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  metric_value NUMERIC,\n  metric_category TEXT, -- 'Valuation', 'Profitability', 'Growth', etc.\n  data_source TEXT DEFAULT 'FMP', -- 'FMP', 'Calculated', 'SEC'\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n\n  -- Composite unique constraint: one value per symbol/year/period/metric\n  CONSTRAINT unique_metric_per_period UNIQUE (symbol, year, period, metric_name)\n);\n\n-- Create indexes for fast queries\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year ON financial_metrics(symbol, year);\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_metric_name ON financial_metrics(metric_name);\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_category ON financial_metrics(metric_category);\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year_metric ON financial_metrics(symbol, year, metric_name);\n\n-- Add RLS (Row Level Security)\nALTER TABLE financial_metrics ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- Allow anyone to read financial metrics (public data)\nCREATE POLICY \"Allow public read access to financial metrics\"\n  ON financial_metrics\n  FOR SELECT\n  USING (true);\n\n-- Add comment\nCOMMENT ON TABLE financial_metrics IS 'Key-value storage for 96+ financial metrics from FMP API. Supports annual and quarterly data.';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.metric_name IS 'Metric identifier (e.g., \"marketCap\", \"peRatio\", \"grossMargin\")';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.metric_value IS 'Numeric value of the metric';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.metric_category IS 'Category from stock_metrics_master.csv (e.g., \"Valuation\", \"Profitability &amp; Returns\")';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.data_source IS 'Data source: FMP API endpoints, calculated from existing data, or SEC filings';",

        "contents": "export async function getAaplFinancialsByMetric(params: {\n  metric: FinancialMetric\n  limit?: number // number of most recent years to fetch\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricDataPoint[] | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n\n\n    const rows: RawRow[] = (data ?? []) as RawRow[]\n\n    const mapped: FinancialMetricDataPoint[] = rows.map((row) =&gt; {\n      const metricValue = (row as Record&lt;string, number | null&gt;)[metric] ?? 0\n      const result: FinancialMetricDataPoint = {\n        year: row.year,\n        value: typeof metricValue === 'number' ? metricValue : Number(metricValue ?? 0),\n        metric,\n      }\n\n      // Include revenue for margin calculations\n      if (['gross_profit', 'operating_income', 'net_income', 'operating_cash_flow'].includes(metric)) {\n        result.revenue = row.revenue ?? null\n      }\n\n      // Include shareholders_equity and total_assets for ROE and ROA calculations\n      if (metric === 'net_income') {\n        result.shareholders_equity = row.shareholders_equity ?? null\n        result.total_assets = row.total_assets ?? null\n      }\n\n      // Include shareholders_equity and total_assets for debt-to-equity and debt-to-assets calculations\n      if (metric === 'total_liabilities') {\n        result.shareholders_equity = row.shareholders_equity ?? null\n        result.total_assets = row.total_assets ?? null\n      }\n\n      // Include total_liabilities and total_assets for debt-to-equity calculations\n      if (metric === 'shareholders_equity') {\n        result.total_liabilities = row.total_liabilities ?? null\n        result.total_assets = row.total_assets ?? null\n      }\n\n      // Include revenue for asset turnover calculation\n      if (metric === 'total_assets') {\n        result.revenue = row.revenue ?? null\n        result.total_liabilities = row.total_liabilities ?? null\n        result.shareholders_equity = row.shareholders_equity ?? null\n      }\n\n      return result\n    })\n\n    return { data: mapped, error: null }\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error('Unexpected error (getAaplFinancialsByMetric):', err)\n    return {\n      data: null,\n      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An unexpected error occurred',\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function fetchFMPData() {\n\n\n  // Process Cash Flow Statements (for FCF and capital allocation)\n  cashFlowStatements.forEach((item) =&gt; {\n    const year = new Date(item.date).getFullYear()\n    const cashFlowMetrics = {\n      freeCashFlow: item.freeCashFlow,\n      capitalExpenditure: Math.abs(item.capitalExpenditure), // Make positive (FMP returns negative)\n      commonStockRepurchased: Math.abs(item.commonStockRepurchased), // Make positive (FMP returns negative)\n      dividendsPaid: Math.abs(item.dividendsPaid), // Make positive (FMP returns negative)\n      stockBasedCompensation: item.stockBasedCompensation,\n    }\n\n    Object.entries(cashFlowMetrics).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n      if (typeof value !== 'number' || value === null || isNaN(value)) return\n      if (SKIP_METRICS.has(key)) return // Skip known duplicates\n\n      // Skip duplicates\n      const isDuplicate = metrics.some(\n        (m) =&gt; m.year === year &amp;&amp; m.metric_name === key\n      )\n      if (isDuplicate) return\n\n      metrics.push({\n        symbol: SYMBOL,\n        year,\n        period: 'FY',\n        metric_name: key,\n        metric_value: value,\n        metric_category: CATEGORY_MAP[key] || 'Cash Flow',\n        data_source: 'FMP:cash-flow-statement',\n      })\n    })\n  })\n\n  // Sort by year (newest first), then metric name\n  metrics.sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n    if (b.year !== a.year) return b.year - a.year\n    return a.metric_name.localeCompare(b.metric_name)\n  })\n\n  console.log(&#96;📊 Total metrics collected: ${metrics.length}&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;📅 Years covered: ${Math.min(...metrics.map((m) =&gt; m.year))} - ${Math.max(...metrics.map((m) =&gt; m.year))}&#96;)\n\n  // Count unique metrics\n  const uniqueMetrics = new Set(metrics.map((m) =&gt; m.metric_name))\n  console.log(&#96;🔢 Unique metric types: ${uniqueMetrics.size}\\\\n&#96;)\n\n  // Save to file\n  const dataDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data')\n  await fs.mkdir(dataDir, { recursive: true })\n\n  const filePath = path.join(dataDir, 'aapl-fmp-metrics.json')\n  await fs.writeFile(filePath, JSON.stringify(metrics, null, 2))\n\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Saved to: data/aapl-fmp-metrics.json&#96;)\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst stream = new \nasync start(controller) {\n\n\n          // Execute the selected tool\n          if (toolSelection.tool === 'getAaplFinancialsByMetric') {\n            const metric = toolSelection.args.metric as FinancialMetric\n            const validMetrics: FinancialMetric[] = [\n              // Raw metrics\n              'revenue', 'gross_profit', 'net_income', 'operating_income',\n              'total_assets', 'total_liabilities', 'shareholders_equity',\n              'operating_cash_flow', 'eps',\n              // Calculated metrics\n              'debt_to_equity_ratio', 'gross_margin', 'roe',\n            ]\n            if (!validMetrics.includes(metric)) {\n              console.error('❌ Invalid metric received:', metric, 'Valid metrics:', validMetrics)\n              flow.failStep('tool_execution', {\n                summary: 'Failed to execute tool',\n                why: &#96;Invalid metric \"${metric}\"&#96;,\n                details: { metric },\n              })\n              sendEvent('error', { message: &#96;Invalid metric: ${metric}&#96; })\n              controller.close()\n              return\n            }\n\n            const toolResult = await getAaplFinancialsByMetric({\n              metric,\n              limit: toolSelection.args.limit || 4,\n            })\n\n            if (toolResult.error || !toolResult.data) {\n              flow.failStep('tool_execution', {\n                summary: 'Financial data fetch failed',\n                why: toolResult.error || 'No data returned',\n                details: { metric },\n              })\n              sendEvent('error', { message: toolResult.error || 'Failed to fetch financial data' })\n              controller.close()\n              return\n            }\n\n            factsJson = JSON.stringify(toolResult.data, null, 2)\n            dataUsed = { type: 'financials', data: toolResult.data }\n\n            flow.startStep({\n              step: 'chart_generation',\n\n      }\n\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * One-time script to fetch AAPL financial data from FMP API\n * Saves to data/aapl-financials.json for ingestion\n */\n\nconst FMP_API_KEY = '[REDACTED_FMP_API_KEY]'\n\nasync function fetchFinancials() {\n  const endpoints = {\n    incomeStatement: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/income-statement/AAPL?limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    balanceSheet: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/balance-sheet-statement/AAPL?limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    cashFlow: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/cash-flow-statement/AAPL?limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n  }\n\n  console.log('Fetching AAPL financial data from FMP API...\\n')\n\n  const [incomeData, balanceData, cashFlowData] = await Promise.all([\n    fetch(endpoints.incomeStatement).then((r) =&gt; r.json()),\n    fetch(endpoints.balanceSheet).then((r) =&gt; r.json()),\n    fetch(endpoints.cashFlow).then((r) =&gt; r.json()),\n  ])\n\n  console.log(&#96;✓ Fetched ${incomeData.length} years of income statements&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;✓ Fetched ${balanceData.length} years of balance sheets&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;✓ Fetched ${cashFlowData.length} years of cash flow statements\\n&#96;)\n\n  // Combine by year\n  const combinedByYear: Record&lt;number, any&gt; = {}\n\n  incomeData.forEach((item: any) =&gt; {\n    const year = new Date(item.date).getFullYear()\n    combinedByYear[year] = {\n      symbol: 'AAPL',\n      year,\n      revenue: item.revenue,\n      gross_profit: item.grossProfit,\n      net_income: item.netIncome,\n      operating_income: item.operatingIncome,\n      eps: item.eps,\n    }\n  })\n\n  balanceData.forEach((item: any) =&gt; {\n    const year = new Date(item.date).getFullYear()\n    if (combinedByYear[year]) {\n      combinedByYear[year].total_assets = item.totalAssets\n      combinedByYear[year].total_liabilities = item.totalLiabilities\n      combinedByYear[year].shareholders_equity = item.totalStockholdersEquity\n    }\n  })\n\n  cashFlowData.forEach((item: any) =&gt; {\n    const year = new Date(item.date).getFullYear()\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const formatMetricValue = (value: number, yAxisLabel: string): string =&gt; {\n  const label = yAxisLabel.toLowerCase()\n\n  if (label.includes('%')) {\n    return &#96;${formatNumberValue(value, 1)}%&#96;\n  }\n\n  if (label.includes('($b)')) {\n    return &#96;$${formatNumberValue(value, 1)}B&#96;\n  }\n\n  if (label.includes('($m)')) {\n    return &#96;$${formatNumberValue(value, 1)}M&#96;\n  }\n\n  if (label.includes('($)')) {\n    return &#96;$${formatNumberValue(value, 2)}&#96;\n  }\n\n  if (label.includes('ratio') || label.includes('turnover')) {\n    return formatNumberValue(value, 2)\n  }\n\n  return formatNumberValue(value, 1)\n}\n\n/**\n * Extracts years from question and returns filtered year range based on distance-based context\n * Option A: Distance-Based Context\n * - Current year (2025): Show 3 years before → [2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]\n * - Other years: Show 2 years before and 2 years after → [year-2, year-1, year, year+1, year+2]\n * - 3+ years mentioned: Show exact years only (no context)\n */",

        "contents": "/**\n * Resolve a single metric name to its canonical form\n *\n * @param input - User input (e.g., \"P/E\", \"price to earnings\", \"peRatio\")\n * @param context - Optional context for logging (e.g., user's question)\n * @returns Resolution result with canonical name and method used\n *\n * @example\n * resolveMetricName(\"P/E\") // { canonical: \"peRatio\", method: \"alias\" }\n * resolveMetricName(\"peRatio\") // { canonical: \"peRatio\", method: \"canonical\" }\n * resolveMetricName(\"pRatio\") // { canonical: \"peRatio\", method: \"fuzzy\", confidence: 0.85 }\n */\nexport async function resolveMetricName(\n  input: string,\n  context?: { question?: string }\n): Promise&lt;MetricResolution&gt; {\n  const normalized = input.toLowerCase().trim()\n\n  // 1. Check if already canonical (exact match, case-sensitive)\n  if (CANONICAL_METRICS.includes(input)) {\n    await logMetricResolution({\n      userPhrase: input,\n      resolvedTo: input,\n      method: 'canonical',\n      fuzzyScore: null,\n      userQuestion: context?.question\n    })\n    return { canonical: input, method: 'canonical' }\n  }\n\n  // 2. Check alias map (case-insensitive)\n  if (METRIC_ALIASES[normalized]) {\n    const resolved = METRIC_ALIASES[normalized]\n    await logMetricResolution({\n      userPhrase: input,\n      resolvedTo: resolved,\n      method: 'alias',\n      fuzzyScore: null,\n      userQuestion: context?.question\n    })\n    return { canonical: resolved, method: 'alias' }\n  }\n\n  // 3. Try fuzzy matching\n  const fuzzyMatch = findMostSimilar(normalized, CANONICAL_METRICS)\n\n  if (fuzzyMatch.similarity &gt;= 0.8) {\n    // 80% similarity threshold\n    await logMetricResolution({\n      userPhrase: input,\n      resolvedTo: fuzzyMatch.metric,\n      method: 'fuzzy',\n      fuzzyScore: fuzzyMatch.similarity,\n      userQuestion: context?.question\n    })\n    return {\n      canonical: fuzzyMatch.metric,\n      method: 'fuzzy',\n      confidence: fuzzyMatch.similarity\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 4. Failed to resolve\n  await logMetricResolution({\n    userPhrase: input,\n    resolvedTo: null,\n    method: null,\n    fuzzyScore: fuzzyMatch.similarity,\n    fuzzyMatch: fuzzyMatch.metric,\n    userQuestion: context?.question\n  })\n\n  return { canonical: null, method: null }\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolve multiple metric names at once\n *\n * @param inputs - Array of user inputs\n * @param context - Optional context for logging\n * @returns Object with resolved and unresolved metric names\n *\n * @example\n * resolveMetricNames([\"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"])\n * // { resolved: [\"peRatio\", \"returnOnEquity\", \"debtEquityRatio\"], unresolved: [] }\n */",

        "contents": "async function exportMetricsCatalog() {\n\n  overviewSheet.getCell(1, 6).value = 'Available Years'\n\n  // Set column widths\n  overviewSheet.getColumn(1).width = 28\n  overviewSheet.getColumn(2).width = 20\n  overviewSheet.getColumn(3).width = 12\n  overviewSheet.getColumn(4).width = 60\n  overviewSheet.getColumn(5).width = 16\n  overviewSheet.getColumn(6).width = 16\n\n  // Write metrics directly to cells (preserves template formatting)\n  allMetrics.forEach((metric, index) =&gt; {\n    const rowNum = index + 2 // Start from row 2 (row 1 is headers)\n    overviewSheet.getCell(rowNum, 1).value = metric.name\n    overviewSheet.getCell(rowNum, 2).value = metric.category\n    overviewSheet.getCell(rowNum, 3).value = metric.isCalculated ? 'Calculated' : 'Raw'\n    overviewSheet.getCell(rowNum, 4).value = metric.description\n    overviewSheet.getCell(rowNum, 5).value = metric.unit\n    overviewSheet.getCell(rowNum, 6).value = metric.availableYears\n\n    // Wrap text for description column\n    overviewSheet.getCell(rowNum, 4).alignment = { vertical: 'top', wrapText: true }\n  })\n\n  // Freeze header row\n  overviewSheet.views = [{ state: 'frozen', xSplit: 0, ySplit: 1 }]\n\n  // ==========================================\n  // Save File\n  // ==========================================\n  const filename = &#96;exports/aapl-metrics-catalog-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx&#96;\n\n  // Add raw metrics\n  rawMetrics.forEach((metric) =&gt; {\n    rawSheet.addRow({\n      name: metric.name,\n      field: metric.databaseField,\n      category: metric.category,\n      description: metric.description,\n      unit: metric.unit,\n      dataType: metric.dataType,\n    })\n  })\n\n  // Wrap text in data rows\n  rawSheet.eachRow((row, rowNumber) =&gt; {\n    if (rowNumber &gt; 1) {\n      row.eachCell((cell) =&gt; {\n        cell.alignment = { vertical: 'top', wrapText: true }\n      })\n    }\n  })\n\n  // ==========================================\n  // SHEET 3: Calculated Metrics\n  // ==========================================\n  console.log('\\n📝 Creating Calculated Metrics sheet (cloning template formatting)...')\n  const calcSheet = cloneSheet(workbook, templateSheet, 'Calculated Metrics')\n  calcSheet.views = [{ state: 'frozen', xSplit: 0, ySplit: 1 }]\n}",

        "contents": "function generateHTMLReport(results: EvaluationResults): string {\n\n  const errorCategoryFilters = failedCategories.map(cat =&gt;\n    &#96;&lt;button class=\"filter-btn\" &#96;&lt;button class=\"filter-btn\" onclick=\"filterVariationsByCategory('${cat}')\" data-category=\"${cat}\"&gt;${cat}&lt;/button&gt;&#96;\n  ).join('')\n\n  const avgLatency = results.results.reduce((sum, r) =&gt; sum + r.routing_latency_ms, 0) / results.results.length\n\n  return &#96;\n&lt;!DOCTYPE html&gt;\n&lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n&lt;head&gt;\n  &lt;meta charset=\"UTF-8\"&gt;\n  &lt;meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0\"&gt;\n  &lt;title&gt;Evaluation Report - ${new -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;\n      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);\n      min-height: 100vh;\n      padding: 40px 20px;\n      color: #2d3748;\n    }\n\n    .container {\n      max-width: 1200px;\n      margin: 0 auto;\n      background: white;\n      border-radius: 16px;\n      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);\n      overflow: hidden;\n    }\n\n    .header {\n      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);\n      color: white;\n      padding: 40px;\n      text-align: center;\n    }\n\n    .header h1 {\n      font-size: 32px;\n      font-weight: 700;\n      margin-bottom: 8px;\n    }\n\n    .header .subtitle {\n      font-size: 16px;\n      opacity:         "contents": "/**\n * Metric Metadata - Manually Curated Descriptions and Aliases\n *\n * This file contains human-readable descriptions and common aliases for all financial metrics.\n * It's the ONLY manually-maintained file for metric metadata.\n *\n * Update this file when:\n * - New metrics are added to the database\n * - Better descriptions are needed\n * - New aliases are discovered from user queries (check metric_resolutions table)\n */\n\nexport interface MetricMetadata {\n  description: string\n  unit: 'ratio' | 'percentage' | 'currency' | 'number' | 'days'\n  commonAliases: string[]\n}\n\n/**\n * Comprehensive metadata for all 50 financial metrics\n * Organized alphabetically by metric name\n */",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "/**",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./docs/METRIC_DISCOVERY_EXECUTION_PLAN.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 31
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Metric Discovery &amp; Execution Plan\n\n## Goal\nExpose all 139 financial metrics through one reliable tool call while giving both humans and the LLM an easy way to discover what’s available. We accomplish this with two complementary layers:\n\n1. **Discovery Layer (Catalog)** – Teach the model/UI what metrics exist before it makes a request.\n2. **Execution Layer (Alias + Multi-metric Resolver)** – Translate whatever phrase the caller uses into the canonical metric keys that Supabase expects.\n\n## 1. Discovery Layer (Catalog)\n### Purpose\nProvide a read-only endpoint (or static JSON) that lists every metric, its canonical key, category, units, definition, and example usage. The LLM or UI can browse this catalog to understand what’s available before calling the tool.\n\n### Why it matters\n- **Discoverability:** The current prompt only lists nine metrics; the catalog shows all 139 grouped by Valuation, Profitability, Growth, etc.\n- **Grounding:** Definitions and units prevent confusion about what each metric represents.\n- **Better tool picks:** The LLM can consult the catalog to pick the right key instead of guessing names from memory.\n\n### Implementation outline\n1. Export the canonical metric list from &#96;financial_metrics&#96; (name, category, description, units).\n2. Store it as &#96;metrics_catalog.json&#96; or serve via a simple &#96;GET /metrics/catalog&#96; endpoint.\n3. Update the router prompt to mention &#96;listMetrics&#96; (or similar) as a read-only tool.\n4. Encourage the LLM to call &#96;listMetrics&#96; when it needs clarification (“Which debt ratios do you know?”).\n\n## 2. Execution Layer (Alias &amp; Multi-Metric Resolver)\n### Purpose\nOnce the model chooses a metric, ensure the request succeeds even if the phrasing isn’t exact, and support multiple metrics in one call.\n\n### Components\n- **Alias map:** Dictionary that maps natural language names and abbreviations (\"price to earnings\", \"p/e\") to canonical keys (&#96;peRatio&#96;).\n- **Similarity fallback:** If no alias exists, use a lightweight similarity check (embeddings or Levenshtein) to pick the closest canonical name.\n- **Plural support:** Allow &#96;metricNames: string[]&#96; so one tool call can fetch multiple metrics.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Metric Discovery &amp; Execution Plan",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Goal",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "Expose all 139 financial metrics through one reliable tool call while giving both humans and the LLM an easy way to discover what’s available. We accomplish this with two complementary layers:",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },

            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Discovery Layer (Catalog)** – Teach the model/UI what metrics exist before it makes a request.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Execution Layer (Alias + Multi-metric Resolver)** – Translate whatever phrase the caller uses into the canonical metric keys that Supabase expects.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. Discovery Layer (Catalog)",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "### Purpose",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Provide a read-only endpoint (or static JSON) that lists every metric, its canonical key, category, units, definition, and example usage. The LLM or UI can browse this catalog to understand what’s available before calling the tool.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### Why it matters",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Discoverability:** The current prompt only lists nine metrics; the catalog shows all 139 grouped by Valuation, Profitability, Growth, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Grounding:** Definitions and units prevent confusion about what each metric represents.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Better tool picks:** The LLM can consult the catalog to pick the right key instead of guessing names from memory.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### Implementation outline",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Export the canonical metric list from &#96;financial_metrics&#96; (name, category, description, units).",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Store it as &#96;metrics_catalog.json&#96; or serve via a simple &#96;GET /metrics/catalog&#96; endpoint.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Update the router prompt to mention &#96;listMetrics&#96; (or similar) as a read-only tool.",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Encourage the LLM to call &#96;listMetrics&#96; when it needs clarification (“Which debt ratios do you know?”).",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. Execution Layer (Alias &amp; Multi-Metric Resolver)",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### Purpose",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "Once the model chooses a metric, ensure the request succeeds even if the phrasing isn’t exact, and support multiple metrics in one call.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### Components",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Alias map:** Dictionary that maps natural language names and abbreviations (\"price to earnings\", \"p/e\") to canonical keys (&#96;peRatio&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Similarity fallback:** If no alias exists, use a lightweight similarity check (embeddings or Levenshtein) to pick the closest canonical name.",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Plural support:** Allow &#96;metricNames: string[]&#96; so one tool call can fetch multiple metrics.",
            "lineNumber": 31

        "contents": "async function exportMetricsCatalog() {\n\n  const calcSheet = cloneSheet(workbook, templateSheet, 'Calculated Metrics')\n  calcSheet.views = [{ state: 'frozen', xSplit: 0, ySplit: 1 }]\n\n  calcSheet.columns = [\n    { header: 'Metric Name', key: 'name', width: 28 },\n    { header: 'Category', key: 'category', width: 20 },\n    { header: 'Description', key: 'description', width: 50 },\n    { header: 'Formula', key: 'formula', width: 35 },\n    { header: 'Unit', key: 'unit', width: 16 },\n  ]\n\n  // Template handles all header styling\n\n  // Add calculated metrics\n  calculatedMetrics.forEach((metric) =&gt; {\n    calcSheet.addRow({\n      name: metric.name,\n      category: metric.category,\n      description: metric.description,\n      formula: metric.formula,\n      unit: metric.unit,\n    })\n  })\n\n  // Wrap text in data rows\n  calcSheet.eachRow((row, rowNumber) =&gt; {\n    if (rowNumber &gt; 1) {\n      row.eachCell((cell) =&gt; {\n        cell.alignment = { vertical: 'top', wrapText: true }\n      })\n    }\n  })\n\n  // ==========================================\n  // SHEET 4: Metrics by Category\n  // ==========================================\n  console.log('\\n📝 Creating By Category sheet (cloning template formatting)...')\n  const categorySheet = cloneSheet(workbook, templateSheet, 'By Category')\n\n  categorySheet.getColumn(1).width = 25\n  categorySheet.getColumn(2).width = 55\n\n  // Title - template handles font styling\n  categorySheet.addRow(['AAPL Financial Metrics by Category'])\n  categorySheet.addRow([])\n\n  // Group by category\n  const categories = [\n    'Income Statement',\n    'Balance Sheet',\n    'Cash Flow Statement',\n    'Profitability Ratio',\n    'Leverage Ratio',\n    'Efficiency Ratio',\n  ]\n\n  categories.forEach((category) =&gt; {\n    const metricsInCategory = allMetrics.filter\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "CREATE TABLE metric_catalog (\n  canonical_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  -- 'peRatio'\n  display_name TEXT,  -- 'P/E Ratio'\n  category TEXT,\n  unit TEXT,  -- 'ratio', 'percentage', 'currency'\n  description TEXT\n);\n\n-- Add foreign key\nALTER TABLE financial_metrics \n  ADD CONSTRAINT fk_metric_name \n  FOREIGN KEY (metric_name) \n  REFERENCES metric_catalog(canonical_name);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 🟢 Nice-to-Have Improvements\n\n#### 8. **Add Data Quality Checks**\n**Problem**: No way to detect bad data\n\n**Solution**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Create data quality view\nCREATE VIEW data_quality_checks AS\nSELECT \n  'financials_std' as table_name,\n  symbol,\n  COUNT(*) as row_count,\n  MIN(year) as min_year,\n  MAX(year) as max_year,\n  COUNT(DISTINCT year) as unique_years,\n  SUM(CASE WHEN revenue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_revenue_count\nFROM financials_std\nGROUP BY symbol;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n#### 9. **Add Query Performance Monitoring**\n**Problem**: Don't know which queries are slow\n\n**Solution**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Enable query logging\nALTER DATABASE your_db SET log_min_duration_statement = 1000;  -- Log queries &gt; 1 second\n\n-- Or use pg_stat_statements extension\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;\n\n-- View slow queries\nSELECT \n  query,\n  calls,\n  total_time,\n  mean_time\nFROM pg_stat_statements\nORDER BY mean_time DESC\nLIMIT 10;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n#### 10. **Optimize JSON Formatting for LLM**\n**Problem**: LLM sees raw numbers like &#96;383285000000&#96; instead of formatted &#96;$383.3B&#96;\n\n**Current**: Application formats after query\n**Better**: Database function formats during query\n\n**Solution**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION format_currency_for_llm(value NUMERIC)\nRETURNS TEXT AS $$\n  SELECT CASE\n    WHEN value &gt;= 1000000000 THEN '$' || ROUND(value / 1000000000, 1) || 'B'\n    WHEN value &gt;= 1000000 THEN '$' || ROUND(value / 1000000, 1) || 'M'\n    ELSE '$' || value::TEXT\n  END;\n$$ LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE;\n\n-- Use in queries\nSELECT \n  year,\n  format_currency_for_llm(revenue) as revenue_formatted\nFROM financials_std;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Recommended Action Plan",

        "contents": "export default function LosersTable({ losers }: LosersTableProps) {\n  const formatPrice = (price: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!price &amp;&amp; price !== 0) return 'N/A'\n    return &#96;$${price.toFixed(2)}&#96;\n  }\n\n  const formatChange = (change: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!change &amp;&amp; change !== 0) return 'N/A'\n    const sign = change &gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''\n    return &#96;${sign}$${change.toFixed(2)}&#96;\n  }\n\n  const formatPercentage = (percentage: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!percentage &amp;&amp; percentage !== 0) return 'N/A'\n    const sign = percentage &gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''\n    return &#96;${sign}${percentage.toFixed(2)}%&#96;\n  }\n\n  const formatVolume = (volume: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!volume || volume === 0) {\n      return '—'\n    }\n    if (volume &gt;= 1_000_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(volume / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(1)}B&#96;\n    }\n    if (volume &gt;= 1_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(volume / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M&#96;\n    }\n    if (volume &gt;= 1_000) {\n      return &#96;${(volume / 1_000).toFixed(1)}K&#96;\n    }\n    return volume.toLocaleString()\n  }\n\n  const formatFloat = (floatShares: number | null | undefined) =&gt; {\n    if (!floatShares || floatShares === 0) {\n      return '—'\n    }\n    if (floatShares &gt;= 1_000_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(floatShares / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(1)}B&#96;\n    }\n    if (floatShares &gt;= 1_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(floatShares / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M&#96;\n    }\n    if (floatShares &gt;= 1_000) {\n      return &#96;${(floatShares / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K&#96;\n    }\n    return floatShares.toLocaleString()\n  }\n\n  if (losers.length === 0) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-3xl\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-[rgb(33,33,33)] rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-8\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400\"&gt;\n            Loading losers data...\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-3xl\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export const TOOL_MENU: ToolDefinition[] = [\n',\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'listMetrics',\n    description: 'Get catalog of all available financial metrics to discover what data is available.',\n    args: {\n      category: 'optional: Valuation | Profitability &amp; Returns | Growth | Leverage &amp; Solvency | Efficiency &amp; Working Capital | Capital Returns &amp; Share Data | Per-Share Metrics | Market Data | Other',\n    },\n    notes: 'Use this when uncertain which metrics are available or to browse metrics by category. Returns metric names, descriptions, units, and common aliases.',\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'getFinancialMetric',\n    description: 'Get advanced financial metrics including P/E ratio, ROE, debt ratios, growth rates, and 50+ other metrics.',\n    args: {\n      metricNames: 'array of metric names (canonical or common aliases like \"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\")',\n      limit: 'integer 1–20 (defaults to 5) - number of years to fetch',\n    },\n    notes: 'Supports flexible metric names via alias resolution. Use listMetrics first if uncertain about metric names. Can fetch multiple metrics in one call.',\n  },\n]\n\n// Static instructions that will be cached by OpenAI\nconst TOOL_SELECTION_STATIC_PROMPT = &#96;You are a router. Choose exactly one tool and return ONLY valid JSON: {\"tool\": string, \"args\": object}. No prose.\n\nAvailable Tools:\n\n1. getAaplFinancialsByMetric - Financial metrics as NUMBERS over time\n\n   SUPPORTED METRICS:\n\n   Raw Metrics:\n   - revenue, gross_profit, net_income, operating_income\n   - total_assets, total_liabilities, shareholders_equity\n   - operating_cash_flow, eps\n\n   Calculated Metrics (✨ Native Support):\n   - debt_to_equity_ratio  (total_liabilities / shareholders_equity)\n   - gross_margin          (gross_profit / revenue × 100)\n   - roe                   (net_income / shareholders_equity × 100)\n\n   METRIC MAPPING (with context clues):\n\n   Income/Profitability:\n   - \"sales\", \"revenue\", \"top line\" → revenue\n   - \"profit\", \"earnings\", \"bottom line\", \"profitability\" → net_income\n   - \"EPS\", \"earnings per share\" → eps\n   - \"operating profit\", \"EBIT\" → operating_income\n\n   Valuation Ratios (use getFinancialMetric tool):\n   - \"P/E ratio\", \"PE ratio\", \"price to earnings\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/E\"]\n   - \"P/B ratio\", \"price to book\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/B\"]\n   - \"PEG ratio\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"PEG\"]\n\n   Calculated Ratios (✨ NOW NATIVE - use directly):\n   - \"gross margin\", \"gross profit margin\" → gross_margin\n   - \"ROE\", \"return on equity\" → roe\n   - \"debt to equity\", \"debt-to-equity\", \"D/E ratio\", \"leverage ratio\" → debt_to_equity_ratio\n\n   Balance Sheet (Raw):\n   - \"assets\", \"total assets\" → total_assets\n   - \"liabilities\", \"total debt\", \"debt\" → total_liabilities\n   - \"equity\", \"book value\", \"shareholders equity\" → shareholders_equity\n\n   Cash Flow:\n   - \"operating cash flow\", \"cash from operations\", \"OCF\" → operating_cash_flow\n   - \"free cash flow\", \"FCF\", \"unlevered free cash flow\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\n   - \"capex\", \"capital expenditures\", \"buybacks\", \"dividends paid\", \"stock-based compensation\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool\n\n   Research &amp; Development:\n   - \"R&amp;D\", \"research and development\", \"R&amp;D spending\", \"R&amp;D expense\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"R&amp;D to revenue\"] or [\"research and development\"]\n\n   Other (use closest available):\n   - \"margins\", \"ratios\" (when not specific) → operating_income\n\n   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:\n\n   1. If question asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (2020, 2019, 2015, 2006, etc.) → limit: 20\n      Why: We have 20 years (2006-2025). To find any specific year, fetch all.\n      Examples:\n      - \"net income in 2020\" → limit: 20\n      - \"revenue for 2018\" → limit: 20\n      - \"What was EPS in 2006?\" → limit: 20\n\n   2. If question asks for a YEAR RANGE (2008 to 2020, 2015 to present, etc.) → limit: 20\n      Why: Need all data to filter to the specific range.\n      Examples:\n      - \"net income 2008 to present\" → limit: 20\n      - \"revenue from 2015 to 2020\" → limit: 20\n      - \"EPS between 2010 and 2018\" → limit: 20\n\n   3. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:\n      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3\n      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5\n      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1\n      \"10 years\" → limit: 10\n      \"20 years\" → limit: 20\n      \"2 years\" → limit: 2\n\n   4. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4\n\n   5. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 20\n\n   6. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"net income in 2006\" → limit: 20 (specific year)\n   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5 (number specified)\n   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4 (no number)\n   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 20 (all data)\n\n   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-20&gt;}\n\n2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history\n\n   ALWAYS use custom date ranges. Calculate the \"from\" date based on the user's request.\n   Today's date is {{TODAY_DATE}} (use this for calculations).\n\n   Date format: YYYY-MM-DD\n   \"to\" is optional (defaults to today)\n\n   CALCULATION EXAMPLES:\n   - \"last 7 days\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-11-01\"} (7 days ago)\n   - \"past month\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-10-08\"} (30 days ago)\n   - \"last 3 months\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-08-08\"} (90 days ago)\n   - \"past year\" → args: {\"from\": \"2024-11-08\"} (365 days ago)\n   - \"YTD\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-01-01\"} (start of current year)\n   - \"last 3 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2022-11-08\"} (3 years ago)\n   - \"past 5 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-11-08\"} (5 years ago)\n   - \"last 7 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-11-08\"} (7 years ago)\n   - \"past 10 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-11-08\"} (10 years ago)\n   - \"last 15 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2010-11-08\"} (15 years ago)\n   - \"past 20 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago)\n   - \"all time\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago, max available)\n\n   EXACT DATE RANGES:\n   - \"from Jan 2020 to June 2023\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-01-01\", \"to\": \"2023-06-30\"}\n   - \"prices between 2015 and 2020\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-01-01\", \"to\": \"2020-12-31\"}\n   - \"from March 2018 to now\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-03-01\"}\n\n   args: {\"from\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\", \"to\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\"}  (to is optional)\n\n3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata ONLY\n\n   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool returns ONLY metadata (filing type, date, URL).\n   It does NOT return filing CONTENT or text.\n\n   Use ONLY when:\n   - User wants to know WHEN filings were submitted\n   - User wants to know WHICH filings exist\n   - User wants filing dates/types/URLs\n\n   DO NOT USE when:\n   - User asks WHAT the filing says\n   - User wants content, quotes, or information FROM the filing\n   - User asks about topics like risks, strategy, etc.\n   → Use searchFilings instead for content questions!\n\n   LIMIT RULES:\n\n   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number\n      \"last 3 filings\" → limit: 3\n      \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1\n      \"2 years of filings\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)\n\n   2. If question says \"recent\", \"latest\" (no number) → limit: 5\n\n   3. If question says \"all\", \"available\", \"history\" → limit: 10\n\n   Examples (metadata questions):\n   - \"when was the most recent filing?\" → limit: 1\n   - \"what filings do you have?\" → limit: 5\n   - \"show me filing dates\" → limit: 5\n\n   args: {\"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}\n\n4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content (for WHAT they say)\n\n   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Use this when user asks about CONTENT, not just dates!\n\n   Use for ANY question about WHAT the filings say:\n   - Risk factors, strategy, operations, business model\n   - Management commentary, outlook, quotes\n   - Products, markets, competition\n   - Governance, compensation\n   - ANY question asking \"what did they say\", \"provide quotes\", etc.\n\n   Even if they mention \"latest 10-K\" or specific filing:\n   - \"What are risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → USE searchFilings\n   - \"What does the 10-K say about AI?\" → USE searchFilings\n   - \"Provide quotes from recent filing\" → USE searchFilings\n\n   QUERY RULES:\n   - Extract key terms from user's question\n   - Keep it simple (1-3 words usually best)\n   - Don't need full sentences\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"What are the risk factors?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"What about risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"Tell me about competition\" → {\"query\": \"competition\", \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"Provide quotes about AI strategy\" → {\"query\": \"AI strategy\", \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone?\" → {\"query\": \"iPhone\", \"limit\": 5}\n\n   args: {\"query\": \"&lt;keywords&gt;\", \"limit\": 5}\n\n5. listMetrics - DISCOVER available financial metrics\n\n   Use when:\n   - User asks \"what metrics do you have?\"\n   - User wants to browse metrics by category\n   - Uncertain which metric name to use for getFinancialMetric\n\n   CATEGORY FILTER (optional):\n   - Valuation: P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, market cap, etc.\n   - Profitability &amp; Returns: ROE, ROA, ROIC, margins\n   - Growth: revenue growth, EPS growth, asset growth\n   - Leverage &amp; Solvency: debt ratios, liquidity ratios\n   - Efficiency &amp; Working Capital: turnover ratios, cycle days\n   - Capital Returns &amp; Share Data: dividend yield, payout ratio\n   - Per-Share Metrics: EPS, book value per share, cash per share\n   - Market Data: stock metrics, valuation metrics\n   - Other: miscellaneous metrics\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"What valuation metrics do you have?\" → {\"category\": \"Valuation\"}\n   - \"Show me all metrics\" → {} (no category)\n   - \"What debt metrics are available?\" → {\"category\": \"Leverage &amp; Solvency\"}\n\n   args: {\"category\": \"&lt;optional category name&gt;\"}\n\n6. getFinancialMetric - GET advanced financial metrics (139 metrics available)\n\n   COMPLETE METRIC CATALOG (organized by category):\n\n   Valuation (11):\n   - peRatio, priceToBookRatio, priceToSalesRatio, priceToFreeCashFlowsRatio, earningsYield\n   - marketCap, enterpriseValue, evToSales, evToOperatingCashFlow, evToFreeCashFlow, freeCashFlowYield\n\n   Profitability &amp; Returns (12):\n   - grossProfitMargin, operatingProfitMargin, netProfitMargin, ebitPerRevenue, ebitdaMargin, pretaxProfitMargin\n   - returnOnEquity, returnOnAssets, returnOnCapitalEmployed, roic, ebtPerEbit, netIncomePerEBT\n\n   Growth (32):\n   - revenueGrowth, grossProfitGrowth, operatingIncomeGrowth, netIncomeGrowth, ebitgrowth\n   - epsgrowth, epsdilutedGrowth, operatingCashFlowGrowth, freeCashFlowGrowth\n   - assetGrowth, debtGrowth, inventoryGrowth, receivablesGrowth\n   - dividendsperShareGrowth, bookValueperShareGrowth, weightedAverageSharesGrowth, weightedAverageSharesDilutedGrowth\n   - rdexpenseGrowth, sgaexpensesGrowth\n   - threeYRevenueGrowthPerShare, threeYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, threeYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare\n   - threeYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, threeYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare\n   - fiveYRevenueGrowthPerShare, fiveYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, fiveYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare\n   - fiveYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, fiveYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare\n   - tenYRevenueGrowthPerShare, tenYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, tenYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare\n   - tenYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, tenYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare\n\n   Leverage &amp; Solvency (9):\n   - debtEquityRatio, debtRatio, currentRatio, quickRatio, cashRatio\n   - interestCoverage, longTermDebtToCapitalization, totalDebtToCapitalization, cashFlowToDebtRatio\n\n   Efficiency &amp; Working Capital (7):\n   - assetTurnover, fixedAssetTurnover, inventoryTurnover, receivablesTurnover, payablesTurnover\n   - cashConversionCycle, daysOfInventoryOutstanding, daysOfSalesOutstanding, daysOfPayablesOutstanding\n\n   Cash Flow (2):\n   - freeCashFlow, capitalExpenditure\n\n   Capital Returns &amp; Share Data (5):\n   - dividendYield, payoutRatio, dividendsPaid, commonStockRepurchased, numberOfShares\n\n   Per-Share Metrics (7):\n   - bookValuePerShare, cashPerShare, operatingCashFlowPerShare, freeCashFlowPerShare\n   - netIncomePerShare, revenuePerShare, tangibleBookValuePerShare\n\n   Market Data (1):\n   - stockPrice\n\n   Other (53):\n   - ebitda, stockBasedCompensation, depreciationAndAmortization, workingCapital, effectiveTaxRate\n   - marketCapitalization, enterpriseValueMultiple, enterpriseValueOverEBITDA\n   - pbRatio, pfcfRatio, pocfratio, priceBookValueRatio, priceCashFlowRatio, priceEarningsRatio\n   - priceEarningsToGrowthRatio, priceFairValue, priceSalesRatio, priceToOperatingCashFlowsRatio, ptbRatio\n   - roe, returnOnTangibleAssets\n   - researchAndDdevelopementToRevenue, salesGeneralAndAdministrativeToRevenue, stockBasedCompensationToRevenue\n   - capexPerShare, capexToDepreciation, capexToOperatingCashFlow, capexToRevenue\n   - shareholdersEquityPerShare, tangibleAssetValue, investedCapital\n   - debtToAssets, debtToEquity, netDebtToEBITDA\n   - operatingCashFlowSalesRatio, freeCashFlowOperatingCashFlowRatio\n   - cashFlowCoverageRatios, capitalExpenditureCoverageRatio, dividendPaidAndCapexCoverageRatio, shortTermCoverageRatios\n   - dividendPayoutRatio, interestDebtPerShare\n   - companyEquityMultiplier, intangiblesToTotalAssets\n   - daysOfInventoryOnHand, daysPayablesOutstanding, daysSalesOutstanding, operatingCycle\n   - incomeQuality, grahamNumber, grahamNetNet, netCurrentAssetValue\n   - averageInventory, averagePayables, averageReceivables\n   - addTotalDebt, minusCashAndCashEquivalents\n\n   METRIC NAME FLEXIBILITY:\n   - Accepts canonical names: \"peRatio\", \"returnOnEquity\", \"debtEquityRatio\"\n   - Accepts common aliases: \"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"\n   - Can handle multiple metrics in one call\n\n   LIMIT RULES (same as getAaplFinancialsByMetric):\n   - Specific year → limit: 20\n   - Number specified → use that number\n   - \"trend\", \"history\" → limit: 4\n   - \"compare\" with multiple metrics → limit: 10 (show more history for comparisons)\n   - Default → limit: 5\n\n   Examples:\n   - \"What's Apple's P/E ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\"], \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"What's the price to book ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"price to book\"], \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"Show me ROE trend\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"ROE\"], \"limit\": 4}\n   - \"What's Apple's free cash flow?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"free cash flow\"], \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"How much did Apple spend on buybacks?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"buybacks\"], \"limit\": 5}\n   - \"Show me capex trend\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"capex\"], \"limit\": 4}\n   - \"Compare P/E, ROE, and debt to equity\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"], \"limit\": 10}\n   - \"Compare P/E and ROE\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\", \"ROE\"], \"limit\": 10}\n   - \"Dividend yield for 2023\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"dividend yield\"], \"limit\": 20}\n\n   args: {\"metricNames\": [\"&lt;metric1&gt;\", \"&lt;metric2&gt;\"], \"limit\": &lt;number&gt;}\n\nTOOL SELECTION LOGIC:\n\n1. Basic financial metrics (revenue, assets, eps, etc.)? → getAaplFinancialsByMetric\n2. Advanced metrics (P/E, ROE, debt ratios, etc.)? → getFinancialMetric\n3. User asks \"what metrics available\"? → listMetrics\n4. Stock price? → getPrices\n5. Filing metadata ONLY (when/which filings)? → getRecentFilings\n6. Filing CONTENT (what they say, quotes, topics)? → searchFilings\n\n⚠️ KEY DISTINCTION for #6 vs #7:\n- \"When was the latest 10-K filed?\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)\n- \"What does the latest 10-K say about risks?\" → searchFilings (content)\n- \"Show me recent filings\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)\n- \"What are risk factors in the latest 10-K?\" → searchFilings (content)\n- \"Provide quotes from the 10-K\" → searchFilings (content)\n\nReturn ONLY JSON - examples:\n\n{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"revenue\",\"limit\":5}}\n{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"eps\",\"limit\":1}}\n{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"total_liabilities\",\"limit\":4}}\n{\"tool\":\"getPrices\",\"args\":{\"from\":\"2018-11-15\"}}\n{\"tool\":\"getPrices\",\"args\":{\"from\":\"2025-01-01\",\"to\":\"2025-11-15\"}}\n{\"tool\":\"getRecentFilings\",\"args\":{\"limit\":3}}\n{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}\n{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"AI strategy\",\"limit\":5}}\n{\"tool\":\"listMetrics\",\"args\":{\"category\":\"Valuation\"}}\n{\"tool\":\"listMetrics\",\"args\":{}}\n{\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\"],\"limit\":5}}\n{\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"ROE\",\"debt to equity\"],\"limit\":10}}\n\nCRITICAL EXAMPLES - Filing Content vs Metadata:\nQ: \"When was the latest 10-K filed?\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getRecentFilings\",\"args\":{\"limit\":1}}\n\nQ: \"What about risk factors in their latest 10k? provide quotes.\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}\n\nQ: \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone sales?\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"iPhone sales\",\"limit\":5}}\n\nQ: \"Provide quotes from the latest filing about competition\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"competition\",\"limit\":5}}\n\nCRITICAL EXAMPLES - Advanced Metrics:\nQ: \"What is AAPL's debt to equity ratio?\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"debt to equity\"],\"limit\":5}}\n\nQ: \"Show me P/E ratio trend\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\"],\"limit\":4}}\n\nQ: \"What's the ROE in 2023?\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"ROE\"],\"limit\":20}}\n\nQ: \"Compare P/E and PEG ratio\"\nA: {\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\",\"PEG\"],\"limit\":10}}&#96;",
