          },
          {
            "text": "   2. If question asks for a YEAR RANGE (2008 to 2020, 2015 to present, etc.) → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "      Why: Need all data to filter to the specific range.",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "      Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"net income 2008 to present\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"revenue from 2015 to 2020\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"EPS between 2010 and 2018\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "   3. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"10 years\" → limit: 10",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"20 years\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"2 years\" → limit: 2",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "   4. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "   5. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "   6. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"net income in 2006\" → limit: 20 (specific year)",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5 (number specified)",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 20 (all data)",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-20&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "   ALWAYS use custom date ranges. Calculate the \"from\" date based on the user's request.",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "   Today's date is {{TODAY_DATE}} (use this for calculations).",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "   Date format: YYYY-MM-DD",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "   \"to\" is optional (defaults to today)",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "   CALCULATION EXAMPLES:",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 7 days\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-11-01\"} (7 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past month\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-10-08\"} (30 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 3 months\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-08-08\"} (90 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past year\" → args: {\"from\": \"2024-11-08\"} (365 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"YTD\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-01-01\"} (start of current year)",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 3 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2022-11-08\"} (3 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 5 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-11-08\"} (5 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 7 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-11-08\"} (7 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 10 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-11-08\"} (10 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 15 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2010-11-08\"} (15 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 20 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"all time\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago, max available)",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "   EXACT DATE RANGES:",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"from Jan 2020 to June 2023\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-01-01\", \"to\": \"2023-06-30\"}",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"prices between 2015 and 2020\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-01-01\", \"to\": \"2020-12-31\"}",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"from March 2018 to now\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-03-01\"}",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"from\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\", \"to\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\"}  (to is optional)",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata ONLY",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool returns ONLY metadata (filing type, date, URL).",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "   It does NOT return filing CONTENT or text.",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use ONLY when:",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to know WHEN filings were submitted",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to know WHICH filings exist",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants filing dates/types/URLs",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "   DO NOT USE when:",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks WHAT the filing says",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants content, quotes, or information FROM the filing",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks about topics like risks, strategy, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "   → Use searchFilings instead for content questions!",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES:",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last 3 filings\" → limit: 3",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"2 years of filings\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "   2. If question says \"recent\", \"latest\" (no number) → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "   3. If question says \"all\", \"available\", \"history\" → limit: 10",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples (metadata questions):",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"when was the most recent filing?\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"what filings do you have?\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"show me filing dates\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content (for WHAT they say)",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Use this when user asks about CONTENT, not just dates!",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use for ANY question about WHAT the filings say:",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Risk factors, strategy, operations, business model",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Management commentary, outlook, quotes",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Products, markets, competition",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Governance, compensation",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ANY question asking \"what did they say\", \"provide quotes\", etc.",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "   Even if they mention \"latest 10-K\" or specific filing:",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What are risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What does the 10-K say about AI?\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Provide quotes from recent filing\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "   QUERY RULES:",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Extract key terms from user's question",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Keep it simple (1-3 words usually best)",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Don't need full sentences",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What are the risk factors?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What about risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Tell me about competition\" → {\"query\": \"competition\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Provide quotes about AI strategy\" → {\"query\": \"AI strategy\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone?\" → {\"query\": \"iPhone\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"query\": \"&lt;keywords&gt;\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "5. listMetrics - DISCOVER available financial metrics",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use when:",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks \"what metrics do you have?\"",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to browse metrics by category",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Uncertain which metric name to use for getFinancialMetric",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "   CATEGORY FILTER (optional):",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Valuation: P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, market cap, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Profitability &amp; Returns: ROE, ROA, ROIC, margins",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Growth: revenue growth, EPS growth, asset growth",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Leverage &amp; Solvency: debt ratios, liquidity ratios",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Efficiency &amp; Working Capital: turnover ratios, cycle days",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Capital Returns &amp; Share Data: dividend yield, payout ratio",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Per-Share Metrics: EPS, book value per share, cash per share",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Market Data: stock metrics, valuation metrics",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Other: miscellaneous metrics",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What valuation metrics do you have?\" → {\"category\": \"Valuation\"}",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Show me all metrics\" → {} (no category)",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What debt metrics are available?\" → {\"category\": \"Leverage &amp; Solvency\"}",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"category\": \"&lt;optional category name&gt;\"}",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "6. getFinancialMetric - GET advanced financial metrics (139 metrics available)",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "   COMPLETE METRIC CATALOG (organized by category):",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "   Valuation (11):",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "   - peRatio, priceToBookRatio, priceToSalesRatio, priceToFreeCashFlowsRatio, earningsYield",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "   - marketCap, enterpriseValue, evToSales, evToOperatingCashFlow, evToFreeCashFlow, freeCashFlowYield",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "   Profitability &amp; Returns (12):",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "   - grossProfitMargin, operatingProfitMargin, netProfitMargin, ebitPerRevenue, ebitdaMargin, pretaxProfitMargin",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "   - returnOnEquity, returnOnAssets, returnOnCapitalEmployed, roic, ebtPerEbit, netIncomePerEBT",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "   Growth (32):",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "   - revenueGrowth, grossProfitGrowth, operatingIncomeGrowth, netIncomeGrowth, ebitgrowth",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "   - epsgrowth, epsdilutedGrowth, operatingCashFlowGrowth, freeCashFlowGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "   - assetGrowth, debtGrowth, inventoryGrowth, receivablesGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendsperShareGrowth, bookValueperShareGrowth, weightedAverageSharesGrowth, weightedAverageSharesDilutedGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "   - rdexpenseGrowth, sgaexpensesGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "   - threeYRevenueGrowthPerShare, threeYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, threeYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "   - threeYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, threeYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "   - fiveYRevenueGrowthPerShare, fiveYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, fiveYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "   - fiveYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, fiveYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "   - tenYRevenueGrowthPerShare, tenYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, tenYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "   - tenYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, tenYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "   Leverage &amp; Solvency (9):",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "   - debtEquityRatio, debtRatio, currentRatio, quickRatio, cashRatio",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "   - interestCoverage, longTermDebtToCapitalization, totalDebtToCapitalization, cashFlowToDebtRatio",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "   Efficiency &amp; Working Capital (7):",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "   - assetTurnover, fixedAssetTurnover, inventoryTurnover, receivablesTurnover, payablesTurnover",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "   - cashConversionCycle, daysOfInventoryOutstanding, daysOfSalesOutstanding, daysOfPayablesOutstanding",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "   Cash Flow (2):",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "   - freeCashFlow, capitalExpenditure",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "   Capital Returns &amp; Share Data (5):",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendYield, payoutRatio, dividendsPaid, commonStockRepurchased, numberOfShares",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "   Per-Share Metrics (7):",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "   - bookValuePerShare, cashPerShare, operatingCashFlowPerShare, freeCashFlowPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "   - netIncomePerShare, revenuePerShare, tangibleBookValuePerShare",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "   Market Data (1):",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "   - stockPrice",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "   Other (53):",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ebitda, stockBasedCompensation, depreciationAndAmortization, workingCapital, effectiveTaxRate",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "   - marketCapitalization, enterpriseValueMultiple, enterpriseValueOverEBITDA",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "   - pbRatio, pfcfRatio, pocfratio, priceBookValueRatio, priceCashFlowRatio, priceEarningsRatio",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "   - priceEarningsToGrowthRatio, priceFairValue, priceSalesRatio, priceToOperatingCashFlowsRatio, ptbRatio",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "   - roe, returnOnTangibleAssets",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "   - researchAndDdevelopementToRevenue, salesGeneralAndAdministrativeToRevenue, stockBasedCompensationToRevenue",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "   - capexPerShare, capexToDepreciation, capexToOperatingCashFlow, capexToRevenue",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "   - shareholdersEquityPerShare, tangibleAssetValue, investedCapital",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "   - debtToAssets, debtToEquity, netDebtToEBITDA",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "   - operatingCashFlowSalesRatio, freeCashFlowOperatingCashFlowRatio",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "   - cashFlowCoverageRatios, capitalExpenditureCoverageRatio, dividendPaidAndCapexCoverageRatio, shortTermCoverageRatios",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendPayoutRatio, interestDebtPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "   - companyEquityMultiplier, intangiblesToTotalAssets",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "   - daysOfInventoryOnHand, daysPayablesOutstanding, daysSalesOutstanding, operatingCycle",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "   - incomeQuality, grahamNumber, grahamNetNet, netCurrentAssetValue",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "   - averageInventory, averagePayables, averageReceivables",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "   - addTotalDebt, minusCashAndCashEquivalents",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "   METRIC NAME FLEXIBILITY:",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Accepts canonical names: \"peRatio\", \"returnOnEquity\", \"debtEquityRatio\"",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Accepts common aliases: \"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Can handle multiple metrics in one call",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES (same as getAaplFinancialsByMetric):",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Specific year → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Number specified → use that number",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"trend\", \"history\" → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"compare\" with multiple metrics → limit: 10 (show more history for comparisons)",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Default → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's Apple's P/E ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's the price to book ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"price to book\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {

        "contents": "export function generateExtendedMetricChart(\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[],\n  metricName: string,\n  userQuestion?: string\n): ChartConfig | null {\n\n\n  switch (unit) {\n    case 'percentage':\n      // FMP stores percentage metrics as decimals (e.g., ROE of 1.52 = 152%, margin of 0.46 = 46%)\n      // Always multiply by 100 to convert to percentage display\n      values = validData.map(d =&gt; {\n        const val = d.metric_value!\n        return parseFloat((val * 100).toFixed(2))\n      })\n      yAxisLabel = &#96;${displayName} (%)&#96;\n      break\n\n    case 'ratio':\n      values = validData.map(d =&gt; parseFloat(d.metric_value!.toFixed(2)))\n      yAxisLabel = displayName\n      break\n\n    case 'currency':\n      // Determine scale based on magnitude\n      const maxVal = Math.max(...validData.map(d =&gt; Math.abs(d.metric_value!)))\n      if (maxVal &gt;= 1_000_000_000) {\n        values = validData.map(d =&gt; parseFloat((d.metric_value! / 1e9).toFixed(2)))\n        yAxisLabel = &#96;${displayName} ($B)&#96;\n      } else if (maxVal &gt;= 1_000_000) {\n        values = validData.map(d =&gt; parseFloat((d.metric_value! / 1e6).toFixed(2)))\n        yAxisLabel = &#96;${displayName} ($M)&#96;\n      } else {\n        values = validData.map(d =&gt; parseFloat(d.metric_value!.toFixed(2)))\n        yAxisLabel = &#96;${displayName} ($)&#96;\n      }\n      chartType = 'column' // Bar charts for currency values\n      break\n\n    case 'days':\n      values = validData.map(d =&gt; parseFloat(d.metric_value!.toFixed(1)))\n      yAxisLabel = &#96;${displayName} (days)&#96;\n      break\n\n    default: // 'number' or unknown\n      values = validData.map(d =&gt; parseFloat(d.metric_value!.toFixed(2)))\n      yAxisLabel = displayName\n  }\n\n  return {\n    type: chartType,\n    title: &#96;AAPL ${displayName} (${categories[0]}-${categories[categories.length - 1]})&#96;,\n    data: values,\n    categories,\n    yAxisLabel,\n    xAxisLabel: 'Year',\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export default function GainersTable({ gainers }: GainersTableProps) {\n  const formatPrice = (price: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!price &amp;&amp; price !== 0) return 'N/A'\n    return &#96;$${price.toFixed(2)}&#96;\n  }\n\n  const formatChange = (change: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!change &amp;&amp; change !== 0) return 'N/A'\n    const sign = change &gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''\n    return &#96;${sign}$${change.toFixed(2)}&#96;\n  }\n\n  const formatPercentage = (percentage: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!percentage &amp;&amp; percentage !== 0) return 'N/A'\n    const sign = percentage &gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''\n    return &#96;${sign}${percentage.toFixed(2)}%&#96;\n  }\n\n  const formatVolume = (volume: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!volume || volume === 0) {\n      return '—'\n    }\n    if (volume &gt;= 1_000_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(volume / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(1)}B&#96;\n    }\n    if (volume &gt;= 1_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(volume / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M&#96;\n    }\n    if (volume &gt;= 1_000) {\n      return &#96;${(volume / 1_000).toFixed(1)}K&#96;\n    }\n    return volume.toLocaleString()\n  }\n\n  const formatFloat = (floatShares: number | null | undefined) =&gt; {\n    if (!floatShares || floatShares === 0) {\n      return '—'\n    }\n    if (floatShares &gt;= 1_000_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(floatShares / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(1)}B&#96;\n    }\n    if (floatShares &gt;= 1_000_000) {\n      return &#96;${(floatShares / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M&#96;\n    }\n    if (floatShares &gt;= 1_000) {\n      return &#96;${(floatShares / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K&#96;\n    }\n    return floatShares.toLocaleString()\n  }\n\n  if (gainers.length === 0) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-3xl\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-[rgb(33,33,33)] rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-8\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400\"&gt;\n            Loading gainers data...\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-3xl\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "- Client-side polling every 10s during market hours\n- Pause polling when market closed\n- Optimistic UI updates\n\n---\n\n### Section 2: Quick Stats Grid (Finviz-Style)\n\n**Layout:**\n- Dense 3-4 column grid\n- Each cell: Label | Value\n- Compact, information-dense design\n- No cards, just clean table-like structure\n\n**Metrics (20-30 key stats):**\n\n**Column 1: Valuation**\n- Market Cap\n- Enterprise Value\n- P/E Ratio\n- Forward P/E\n- PEG Ratio\n- P/S Ratio\n- P/B Ratio\n- Price/Cash Flow\n\n**Column 2: Performance**\n- 52-Week High\n- 52-Week Low\n- YTD Return\n- 1-Year Return\n- 3-Year CAGR\n- 5-Year CAGR\n- Beta\n- Average Volume\n\n**Column 3: Profitability**\n- Gross Margin\n- Operating Margin\n- Net Margin\n- ROE\n- ROA\n- ROIC\n- Revenue (TTM)\n- Net Income (TTM)\n\n**Column 4: Financial Health**\n- Debt-to-Equity\n- Current Ratio\n- Quick Ratio\n- Operating Cash Flow\n- Free Cash Flow\n- Dividend Yield\n- Payout Ratio\n- EPS (TTM)\n\n**Data Sources:**\n- &#96;financial_metrics&#96; table (latest year for all ratios)\n- &#96;financials_std&#96; table (latest year for core metrics)\n- FMP API (52-week high/low, volume, current metrics)\n\n**Formatting:**\n- $ values: B/M suffixes (e.g., \"$383.3B\")\n- % values: 2 decimals (e.g., \"28.5%\")\n- Ratios: 2 decimals (e.g., \"1.25\")\n- Color coding: Green/red for positive/negative values where applicable\n\n---\n\n### Section 3: Price Chart\n\n**Layout:**\n- Full-width interactive chart\n- Timeframe selector above chart: [1D] [5D] [1M] [3M] [6M] [1Y] [5Y] [MAX]\n- Chart type toggle: [Line] [Candlestick] [Area]\n- Volume bars below main chart\n\n**Features:**\n- Zoom/pan\n- Crosshair tooltip with OHLCV data\n- Responsive design\n- Dark/light theme support\n\n**Data Sources:**\n- &#96;getPrices()&#96; server action (FMP API)\n- Date ranges: from/to parameters based on selected timeframe\n\n**Implementation:**\n- Reuse/extend &#96;FinancialChart.tsx&#96; component\n- Add candlestick chart type support via Highcharts\n- Client-side state for timeframe/chart type selection\n\n---\n\n### Section 4: Financials Tables\n\n**Layout:**\n- Three separate tables, stacked vertically\n- Each table: Rows = Metrics, Columns = Years (2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- Client-side polling every 10s during market hours",

        "contents": "export default function FinancialsModal({ isOpen, onClose }: FinancialsModalProps) {\n  const [companies, setCompanies] = useState&lt;CompanyWithFinancials[] | null&gt;(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null)\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (isOpen &amp;&amp; !companies) {\n      loadFinancials()\n    }\n  }, [isOpen])\n\n  const loadFinancials = async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true)\n    setError(null)\n    const result = await getCompaniesWithFinancials()\n    if (result.error) {\n      setError(result.error)\n    } else {\n      setCompanies(result.data)\n    }\n    setLoading(false)\n  }\n\n  if (!isOpen) return null\n\n  // Get the first company (AAPL) for display\n  const company = companies?.[0]\n  const financials = company?.financials_std || []\n\n  // Get last 3 years only (descending for display)\n  const years = [...financials]\n    .sort((a, b) =&gt; b.year - a.year)\n    .slice(0, 3)\n    .map(f =&gt; f.year)\n\n  // Filter financials to only include those 3 years\n  const filteredFinancials = financials.filter(f =&gt; years.includes(f.year))\n\n  // Sort by year ascending for proper sparkline direction\n  const sortedFinancials = [...filteredFinancials].sort((a, b) =&gt; a.year - b.year)\n\n  // Helper to get value for a specific year\n  const getValue = (year: number, field: keyof FinancialRow): number | null =&gt; {\n    const record = financials.find(f =&gt; f.year === year)\n    return record ? (record[field] as number | null) : null\n  }\n\n\n  // Metric row component\n  const MetricRow = (\n\n}",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Stock Detail Page Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nCreate a comprehensive stock detail page at &#96;/stock/AAPL&#96; that displays all financial data, price charts, SEC filings, key metrics, and AI-powered insights in a single scrollable page (similar to finviz.com). This will serve as the primary destination for deep-dive stock analysis.\n\n**Status**: Planning\n**Priority**: High\n**Target**: AAPL-only MVP (no multi-stock expansion planned)\n\n---\n\n## Goals\n\n1. **Provide comprehensive stock information** in a single scrollable page with dense information architecture\n2. **Leverage existing AI capabilities** for natural language financial analysis\n3. **Reuse existing data infrastructure** (financials_std, financial_metrics, filings, prices)\n4. **Create finviz-style experience** with all metrics visible at a glance\n5. **Differentiate from competitors** through AI-first interface and grounded answers\n\n---\n\n## Page Structure\n\n### URL Pattern\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/stock/AAPL           # Single stock page for Apple (only AAPL supported)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Layout Hierarchy (Single Scrollable Page)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ Navigation Bar (existing)                                   │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ SECTION 1: Stock Header                                     │\n│ - Company Name, Symbol, Sector                              │\n│ - Current Price (real-time updates)                         │\n│ - Price Change ($ and %)                                    │\n│ - Market Status (Open/Closed/Pre-market/After-hours)        │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ SECTION 2: Quick Stats Grid (finviz-style)                  │",

        "contents": "### Existing Server Actions (No Changes Needed)\n\n- &#96;getPrices()&#96; - Already supports AAPL, custom date ranges\n- &#96;getRecentFilings()&#96; - Already supports AAPL\n- &#96;searchFilings()&#96; - Already supports AAPL\n- &#96;askQuestion()&#96; - Already supports AAPL (hardcoded)\n\n---\n\n## Data Fetching Strategy\n\n### Initial Page Load (Server Component)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// app/stock/aapl/page.tsx\nexport default async function StockPage() {\n  // Parallel data fetching\n  const [overview, keyStats, financials, metrics, filings] = await Promise.all([\n    getStockOverview(),\n    getStockKeyStats(),\n    getAllFinancials(),\n    getAllMetrics(),\n    getRecentFilings('AAPL', 20) // Last 20 filings\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div&gt;\n      &lt;StockHeader {...overview} /&gt;\n      &lt;QuickStatsGrid stats={keyStats} /&gt;\n      &lt;StockPriceChart initialData={[]} /&gt; {/* Fetch client-side for interactivity */}\n      &lt;FinancialsSection data={financials} /&gt;\n      &lt;MetricsGrid metrics={metrics} /&gt;\n      &lt;FilingsSection filings={filings} /&gt;\n      &lt;AIInsightsPanel symbol=\"AAPL\" /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}\n\n// ISR with 60s revalidation\nexport const revalidate = 60;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client-Side Data Fetching\n\n**Price Chart:**\n- Default: Load 7D data on mount\n- On timeframe change: Fetch new data via &#96;getPrices()&#96;\n\n**Real-time Price:**\n- Poll &#96;getStockOverview()&#96; every 10s during market hours\n- Update header price display\n\n**AI Chat:**\n- Fetch answers via &#96;askQuestion()&#96; on user input\n- Stream responses using existing implementation\n\n---\n\n## UI/UX Design Decisions\n\n### 1. Single Page Scroll vs Tabs\n\n**Decision**: Single scrollable page (no tabs)\n\n**Rationale:**\n- Finviz-style dense information display\n- Faster information scanning (no clicking required)\n- Better for power users who want to see everything\n- Simpler implementation (no tab state management)\n- Better SEO (all content rendered on page)\n\n**Trade-offs:**\n- Longer initial page load (more data)\n- May be overwhelming for casual users\n- Larger bundle size\n\n**Mitigations:**\n- Use ISR to pre-render server-side (fast TTFB)\n- Lazy load images and charts below fold\n- Skeleton loaders for each section",

        "contents": "**Layout Option B (Bottom Section - All Devices):**\n- Full-width section at bottom of page\n- Always visible on scroll\n- Horizontal layout on desktop, vertical on mobile\n\n**Recommended: Option B** (simpler, works on all devices)\n\n**Content:**\n- **Header**: \"Ask AI about AAPL\"\n- **Pre-populated Questions** (clickable chips):\n  - \"What's the revenue trend over the last 5 years?\"\n  - \"How has gross margin changed?\"\n  - \"What are the biggest risks in the latest 10-K?\"\n  - \"Compare ROE to historical average\"\n  - \"Why did net income decrease in 2024?\"\n\n- **Chat Input**: Text field with \"Ask a question...\" placeholder\n- **Recent Answers** (if any): Show last 2-3 Q&amp;A pairs\n\n**Interactions:**\n- Click pre-populated question → Send to chatbot, show answer\n- Type custom question → Send, show streaming answer\n- \"Ask AI\" buttons throughout page → Scroll to this section + pre-fill question\n\n**Data Sources:**\n- All existing server actions (financials, metrics, prices, filings, search)\n- &#96;conversations&#96; and &#96;messages&#96; tables for history\n\n**Implementation:**\n- Reuse &#96;AssistantChat.tsx&#96; component\n- Embed in stock page (not sidebar like homepage)\n- Pass hardcoded symbol: 'AAPL'\n\n---\n\n## Component Architecture\n\n### New Components\n\n**1. &#96;app/stock/aapl/page.tsx&#96;**\n- Main page component (Server Component)\n- Fetches all initial data in parallel\n- Renders all sections in single scrollable layout\n- No tabs, no client-side routing\n\n**2. &#96;components/stock/StockHeader.tsx&#96;**\n- Section 1: Header with price, company info, market status\n- Client component with real-time price polling\n- Props: company, currentPrice, priceChange, marketStatus\n\n**3. &#96;components/stock/QuickStatsGrid.tsx&#96;**\n- Section 2: Dense grid of 20-30 key metrics\n- Server component (pre-rendered with ISR)\n- Props: stats (object with all key metrics)\n\n**4. &#96;components/stock/StockPriceChart.tsx&#96;**\n- Section 3: Interactive price chart\n- Client component with timeframe/chart type state\n- Wraps &#96;FinancialChart.tsx&#96; with candlestick support\n- Props: initialData (7D default)\n\n**5. &#96;components/stock/FinancialsSection.tsx&#96;**",

(\n                                    &lt;td key={idx} className=\"px-3 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-base text-center text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 font-mono\"&gt;\n                                      ${(row.value / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(1)}B\n                                    &lt;/td&gt;\n                                  ))}\n                                &lt;/tr&gt;\n                              &lt;/tbody&gt;\n                            &lt;/table&gt;\n                          &lt;/div&gt;\n                        &lt;/div&gt;\n                      )\n                    })()}\n\n                    {/* Data table for financial_metrics type */}\n                    {message.dataUsed &amp;&amp; ## What I've done:

1. **Added a Financial Metrics section** that displays all 139+ metrics organized by category:

   - Leverage & Solvency

   - Growth Metrics

        "contents": "/**\n * Get multiple metrics for a single year (useful for comparisons)\n * NOW WITH ALIAS SUPPORT - accepts flexible metric names\n *\n * @example\n * getFinancialMetrics({\n *   symbol: 'AAPL',\n *   metricNames: ['P/E', 'ROE', 'debt to equity'], // Aliases work!\n *   limit: 5\n * })\n */\nexport async function getFinancialMetrics(params: {\n  symbol: string\n  metricNames: string[] // Array of metric names (canonical OR aliases)\n  year?: number\n  yearStart?: number\n  yearEnd?: number\n  limit?: number // Number of years per metric (default: 5, max: 20)\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[] | null\n  error: string | null\n  unresolved?: string[] // Metrics that couldn't be resolved\n}&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 1. Resolve all metric names (aliases → canonical)\n    const { resolved, unresolved } = await resolveMetricNames(params.metricNames)\n\n    // 2. If any metrics couldn't be resolved, return error with suggestions\n    if (unresolved.length &gt; 0) {\n      return {\n        data: null,\n        error: &#96;Could not resolve these metrics: ${unresolved.join(', ')}. Use listMetrics to see available metrics.&#96;,\n        unresolved\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 3. Query database with resolved canonical names\n    const supabase = await createServerClient()\n\n    let query = supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .select('year, metric_name, metric_value, metric_category, data_source')\n      .eq('symbol', params.symbol)\n      .in('metric_name', resolved) // Use resolved canonical names\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n      .order('metric_name', { ascending: true })\n\n    // 4. Apply year filters\n    if (params.year) {\n      query = query.eq('year', params.year)\n    } else {\n      if (params.yearStart) {\n        query = query.gte('year', params.yearStart)\n      }\n      if (params.yearEnd) {\n        query = query.lte('year', params.yearEnd)\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 5. Apply limit (default: 5 years per metric, max: 20)\n    const limit = Math.min(params.limit || 5, 20)\n    query = query.limit(limit * resolved.length)\n\n    const { data, error } = await query\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('[getFinancialMetrics] Error:', error)\n      return { data: null, error: error.message }\n    }\n\n    return { data, error: null }\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    console.error('[getFinancialMetrics] Exception:', err)\n    return { data: null, error: err.message }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Search metrics by category (e.g., all \"Valuation\" metrics)\n */\nexport async function getMetricsByCategory(params: {\n  symbol: string\n  category: string // 'Valuation', 'Profitability &amp; Returns', 'Growth', etc.\n  year?: number\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[] | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Get all financial metrics grouped by category for the last 5 years\n * Returns data for current year, 1Y ago, 3Y ago, and 5Y ago\n * Currently hardcoded to AAPL\n */\nexport async function getAllMetrics(): Promise&lt;AllMetrics&gt; {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient();\n\n    // Get current year\n    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();\n    const targetYears = [\n      &#96;${currentYear}-01-01&#96;,      // Current (approximate)\n      &#96;${currentYear - 1}-01-01&#96;,  // 1Y ago\n      &#96;${currentYear - 3}-01-01&#96;,  // 3Y ago\n      &#96;${currentYear - 5}-01-01&#96;,  // 5Y ago\n    ];\n\n    // Fetch all metrics for relevant years (key-value format)\n    const { data: metricsData, error } = await supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .select('metric_name, metric_value, year')\n      .eq('symbol', 'AAPL')\n      .order('year', { ascending: false });\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching metrics:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (!metricsData || metricsData.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        valuation: [],\n        profitability: [],\n        leverage: [],\n        efficiency: [],\n        growth: [],\n        perShare: [],\n        capitalReturns: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Group metrics by year\n    const metricsByYear = new Map&lt;number, Map&lt;string, number&gt;&gt;();\n    metricsData.forEach((row) =&gt; {\n      if (!metricsByYear.has(row.year)) {\n        metricsByYear.set(row.year, new Map());\n      }\n      metricsByYear.get(row.year)!.set(row.metric_name, row.metric_value);\n    });\n\n    // Get sorted years\n    const sortedYears = Array.from(metricsByYear.keys()).sort((a, b) =&gt; b - a);\n\n    // Helper function to get metric value by year offset\n    const getMetricValue = (metricKey: string, yearOffset: number): number =&gt; {\n      const targetYearIndex = Math.min(yearOffset, sortedYears.length - 1);\n      if (targetYearIndex &lt; 0) return 0;\n\n      const year = sortedYears[targetYearIndex];\n      const yearMetrics = metricsByYear.get(year);\n      return yearMetrics?.get(metricKey) || 0;\n    };\n\n    // Helper function to transform category metrics\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getFinancialMetric(\n  params: FinancialMetricParams\n): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[] | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient()\n\n    // Build query\n    let query = supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .select('year, metric_name, metric_value, metric_category, data_source')\n      .eq('symbol', params.symbol)\n      .eq('metric_name', params.metricName)\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n\n    // Apply year filters\n    if (params.yearStart) {\n      query = query.gte('year', params.yearStart)\n    }\n    if (params.yearEnd) {\n      query = query.lte('year', params.yearEnd)\n    }\n\n    // Apply limit (default 10, max 20)\n    const limit = Math.min(params.limit || 10, 20)\n    query = query.limit(limit)\n\n    const { data, error } = await query\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('[getFinancialMetric] Error:', error)\n      return { data: null, error: error.message }\n    }\n\n    return { data, error: null }\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    console.error('[getFinancialMetric] Exception:', err)\n    return { data: null, error: err.message }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Get multiple metrics for a single year (useful for comparisons)\n * NOW WITH ALIAS SUPPORT - accepts flexible metric names\n *\n * @example\n * getFinancialMetrics({\n *   symbol: 'AAPL',\n *   metricNames: ['P/E', 'ROE', 'debt to equity'], // Aliases work!\n *   limit: 5\n * })\n */",

        "contents": "async function fetchFMPData() {\n  console.log('📊 Fetching financial metrics from FMP API...\\\\n')\n\n  const endpoints = {\n    keyMetrics: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/key-metrics/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    ratios: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/ratios/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    growth: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/financial-growth/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    enterpriseValue: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/enterprise-values/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    incomeStatement: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/income-statement/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n    cashFlowStatement: &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/cash-flow-statement/${SYMBOL}?period=annual&amp;limit=20&amp;apikey=${FMP_API_KEY}&#96;,\n  }\n\n  // Fetch all endpoints in parallel\n  const [keyMetrics, ratios, growth, enterpriseValues, incomeStatements, cashFlowStatements] = await Promise.all([\n    fetch(endpoints.keyMetrics).then((r) =&gt; r.json()) as Promise&lt;FMPKeyMetrics[]&gt;,\n    fetch(endpoints.ratios).then((r) =&gt; r.json()) as Promise&lt;FMPRatios[]&gt;,\n    fetch(endpoints.growth).then((r) =&gt; r.json()) as Promise&lt;FMPGrowth[]&gt;,\n    fetch(endpoints.enterpriseValue).then((r) =&gt; r.json()) as Promise&lt;FMPEnterpriseValue[]&gt;,\n    fetch(endpoints.incomeStatement).then((r) =&gt; r.json()) as Promise&lt;FMPIncomeStatement[]&gt;,\n    fetch(endpoints.cashFlowStatement).then((r) =&gt; r.json()) as Promise&lt;FMPCashFlowStatement[]&gt;,\n  ])\n\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Key Metrics: ${keyMetrics.length} years&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Ratios: ${ratios.length} years&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Growth: ${growth.length} years&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Enterprise Values: ${enterpriseValues.length} years&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Income Statements: ${incomeStatements.length} years&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;✅ Cash Flow Statements: ${cashFlowStatements.length} years\\\\n&#96;)\n\n  // Transform to key-value format\n  const metrics: MetricRecord[] = []\n}",

        "contents": "# Financial Metrics System - Implementation Summary\n\n**Branch:** &#96;feature/add-financial-metrics&#96;\n**Date:** 2025-11-06\n**Status:** ✅ **Phase 1 Complete** (Database + Data Loading)\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 What We Built\n\nAdded **139 financial metrics** from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API to the Supabase database, expanding beyond the original 9 metrics to include comprehensive valuation, profitability, growth, and leverage ratios.\n\n---\n\n## ✅ Completed\n\n### 1. Database Schema\n\n**Table:** &#96;financial_metrics&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE financial_metrics (\n  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,\n  year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  period TEXT, -- 'FY', 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'\n  metric_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  metric_value NUMERIC,\n  metric_category TEXT,\n  data_source TEXT DEFAULT 'FMP',\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n  CONSTRAINT unique_metric_per_period UNIQUE (symbol, year, period, metric_name)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Indexes:**\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year&#96; - Fast lookup by company/year\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_metric_name&#96; - Fast lookup by metric\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_category&#96; - Fast category queries\n- &#96;idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year_metric&#96; - Composite for specific queries\n\n**RLS:** Public read access enabled\n\n---\n\n### 2. Data Coverage\n\n| Metric | Count | Description |\n|--------|-------|-------------|\n| **Total Records** | 2,780 | All metrics across all years |\n| **Unique Metrics** | 139 | Distinct metric types |\n| **Years Covered** | 2006-2025 | 20 years of data |\n| **Symbol** | AAPL | Apple Inc. (MVP) |\n\n---\n\n### 3. Metrics by Category\n\n| Category | Records | Example Metrics |\n|----------|---------|----------------|\n| **Valuation** | 77 | P/E Ratio, P/B Ratio, EV/EBITDA, Market Cap |\n| **Profitability &amp; Returns** | 77 | ROE, ROA, ROIC, Gross Margin, Net Margin |\n| **Growth** | 240 | Revenue Growth, EPS Growth, 3Y/5Y/10Y CAGRs |\n| **Leverage &amp; Solvency** | 67 | Debt-to-Equity, Current Ratio, Quick Ratio |\n| **Efficiency &amp; Working Capital** | 68 | Asset Turnover, Inventory Turnover, Cash Conversion Cycle |\n| **Per-Share Metrics** | 51 | Book Value per Share, FCF per Share, Revenue per Share |",

        "contents": "# Database Structure &amp; Chatbot Optimization Guide\n\n## Current Database Structure\n\n### Core Tables for Chatbot\n\n#### 1. &#96;financials_std&#96; - Standard Financial Data (Wide Table)\n**Purpose**: Stores basic financial metrics in columns (one row per year)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nColumns:\n- symbol (TEXT) - Stock ticker (e.g., 'AAPL')\n- year (INTEGER) - Fiscal year\n- revenue (NUMERIC)\n- gross_profit (NUMERIC)\n- net_income (NUMERIC)\n- operating_income (NUMERIC)\n- total_assets (NUMERIC)\n- total_liabilities (NUMERIC)\n- shareholders_equity (NUMERIC)\n- operating_cash_flow (NUMERIC)\n- eps (NUMERIC)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**How Chatbot Uses It**:\n- Query: &#96;SELECT year, revenue FROM financials_std WHERE symbol='AAPL' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 5&#96;\n- Returns: &#96;[{year: 2024, revenue: 383285000000}, {year: 2023, revenue: 383285000000}]&#96;\n- Sent to LLM as JSON string in prompt\n\n**Pros**:\n- Fast queries for single metrics\n- All related data in one row\n- Easy to calculate ratios (has all fields together)\n\n**Cons**:\n- Can't add new metrics without schema changes\n- Wastes space if most fields are NULL\n- Inconsistent with &#96;financial_metrics&#96; table structure\n\n---\n\n#### 2. &#96;financial_metrics&#96; - Extended Metrics (Key-Value Table)\n**Purpose**: Stores 96+ advanced metrics in key-value format (one row per metric per year)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nColumns:\n- symbol (TEXT)\n- year (INTEGER)\n- period (TEXT) - 'FY', 'Q1', 'Q2', etc.\n- metric_name (TEXT) - e.g., 'peRatio', 'marketCap', 'returnOnEquity'\n- metric_value (NUMERIC)\n- metric_category (TEXT) - 'Valuation', 'Profitability', etc.\n- data_source (TEXT) - 'FMP', 'Calculated', 'SEC'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**How Chatbot Uses It**:\n- Query: &#96;SELECT year, metric_name, metric_value FROM financial_metrics WHERE symbol='AAPL' AND metric_name IN ('peRatio', 'roe') ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10&#96;\n- Returns: &#96;[{year: 2024, metric_name: 'peRatio', metric_value: 28.5}, ...]&#96;\n- Sent to LLM as JSON string\n\n**Pros**:\n- Flexible: Easy to add new metrics\n- Supports multiple metrics per query\n- Categorized for organization\n\n**Cons**:\n- More rows = slower queries\n- Requires multiple rows for one year's data",

        "contents": "# Financial Metrics for AAPL\n\nThis document details all financial metrics (primitives and calculated) available for Apple Inc. (AAPL) in the Fin Quote system.\n\n---\n\n## Data Coverage\n\n- **Ticker**: AAPL (Apple Inc.)\n- **Years Available**: 2006 - 2025 (20 years)\n- **Data Source**: Financial Modeling Prep API\n- **Database Table**: &#96;financials_std&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Raw Financial Metrics (Primitives)\n\nThese metrics are stored directly in the database and fetched from the Financial Modeling Prep API.\n\n### Income Statement Metrics\n\n| Metric | Database Field | Description | Unit |\n|--------|---------------|-------------|------|\n| **Revenue** | &#96;revenue&#96; | Total revenue (sales) for the fiscal year | USD |\n| **Gross Profit** | &#96;gross_profit&#96; | Revenue minus cost of goods sold (COGS) | USD |\n| **Operating Income** | &#96;operating_income&#96; | Profit from core business operations (EBIT) | USD |\n| **Net Income** | &#96;net_income&#96; | Bottom line profit after all expenses and taxes | USD |\n| **EPS** | &#96;eps&#96; | Earnings per share (diluted) | USD per share |\n\n### Balance Sheet Metrics\n\n| Metric | Database Field | Description | Unit |\n|--------|---------------|-------------|------|\n| **Total Assets** | &#96;total_assets&#96; | Sum of all assets owned by the company | USD |\n| **Total Liabilities** | &#96;total_liabilities&#96; | Sum of all debts and obligations | USD |\n| **Shareholders' Equity** | &#96;shareholders_equity&#96; | Net worth of the company (Assets - Liabilities) | USD |\n\n### Cash Flow Statement Metrics\n\n| Metric | Database Field | Description | Unit |\n|--------|---------------|-------------|------|\n| **Operating Cash Flow** | &#96;operating_cash_flow&#96; | Cash generated from core business operations | USD |\n\n---\n\n## Calculated Financial Metrics (Derived)\n\nThese metrics are computed on-the-fly from raw metrics when requested. They are not stored in the database.\n\n### Profitability Ratios\n\n#### Gross Margin\n- **Formula**: &#96;(gross_profit / revenue) × 100&#96;\n- **Unit**: Percentage (%)\n- **Description**: Percentage of revenue retained after accounting for cost of goods sold. Higher is better.\n- **Interpretation**:\n  - Shows how efficiently a company produces its goods",

        "contents": "2. Tool execution fetches calculated gross margin data directly\n3. Answer generation formats the answer\n4. Chart helper generates ratio chart (percentage scale, not raw values)\n\nFor metrics not natively calculated:\n1. Tool execution fetches related metrics (e.g., &#96;net_income&#96; includes &#96;shareholders_equity&#96;)\n2. Answer generation calculates ratio from raw data using provided formula\n3. Chart helper detects ratio request from user question and generates appropriate chart\n\n### Extended Metrics System (139 Metrics)\n\n**Implementation Status**: Fully integrated in Q&amp;A system (Phase 4 complete)\n\n**Tool Flow:**\n1. User asks: \"What's AAPL's P/E ratio?\"\n2. Tool selection picks &#96;getFinancialMetric&#96; with &#96;metricNames: [\"P/E\"]&#96; (alias support)\n3. Alias resolver converts \"P/E\" → &#96;peRatio&#96;\n4. Tool execution fetches from &#96;financial_metrics&#96; table\n5. Answer generation formats response\n6. (Charts not yet implemented for advanced metrics)\n\n**Discovery Flow:**\n1. User asks: \"What profitability metrics are available?\"\n2. Tool selection picks &#96;listMetrics&#96; with &#96;category: \"Profitability &amp; Returns\"&#96;\n3. Tool execution fetches from metrics catalog\n4. Answer generation lists available metrics with descriptions\n\n**Metric Categories:**\n- Valuation (P/E, P/B, P/S, EV/EBITDA, PEG, Market Cap, Enterprise Value)\n- Profitability &amp; Returns (ROE, ROA, ROIC, profit margins)\n- Leverage &amp; Solvency (debt ratios, interest coverage, liquidity ratios)\n- Efficiency (asset turnover, inventory turnover, receivables turnover)\n- Growth Rates (revenue growth, EPS growth, 3Y/5Y/10Y CAGRs)\n- Per-Share Metrics (book value per share, operating cash flow per share)\n- Capital Returns &amp; Share Data (dividend yield, payout ratio, share buybacks)\n\n### Conversation History\n\nThe system maintains conversation context:\n- Stored in &#96;conversations&#96; and &#96;messages&#96; tables (persisted to Supabase)\n- Passed to both tool selection and answer generation\n- Limited to last 10 messages (tool selection) or 4 messages (answer generation for gpt-5)\n- Enables follow-up questions like \"What about 2022?\" after asking about 2023",

        "contents": "async function ingestDirect() {\nconst { data, error } = await \n(5)\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.log('⚠️  Client query failed (cache issue), trying direct SQL...')\n\n    // Try direct SQL query\n    const response = await fetch(&#96;${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/financial_metrics?symbol=eq.AAPL&amp;metric_name=eq.peRatio&amp;order=year.desc&amp;limit=5&#96;, {\n      headers: {\n        'apikey': supabaseKey,\n        'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${supabaseKey}&#96;,\n      },\n    })\n\n    if (response.ok) {\n      const directData = await response.json()\n      console.log('\\n📊 Sample data - AAPL P/E Ratio:')\n      console.table(directData.map((d: any) =&gt; ({\n        year: d.year,\n        'P/E Ratio': d.metric_value?.toFixed(2),\n      })))\n    }\n  } else if (data &amp;&amp; data.length &gt; 0) {\n    console.log('\\n📊 Sample data - AAPL P/E Ratio:')\n    console.table(data.map((d: any) =&gt; ({\n      year: d.year,\n      'P/E Ratio': d.metric_value?.toFixed(2),\n    })))\n  }\n\n  console.log('\\n✅ Done!')\n}\n\ningestDirect().catch(console.error)",

Scripts Created\n\n| Script | Purpose | Command |\n|--------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;fetch-fmp-metrics.ts&#96; | Fetch metrics from FMP API | &#96;npm run fetch:metrics&#96; |\n| &#96;ingest-fmp-metrics.ts&#96; | Load data via Supabase client | &#96;npm run ingest:metrics&#96; |\n| &#96;setup-financial-metrics.ts&#96; | All-in-one fetch + ingest | &#96;npm run setup:metrics&#96; |\n| &#96;ingest-via-rest.ts&#96; | Load via REST API (bypasses cache) | &#96;npx tsx scripts/ingest-via-rest.ts&#96; |\n| &#96;apply-migration.ts&#96; | Migration helper | &#96;npx tsx scripts/apply-migration.ts&#96; |\n| &#96;execute-migration.ts&#96; | Check table existence | &#96;npx tsx scripts/execute-migration.ts&#96; |\n\n---\n\n### 6.         "contents": "# Missing FMP API Data\n\n## Current State\n\nWe're currently fetching from **5 endpoints**:\n1. ✅ &#96;key-metrics&#96; - Key financial metrics (P/E, ROE, book value, etc.)\n2. ✅ &#96;ratios&#96; - Financial ratios (current ratio, debt ratios, turnover ratios)\n3. ✅ &#96;financial-growth&#96; - Growth rates (revenue growth, EPS growth, etc.)\n4. ✅ &#96;enterprise-values&#96; - Enterprise value components (market cap, debt, cash)\n5. ✅ &#96;income-statement&#96; - Revenue, expenses, EBITDA, margins (NEWLY ADDED)\n\n## Missing Endpoints with Valuable Data\n\n### 1. Balance Sheet Statement (&#96;/balance-sheet-statement&#96;)\n\n**What it provides:**\n- **Assets**: Cash, receivables, inventory, PP&amp;E, investments, intangibles, goodwill\n- **Liabilities**: Payables, short-term debt, long-term debt, deferred revenue\n- **Equity**: Common stock, retained earnings, accumulated OCI\n- **Calculated fields**: Total debt, net debt, total investments\n\n**Why it's important:**\n- We currently have basic balance sheet items (total_assets, total_liabilities, shareholders_equity) from &#96;financials_std&#96; table\n- But we're missing detailed breakdowns like:\n  - Current vs non-current assets/liabilities\n  - PP&amp;E (property, plant, equipment)\n  - Working capital components (inventory, receivables, payables - detailed values, not just turnover ratios)\n  - Debt structure (short-term vs long-term debt)\n  - Cash vs investments breakdown\n\n**Example data (AAPL 2025):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncashAndCashEquivalents: $33.5B\ninventory: $5.7B\npropertyPlantEquipmentNet: $61.0B\nshortTermDebt: $22.4B\nlongTermDebt: $89.9B\ntotalDebt: $112.4B\nnetDebt: $78.8B\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Cash Flow Statement (&#96;/cash-flow-statement&#96;)\n\n**What it provides:**\n- **Operating Activities**: Net income adjustments, working capital changes, D&amp;A, stock-based comp\n- **Investing Activities**: Capex, acquisitions, investment purchases/sales\n- **Financing Activities**: Debt repayment, stock repurchases, dividends\n- **Calculated fields**: Free cash flow, operating cash flow, capex\n\n**Why it's important:**\n- We currently only have &#96;operating_cash_flow&#96; from &#96;financials_std&#96; table\n- But we're missing:\n  - **Free cash flow** (operating cash flow - capex) - critical metric!",

\"margins\", \"ratios\" (when not specific) → operating_income\n\n   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:\n\n   1.
