            "text": "   - debt_to_equity_ratio  (total_liabilities / shareholders_equity)",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - gross_margin          (gross_profit / revenue × 100)",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - roe                   (net_income / shareholders_equity × 100)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "   METRIC MAPPING (with context clues):",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "   Income/Profitability:",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"sales\", \"revenue\", \"top line\" → revenue",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"profit\", \"earnings\", \"bottom line\", \"profitability\" → net_income",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"EPS\", \"earnings per share\" → eps",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"operating profit\", \"EBIT\" → operating_income",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "   Valuation Ratios (use getFinancialMetric tool):",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"P/E ratio\", \"PE ratio\", \"price to earnings\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/E\"]",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"P/B ratio\", \"price to book\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"P/B\"]",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"PEG ratio\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"PEG\"]",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "   Calculated Ratios (✨ NOW NATIVE - use directly):",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"gross margin\", \"gross profit margin\" → gross_margin",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"ROE\", \"return on equity\" → roe",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"debt to equity\", \"debt-to-equity\", \"D/E ratio\", \"leverage ratio\" → debt_to_equity_ratio",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "   Balance Sheet (Raw):",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"assets\", \"total assets\" → total_assets",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"liabilities\", \"total debt\", \"debt\" → total_liabilities",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"equity\", \"book value\", \"shareholders equity\" → shareholders_equity",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "   Cash Flow:",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"operating cash flow\", \"cash from operations\", \"OCF\" → operating_cash_flow",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"free cash flow\", \"FCF\", \"unlevered free cash flow\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"capex\", \"capital expenditures\", \"buybacks\", \"dividends paid\", \"stock-based compensation\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "   Research &amp; Development:",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"R&amp;D\", \"research and development\", \"R&amp;D spending\", \"R&amp;D expense\" → Use getFinancialMetric tool with metricNames: [\"R&amp;D to revenue\"] or [\"research and development\"]",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "   Other (use closest available):",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"margins\", \"ratios\" (when not specific) → operating_income",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES - CRITICAL:",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "   1. If question asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (2020, 2019, 2015, 2006, etc.) → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "      Why: We have 20 years (2006-2025). To find any specific year, fetch all.",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "      Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"net income in 2020\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"revenue for 2018\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"What was EPS in 2006?\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "   2. If question asks for a YEAR RANGE (2008 to 2020, 2015 to present, etc.) → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "      Why: Need all data to filter to the specific range.",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "      Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"net income 2008 to present\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"revenue from 2015 to 2020\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "      - \"EPS between 2010 and 2018\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "   3. If question specifies a NUMBER of years, use that EXACT number:",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last 3 years\" → limit: 3",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"past 5 years\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last year\" or \"most recent year\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"10 years\" → limit: 10",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"20 years\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"2 years\" → limit: 2",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "   4. If question says \"trend\", \"history\", \"over time\" WITHOUT a number → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "   5. If question says \"all\", \"complete\", \"full history\" → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "   6. If question is just asking for the metric (no time context) → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"net income in 2006\" → limit: 20 (specific year)",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"revenue over 5 years\" → limit: 5 (number specified)",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"show me net income trend\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"EPS history\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"gross profit\" → limit: 4 (no number)",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"all historical data\" → limit: 20 (all data)",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"metric\": &lt;exact name&gt;, \"limit\": &lt;number 1-20&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "2. getPrices - Stock PRICE history",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "   ALWAYS use custom date ranges. Calculate the \"from\" date based on the user's request.",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "   Today's date is {{TODAY_DATE}} (use this for calculations).",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "   Date format: YYYY-MM-DD",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "   \"to\" is optional (defaults to today)",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "   CALCULATION EXAMPLES:",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 7 days\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-11-01\"} (7 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past month\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-10-08\"} (30 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 3 months\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-08-08\"} (90 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past year\" → args: {\"from\": \"2024-11-08\"} (365 days ago)",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"YTD\" → args: {\"from\": \"2025-01-01\"} (start of current year)",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 3 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2022-11-08\"} (3 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 5 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-11-08\"} (5 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 7 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-11-08\"} (7 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 10 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-11-08\"} (10 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"last 15 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2010-11-08\"} (15 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"past 20 years\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago)",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"all time\" → args: {\"from\": \"2005-11-08\"} (20 years ago, max available)",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "   EXACT DATE RANGES:",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"from Jan 2020 to June 2023\" → args: {\"from\": \"2020-01-01\", \"to\": \"2023-06-30\"}",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"prices between 2015 and 2020\" → args: {\"from\": \"2015-01-01\", \"to\": \"2020-12-31\"}",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"from March 2018 to now\" → args: {\"from\": \"2018-03-01\"}",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"from\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\", \"to\": \"&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;\"}  (to is optional)",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "3. getRecentFilings - LIST SEC filings metadata ONLY",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool returns ONLY metadata (filing type, date, URL).",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "   It does NOT return filing CONTENT or text.",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use ONLY when:",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to know WHEN filings were submitted",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to know WHICH filings exist",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants filing dates/types/URLs",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "   DO NOT USE when:",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks WHAT the filing says",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants content, quotes, or information FROM the filing",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks about topics like risks, strategy, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "   → Use searchFilings instead for content questions!",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES:",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "   1. If question specifies NUMBER of filings → use that number",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"last 3 filings\" → limit: 3",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"most recent filing\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"2 years of filings\" → limit: 10 (2 years ≈ 8-10 filings)",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "   2. If question says \"recent\", \"latest\" (no number) → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "   3. If question says \"all\", \"available\", \"history\" → limit: 10",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples (metadata questions):",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"when was the most recent filing?\" → limit: 1",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"what filings do you have?\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"show me filing dates\" → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"limit\": &lt;number 1-10&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "4. searchFilings - SEARCH filing content (for WHAT they say)",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "   ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Use this when user asks about CONTENT, not just dates!",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use for ANY question about WHAT the filings say:",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Risk factors, strategy, operations, business model",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Management commentary, outlook, quotes",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Products, markets, competition",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Governance, compensation",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ANY question asking \"what did they say\", \"provide quotes\", etc.",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "   Even if they mention \"latest 10-K\" or specific filing:",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What are risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What does the 10-K say about AI?\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Provide quotes from recent filing\" → USE searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "   QUERY RULES:",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Extract key terms from user's question",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Keep it simple (1-3 words usually best)",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Don't need full sentences",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What are the risk factors?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What about risk factors in latest 10-K?\" → {\"query\": \"risk factors\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Tell me about competition\" → {\"query\": \"competition\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Provide quotes about AI strategy\" → {\"query\": \"AI strategy\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What does the 10-K say about iPhone?\" → {\"query\": \"iPhone\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"query\": \"&lt;keywords&gt;\", \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "5. listMetrics - DISCOVER available financial metrics",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "   Use when:",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User asks \"what metrics do you have?\"",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User wants to browse metrics by category",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Uncertain which metric name to use for getFinancialMetric",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "   CATEGORY FILTER (optional):",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Valuation: P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, market cap, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Profitability &amp; Returns: ROE, ROA, ROIC, margins",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Growth: revenue growth, EPS growth, asset growth",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Leverage &amp; Solvency: debt ratios, liquidity ratios",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Efficiency &amp; Working Capital: turnover ratios, cycle days",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Capital Returns &amp; Share Data: dividend yield, payout ratio",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Per-Share Metrics: EPS, book value per share, cash per share",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Market Data: stock metrics, valuation metrics",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Other: miscellaneous metrics",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What valuation metrics do you have?\" → {\"category\": \"Valuation\"}",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Show me all metrics\" → {} (no category)",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What debt metrics are available?\" → {\"category\": \"Leverage &amp; Solvency\"}",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"category\": \"&lt;optional category name&gt;\"}",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "6. getFinancialMetric - GET advanced financial metrics (139 metrics available)",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "   COMPLETE METRIC CATALOG (organized by category):",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "   Valuation (11):",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "   - peRatio, priceToBookRatio, priceToSalesRatio, priceToFreeCashFlowsRatio, earningsYield",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "   - marketCap, enterpriseValue, evToSales, evToOperatingCashFlow, evToFreeCashFlow, freeCashFlowYield",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "   Profitability &amp; Returns (12):",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "   - grossProfitMargin, operatingProfitMargin, netProfitMargin, ebitPerRevenue, ebitdaMargin, pretaxProfitMargin",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "   - returnOnEquity, returnOnAssets, returnOnCapitalEmployed, roic, ebtPerEbit, netIncomePerEBT",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "   Growth (32):",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "   - revenueGrowth, grossProfitGrowth, operatingIncomeGrowth, netIncomeGrowth, ebitgrowth",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "   - epsgrowth, epsdilutedGrowth, operatingCashFlowGrowth, freeCashFlowGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "   - assetGrowth, debtGrowth, inventoryGrowth, receivablesGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendsperShareGrowth, bookValueperShareGrowth, weightedAverageSharesGrowth, weightedAverageSharesDilutedGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "   - rdexpenseGrowth, sgaexpensesGrowth",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "   - threeYRevenueGrowthPerShare, threeYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, threeYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "   - threeYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, threeYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "   - fiveYRevenueGrowthPerShare, fiveYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, fiveYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "   - fiveYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, fiveYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "   - tenYRevenueGrowthPerShare, tenYNetIncomeGrowthPerShare, tenYOperatingCFGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "   - tenYShareholdersEquityGrowthPerShare, tenYDividendperShareGrowthPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "   Leverage &amp; Solvency (9):",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "   - debtEquityRatio, debtRatio, currentRatio, quickRatio, cashRatio",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "   - interestCoverage, longTermDebtToCapitalization, totalDebtToCapitalization, cashFlowToDebtRatio",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "   Efficiency &amp; Working Capital (7):",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "   - assetTurnover, fixedAssetTurnover, inventoryTurnover, receivablesTurnover, payablesTurnover",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "   - cashConversionCycle, daysOfInventoryOutstanding, daysOfSalesOutstanding, daysOfPayablesOutstanding",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "   Cash Flow (2):",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "   - freeCashFlow, capitalExpenditure",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "   Capital Returns &amp; Share Data (5):",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendYield, payoutRatio, dividendsPaid, commonStockRepurchased, numberOfShares",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "   Per-Share Metrics (7):",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "   - bookValuePerShare, cashPerShare, operatingCashFlowPerShare, freeCashFlowPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "   - netIncomePerShare, revenuePerShare, tangibleBookValuePerShare",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "   Market Data (1):",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "   - stockPrice",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "   Other (53):",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ebitda, stockBasedCompensation, depreciationAndAmortization, workingCapital, effectiveTaxRate",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "   - marketCapitalization, enterpriseValueMultiple, enterpriseValueOverEBITDA",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "   - pbRatio, pfcfRatio, pocfratio, priceBookValueRatio, priceCashFlowRatio, priceEarningsRatio",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "   - priceEarningsToGrowthRatio, priceFairValue, priceSalesRatio, priceToOperatingCashFlowsRatio, ptbRatio",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "   - roe, returnOnTangibleAssets",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "   - researchAndDdevelopementToRevenue, salesGeneralAndAdministrativeToRevenue, stockBasedCompensationToRevenue",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "   - capexPerShare, capexToDepreciation, capexToOperatingCashFlow, capexToRevenue",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "   - shareholdersEquityPerShare, tangibleAssetValue, investedCapital",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "   - debtToAssets, debtToEquity, netDebtToEBITDA",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "   - operatingCashFlowSalesRatio, freeCashFlowOperatingCashFlowRatio",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "   - cashFlowCoverageRatios, capitalExpenditureCoverageRatio, dividendPaidAndCapexCoverageRatio, shortTermCoverageRatios",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "   - dividendPayoutRatio, interestDebtPerShare",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "   - companyEquityMultiplier, intangiblesToTotalAssets",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "   - daysOfInventoryOnHand, daysPayablesOutstanding, daysSalesOutstanding, operatingCycle",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "   - incomeQuality, grahamNumber, grahamNetNet, netCurrentAssetValue",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "   - averageInventory, averagePayables, averageReceivables",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "   - addTotalDebt, minusCashAndCashEquivalents",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "   METRIC NAME FLEXIBILITY:",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Accepts canonical names: \"peRatio\", \"returnOnEquity\", \"debtEquityRatio\"",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Accepts common aliases: \"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Can handle multiple metrics in one call",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "   LIMIT RULES (same as getAaplFinancialsByMetric):",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Specific year → limit: 20",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Number specified → use that number",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"trend\", \"history\" → limit: 4",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"compare\" with multiple metrics → limit: 10 (show more history for comparisons)",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Default → limit: 5",
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "text": "   Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's Apple's P/E ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's the price to book ratio?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"price to book\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Show me ROE trend\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"ROE\"], \"limit\": 4}",
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"What's Apple's free cash flow?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"free cash flow\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"How much did Apple spend on buybacks?\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"buybacks\"], \"limit\": 5}",
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Show me capex trend\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"capex\"], \"limit\": 4}",
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Compare P/E, ROE, and debt to equity\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\", \"ROE\", \"debt to equity\"], \"limit\": 10}",
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Compare P/E and ROE\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"P/E\", \"ROE\"], \"limit\": 10}",
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "text": "   - \"Dividend yield for 2023\" → {\"metricNames\": [\"dividend yield\"], \"limit\": 20}",
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "text": "   args: {\"metricNames\": [\"&lt;metric1&gt;\", \"&lt;metric2&gt;\"], \"limit\": &lt;number&gt;}",
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "TOOL SELECTION LOGIC:",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Basic financial metrics (revenue, assets, eps, etc.)? → getAaplFinancialsByMetric",
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Advanced metrics (P/E, ROE, debt ratios, etc.)? → getFinancialMetric",
            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "text": "3. User asks \"what metrics available\"? → listMetrics",
            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Stock price? → getPrices",
            "lineNumber": 373
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Filing metadata ONLY (when/which filings)? → getRecentFilings",
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "6. Filing CONTENT (what they say, quotes, topics)? → searchFilings",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "⚠️ KEY DISTINCTION for #6 vs #7:",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"When was the latest 10-K filed?\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"What does the latest 10-K say about risks?\" → searchFilings (content)",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"Show me recent filings\" → getRecentFilings (metadata)",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"What are risk factors in the latest 10-K?\" → searchFilings (content)",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "- \"Provide quotes from the 10-K\" → searchFilings (content)",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "Return ONLY JSON - examples:",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"revenue\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"eps\",\"limit\":1}}",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getAaplFinancialsByMetric\",\"args\":{\"metric\":\"total_liabilities\",\"limit\":4}}",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getRecentFilings\",\"args\":{\"limit\":3}}",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"risk factors\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"searchFilings\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"AI strategy\",\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"listMetrics\",\"args\":{}}",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"P/E\"],\"limit\":5}}",
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "{\"tool\":\"getFinancialMetric\",\"args\":{\"metricNames\":[\"ROE\",\"debt to equity\"],\"limit\":10}}",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "CRITICAL EXAMPLES - Filing Content vs Metadata:",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "Q: \"When was the latest 10-K filed?\"",

        "contents": "4. **Validation &amp; Auto-Correction** (lines 653-796)\n   - Validates numbers, years, and filing citations\n   - If validation fails with medium+ severity, triggers auto-regeneration\n   - May refetch data with corrected args if needed\n   - Logs all attempts and results to &#96;query_logs&#96; table\n\n### Available Tools\n\nDefined in &#96;lib/tools.ts&#96; (TOOL_MENU):\n\n1. **getAaplFinancialsByMetric** - Core financial metrics from &#96;financials_std&#96; table\n   - Raw metrics: &#96;revenue&#96;, &#96;gross_profit&#96;, &#96;net_income&#96;, &#96;operating_income&#96;, &#96;total_assets&#96;, &#96;total_liabilities&#96;, &#96;shareholders_equity&#96;, &#96;operating_cash_flow&#96;, &#96;eps&#96;\n   - Calculated metrics (native support): &#96;gross_margin&#96;, &#96;roe&#96;, &#96;debt_to_equity_ratio&#96;\n   - Returns time-series data with related metrics for ratio calculations\n\n2. **getFinancialMetric** - Extended metrics from &#96;financial_metrics&#96; table (139 metrics)\n   - Supports flexible aliases: \"P/E\" → &#96;peRatio&#96;, \"return on equity\" → &#96;returnOnEquity&#96;\n   - Categories: Valuation, Profitability, Growth, Leverage, Efficiency, Per-Share Metrics\n   - Multi-metric queries: fetch multiple metrics in one call\n\n3. **listMetrics** - Browse available metrics catalog\n   - Optional category filter\n   - Returns metric names, descriptions, units, and common aliases\n   - Use when uncertain which metrics are available\n\n4. **getPrices** - Stock price history from FMP API\n   - Custom date ranges: &#96;from&#96; (required), &#96;to&#96; (optional, defaults to today)\n   - Supports multi-year ranges (up to 20 years)\n   - Returns daily OHLCV data\n\n5. **getRecentFilings** - SEC filing metadata (10-K, 10-Q)\n   - Returns filing type, date, period, fiscal year/quarter, URL\n   - Limit: 1-10 filings\n\n6. **searchFilings** - Semantic search over SEC filing content (RAG)\n   - Uses pgvector for embedding-based search\n   - Returns relevant text passages with citations\n   - Query: natural language, Limit: 1-10 passages\n\n### Data Storage (Supabase)\n\n**Core Tables:**\n- &#96;company&#96; - Company metadata (symbol, name, sector)\n- &#96;financials_std&#96; - Core financial metrics by year (9 metrics with 20-year history)\n- &#96;financial_metrics&#96; - Extended metrics (139 metrics from FMP, 2006-2025)",

        },
        "contents": "export async function getFinancialMetrics(params: {\n  symbol: string\n  metricNames: string[] // Array of metric names (canonical OR aliases)\n  year?: number\n  yearStart?: number\n  yearEnd?: number\n  limit?: number // Number of years per metric (default: 5, max: 20)\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[] | null\n  error: string | null\n  unresolved?: string[] // Metrics that couldn't be resolved\n}&gt; {\n\n    return { data: null, error: err.message }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Search metrics by category (e.g., all \"Valuation\" metrics)\n */\nexport async function getMetricsByCategory(params: {\n  symbol: string\n  category: string // 'Valuation', 'Profitability &amp; Returns', 'Growth', etc.\n  year?: number\n}): Promise&lt;{\n  data: FinancialMetricResult[] | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient()\n\n    let query = supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .select('year, metric_name, metric_value, metric_category, data_source')\n      .eq('symbol', params.symbol)\n      .eq('metric_category', params.category)\n      .order('metric_name', { ascending: true })\n\n    if (params.year) {\n      query = query.eq('year', params.year)\n    } else {\n      // Get most recent year if not specified\n      query = query.order('year', { ascending: false }).limit(50)\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await query\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('[getMetricsByCategory] Error:', error)\n      return { data: null, error: error.message }\n    }\n\n    return { data, error: null }\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    console.error('[getMetricsByCategory] Exception:', err)\n    return { data: null, error: err.message }\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {

        "contents": "async function ingestMetrics() {\n\n\n  for (let i = 0; i &lt; metrics.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {\n    const batch = metrics.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE)\n\n    const { error } = await supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .upsert(batch, {\n        onConflict: 'symbol,year,period,metric_name', // Unique constraint\n      })\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;❌ Error in batch ${i / BATCH_SIZE + 1}:&#96;, error.message)\n      errors += batch.length\n    } else {\n      inserted += batch.length\n      const progress = ((i + batch.length) / metrics.length) * 100\n      console.log(&#96;   ✓ Batch ${i / BATCH_SIZE + 1}: ${batch.length} records (${progress.toFixed(1)}%)&#96;)\n    }\n  }\n\n  console.log(&#96;\\\\n✅ Ingestion complete!&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;   Processed: ${inserted} records&#96;)\n  console.log(&#96;   Errors: ${errors} records&#96;)\n\n  // Verify data\n  console.log(&#96;\\\\n🔍 Verifying data in Supabase...&#96;)\n\n  const { count: finalCount } = await supabase\n    .from('financial_metrics')\n    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n\n  console.log(&#96;   Total records in table: ${finalCount}&#96;)\n\n  // Sample query - get P/E ratio for 2024\n  const { data: sampleData, error: sampleError } = await supabase\n    .from('financial_metrics')\n    .select('*')\n    .eq('symbol', 'AAPL')\n    .eq('metric_name', 'peRatio')\n    .order('year', { ascending: false })\n    .limit(5)\n\n  if (!sampleError &amp;&amp; sampleData &amp;&amp; sampleData.length &gt; 0) {\n    console.log(&#96;\\\\n📊 Sample query - AAPL P/E Ratio (last 5 years):&#96;)\n    console.table(sampleData.map((d: any) =&gt; ({\n      year: d.year,\n      value: d.metric_value?.toFixed(2),\n      category: d.metric_category,\n      source: d.data_source,\n    })))\n  }\n\n  // Get unique metrics count\n  const { data: uniqueMetrics } = await supabase\n    .from('financial_metrics')\n    .select('metric_name')\n    .eq('symbol', 'AAPL')\n\n  if (uniqueMetrics) {\n    const uniqueCount = new Set(uniqueMetrics.map((m: any) =&gt; m.metric_name)).size\n    console.log(&#96;\\\\n🎯 Unique metrics in database: ${uniqueCount}&#96;)\n  }\n\n  console.log(&#96;\\\\n✅ Done! You can now query financial_metrics table.&#96;)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Fetch latest Russell 2000 index price and intraday data for homepage\n */\nexport async function getRussellMarketData() {\n  try {\n    // Get latest index price from FMP API\n    const apiKey = process.env.FMP_API_KEY\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      return { error: 'API configuration error' }\n    }\n\n    // Fetch latest price quote for Russell 2000 index\n    const quoteUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/quote/^RUT?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n    const quoteResponse = await fetch(quoteUrl, {\n      next: { revalidate: 10 }, // Cache for 10 seconds (real-time data)\n    })\n\n    if (!quoteResponse.ok) {\n      console.error('FMP API error:', quoteResponse.status)\n      return { error: 'Failed to fetch price data' }\n    }\n\n    const quoteJson = await quoteResponse.json()\n    const priceData = quoteJson[0] // FMP returns array with one item\n\n    // Fetch 1-minute intraday data and aggregate into 10-minute candles\n    // FMP Premium tier includes 1-minute data for last 3 trading days\n    const intradayUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/historical-chart/1min/^RUT?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n    const intradayResponse = await fetch(intradayUrl, {\n      next: { revalidate: 10 }, // Cache for 10 seconds (real-time data)\n    })\n\n    let priceHistory = []\n    if (intradayResponse.ok) {\n      const intradayJson = await intradayResponse.json()\n}",

Fixed the issues:

## Changes Made:

1. **Fixed metric name lookups** in `getStockKeyStats`:
   - `operatingMargin`: now checks `operatingProfitMargin` and `ebitPerRevenue`
   - `netMargin`: now checks `netProfitMargin` (was `netIncomeMargin`)
   - `debtToEquity`: now checks both `debtToEquity` and `debtEquityRatio`
   - `threeYearCAGR`: now checks `threeYRevenueGrowthPerShare` (was `revenuePerShareThreeYearGrowth`)
   - `fiveYearCAGR`: now checks `fiveYRevenueGrowthPerShare` (was `revenuePerShareFiveYearGrowth`)
   - Added fallbacks for `forwardPE`, `beta`, `dividendYield` from the database

2. **Improved formatting logic**:
   - Margins now allow 0% (changed `allowZero: false` to `allowZero: true` for Operating/Net Margin)
   - Beta and Debt-to-Equity now use `formatMetric` for consistent handling

3. **Better fallback chain**:
   - Each metric checks multiple sources (API → database → 0)
   - Uses alternative metric names when the primary isn't found

The page should now show more values instead of "N/A". Metrics will display if they exist in the database or API, even if they're 0. Refresh the page to see the updates.

        },
        "contents": "export function generatePriceChart(data: PriceData[], range: string): ChartConfig | null {\n\n  let dataToUse = validData\n\n  if (validData.length &gt; MAX_DATA_POINTS) {\n    // Determine aggregation period based on data size\n    // For very large datasets (&gt; 500 points), use monthly aggregation\n    // Otherwise use weekly\n    const daysPerPeriod = validData.length &gt; 500 ? 30 : 7\n\n    const aggregatedData: typeof validData = []\n    for (let i = 0; i &lt; validData.length; i += daysPerPeriod) {\n      const periodData = validData.slice(i, Math.min(i + daysPerPeriod, validData.length))\n      if (periodData.length &gt; 0) {\n        aggregatedData.push({\n          date: periodData[0].date,\n          open: periodData[0].open,\n          high: Math.max(...periodData.map(d =&gt; d.high)),\n          low: Math.min(...periodData.map(d =&gt; d.low)),\n          close: periodData[periodData.length - 1].close,\n          volume: periodData.reduce((sum, d) =&gt; sum + d.volume, 0)\n        })\n      }\n    }\n    dataToUse = aggregatedData\n  }\n\n  // Convert to OHLC candlestick data [timestamp, open, high, low, close] for Highcharts\n  // Add additional validation to ensure no NaN, null, or Infinity values\n  const candlestickData = dataToUse\n    .filter((d) =&gt;\n      d.open != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(d.open) &amp;&amp;\n      d.high != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(d.high) &amp;&amp;\n      d.low != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(d.low) &amp;&amp;\n      d.close != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(d.close)\n    )\n    .map((d) =&gt; {\n      const timestamp = new Date(d.date).getTime()\n      if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) {\n        return null\n      }\n\n      const open = parseFloat(d.open.toFixed(2))\n      const high = parseFloat(d.high.toFixed(2))\n      const low = parseFloat(d.low.toFixed(2))\n      const close = parseFloat(d.close.toFixed(2))\n\n      // Double-check all values are finite after toFixed\n      if (!Number.isFinite(open) || !Number.isFinite(high) || !Number.isFinite(low) || !Number.isFinite(close)) {\n        return null\n      }\n\n      return [timestamp, open, high, low, close]\n    })\n    .filter((item): item is [number, number, number, number, number] =&gt; item !== null)\n\n  // Also prepare volume data [timestamp, volume] for volume chart\n}",

        "contents": "export default function TradingViewChart({\n  data,\n  height = 400,\n  selectedRange,\n  onRangeChange,\n  loading = false,\n}: TradingViewChartProps) {\n\n\n  // Initialize chart\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (!chartContainerRef.current) return;\n\n    const chart = createChart(chartContainerRef.current, {\n      width: chartContainerRef.current.clientWidth,\n      height: height,\n      layout: {\n        background: { color: isDarkMode ? 'rgb(45,45,45)' : '#ffffff' },\n        textColor: isDarkMode ? '#d1d5db' : '#374151',\n      },\n      grid: {\n        vertLines: { color: isDarkMode ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' },\n        horzLines: { color: isDarkMode ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' },\n      },\n      crosshair: {\n        mode: 1, // Magnet mode\n      },\n      rightPriceScale: {\n        borderColor: isDarkMode ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',\n      },\n      timeScale: {\n        borderColor: isDarkMode ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',\n        timeVisible: true,\n        secondsVisible: false,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Add candlestick series (v5 API)\n    const candlestickSeries = chart.addSeries(CandlestickSeries, {\n      upColor: '#22c55e',\n      downColor: '#ef4444',\n      borderUpColor: '#22c55e',\n      borderDownColor: '#ef4444',\n      wickUpColor: '#22c55e',\n      wickDownColor: '#ef4444',\n    });\n\n    // Add volume series (v5 API)\n    const volumeSeries = chart.addSeries(HistogramSeries, {\n      color: '#60a5fa',\n      priceFormat: {\n        type: 'volume',\n      },\n      priceScaleId: 'volume',\n    });\n\n    // Configure volume to be at the bottom with smaller height\n    chart.priceScale('volume').applyOptions({\n      scaleMargins: {\n        top: 0.8,\n        bottom: 0,\n      },\n    });\n\n    chartRef.current = chart;\n    candlestickSeriesRef.current = candlestickSeries;\n    volumeSeriesRef.current = volumeSeries;\n\n    // Handle resize\n    const handleResize = () =&gt; {\n      if (chartContainerRef.current &amp;&amp; chartRef.current) {\n        chartRef.current.applyOptions({\n          width: chartContainerRef.current.clientWidth,\n        });\n      }\n    };\n\n    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": ";\n\nexport default function StockPriceChart({\n  initialData = [],\n  initialRange = '365d',\n}: StockPriceChartProps) {\n  const [data, setData] = useState&lt;PriceDataPoint[]&gt;(initialData);\n  const [selectedRange, setSelectedRange] = useState&lt;PriceRange&gt;(initialRange);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(initialData.length === 0);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // Fetch data when range changes\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const fetchData = async () =&gt; {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n\n      const result = await getAaplPrices({ range: selectedRange });\n\n      if (result.error) {\n        setError(result.error);\n        setData([]);\n      } else if (result.data) {\n        setData(result.data);\n      }\n\n      setLoading(false);\n    };\n\n    fetchData();\n  }, [selectedRange]);\n\n  const handleRangeChange = (range: PriceRange) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedRange(range);\n  };\n\n  if (error) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"flex h-[400px] items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-center\"&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"text-red-600 dark:text-red-400\"&gt;{error}&lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={() =&gt; handleRangeChange(selectedRange)}\n            className=\"mt-2 text-sm text-blue-600 hover:underline dark:text-blue-400\"\n          &gt;\n            Try again\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;TradingViewChart\n      data={data}\n      selectedRange={selectedRange}\n      onRangeChange={handleRangeChange}\n      loading={loading}\n      height={400}\n    /&gt;\n  );\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": ";",

            "isSignature": true

          },
          {
            "text": "export default function StockPriceChart({",

        "contents": "/**\n * Fetch latest Russell 2000 index price and intraday data for homepage\n */\nexport async function getRussellMarketData() {\n  try {\n    // Get latest index price from FMP API\n    const apiKey = process.env.FMP_API_KEY\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      return { error: 'API configuration error' }\n    }\n\n    // Fetch latest price quote for Russell 2000 index\n    const quoteUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/quote/^RUT?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n    const quoteResponse = await fetch(quoteUrl, {\n      next: { revalidate: 10 }, // Cache for 10 seconds (real-time data)\n    })\n\n    if (!quoteResponse.ok) {\n      console.error('FMP API error:', quoteResponse.status)\n      return { error: 'Failed to fetch price data' }\n    }\n\n    const quoteJson = await quoteResponse.json()\n    const priceData = quoteJson[0] // FMP returns array with one item\n\n    // Fetch 1-minute intraday data and aggregate into 10-minute candles\n    // FMP Premium tier includes 1-minute data for last 3 trading days\n    const intradayUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/historical-chart/1min/^RUT?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n    const intradayResponse = await fetch(intradayUrl, {\n      next: { revalidate: 10 }, // Cache for 10 seconds (real-time data)\n    })\n\n    let priceHistory = []\n    if (intradayResponse.ok) {\n      const intradayJson = await intradayResponse.json()\n}",

        "contents": "export async function askQuestion(\n  userQuestion: string,\n  conversationHistory: ConversationHistory = [],\n  sessionId: string = ''\n): Promise&lt;AskQuestionResponse&gt; {\n\n\n      if (toolResult.data.length &gt; MAX_PRICE_POINTS_FOR_LLM) {\n        // Provide summary data instead of all points\n        const first = toolResult.data[0]\n        const last = toolResult.data[toolResult.data.length - 1]\n        const prices = toolResult.data.map(d =&gt; d.close)\n        const high = Math.max(...prices)\n        const low = Math.min(...prices)\n\n        dataForLLM = {\n          summary: &#96;${toolResult.data.length} daily price records&#96;,\n          dateRange: { from: first.date, to: last.date },\n          priceRange: { high, low, start: first.close, end: last.close },\n          note: \"Full price data available in chart\"\n        }\n        console.log('📊 Using SUMMARY for LLM:', toolResult.data.length, 'records →', JSON.stringify(dataForLLM).length, 'chars')\n      } else {\n        dataForLLM = toolResult.data\n        console.log('📊 Using FULL data for LLM:', toolResult.data.length, 'records')\n      }\n\n      factsJson = createFactsJson(dataForLLM)\n      dataUsed = { type: 'prices', data: dataForLLM }\n\n      // Generate chart for price data (use range if available, otherwise use from-to)\n      const chartLabel = priceParams.range || (priceParams.from ? &#96;${priceParams.from} to ${priceParams.to || 'today'}&#96; : 'Price History')\n      chartConfig = generatePriceChart(toolResult.data, chartLabel)\n    } else if (toolSelection.tool === 'getRecentFilings') {\n      // Validate limit\n      const limit = toolSelection.args.limit || 5\n}",

        "contents": "export function generatePriceChart(data: PriceData[], range: string): ChartConfig | null {\n\n\n  // Also prepare volume data [timestamp, volume] for volume chart\n  const volumeData = dataToUse\n    .filter((d) =&gt; d.volume != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(d.volume))\n    .map((d) =&gt; {\n      const timestamp = new Date(d.date).getTime()\n      if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp) || !Number.isFinite(d.volume)) {\n        return null\n      }\n      return [timestamp, d.volume]\n    })\n    .filter((item): item is [number, number] =&gt; item !== null)\n\n  // Get first and last date for title\n  const firstDate = new Date(validData[0].date)\n  const lastDate = new Date(validData[validData.length - 1].date)\n\n  // Determine appropriate data grouping based on data point count\n  let dataGroupingUnits: [string, number[]][]\n  const dataPointCount = dataToUse.length\n\n  if (dataPointCount &lt;= 90) {\n    // 0-90 days: Daily grouping only\n    dataGroupingUnits = [['day', [1]]]\n  } else if (dataPointCount &lt;= 500) {\n    // 91-500 days (~2 years): Daily and weekly\n    dataGroupingUnits = [\n      ['day', [1]],\n      ['week', [1]]\n    ]\n  } else {\n    // 500+ days (2+ years): Daily, weekly, and monthly\n    dataGroupingUnits = [\n      ['day', [1]],\n      ['week', [1]],\n      ['month', [1]]\n    ]\n  }\n\n  // Ensure we have valid candlestick data\n  if (candlestickData.length === 0) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  // Create the config object\n  const config = {\n    type: 'candlestick' as const, // Candlestick charts show OHLC data\n    title: &#96;AAPL Stock Price (${formatDateRange(firstDate, lastDate)})&#96;,\n    data: candlestickData, // OHLC format: [timestamp, open, high, low, close]\n    volumeData, // Separate volume data for optional volume chart\n    categories: [] as string[], // Empty for time-series charts (uses timestamps instead)\n    yAxisLabel: 'Stock Price ($)',\n    xAxisLabel: 'Date',\n    dataGrouping: {\n      enabled: true,\n      units: dataGroupingUnits,\n      approximation: 'ohlc', // Use OHLC aggregation for candlesticks\n    },\n  }\n\n  // Validate that the config can be serialized to JSON\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getAaplPrices(params: PriceParams): Promise&lt;{\n  data: Array&lt;{ date: string; open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number; volume: number }&gt; | null\n  error: string | null\n}&gt; {\n\n\n    const json = await response.json()\n\n    // FMP returns: { symbol: \"AAPL\", historical: [{date, open, high, low, close, volume}, ...] }\n    if (!json.historical || !Array.isArray(json.historical)) {\n      console.error('Unexpected FMP response format:', json)\n\n      // Check if this is an API error message\n      if (json.error || json['Error Message']) {\n        const errorMsg = json.error || json['Error Message']\n        return { data: null, error: &#96;API error: ${errorMsg}&#96; }\n      }\n\n      // If it's an empty response, it might be because the date is too recent or market is closed\n      if (Object.keys(json).length === 0 || (json.historical &amp;&amp; json.historical.length === 0)) {\n        return {\n          data: null,\n          error: 'No price data available for this date. The market may be closed or data may not be available yet for today.'\n        }\n      }\n\n      return { data: null, error: 'Unexpected API response format' }\n    }\n\n    // Map and sort data (API already filtered by date parameters)\n    // Filter out any records with null/invalid OHLC values (including NaN and Infinity)\n    let filteredData: Array&lt;{ date: string; open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number; volume: number }&gt; = json.historical\n      .filter((item: any) =&gt;\n        item.date &amp;&amp;\n        item.open != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(item.open) &amp;&amp;\n        item.high != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(item.high) &amp;&amp;\n        item.low != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(item.low) &amp;&amp;\n        item.close != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(item.close) &amp;&amp;\n        item.volume != null &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(item.volume)\n      )\n      .map((item: any) =&gt; ({\n        date: item.date,\n        open: Number(item.open),\n        high: Number(item.high),\n        low: Number(item.low),\n        close: Number(item.close),\n        volume: Number(item.volume),\n      }))\n      .sort((a: any, b: any) =&gt; new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime()) // Most recent first\n\n    // If we asked for today specifically but got a wider range, return just the most recent trading day\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst stream = new \nasync start(controller) {\n\n\n            if (toolResult.error || !toolResult.data) {\n              flow.failStep('tool_execution', {\n                summary: 'Price data fetch failed',\n                why: toolResult.error || 'No data returned',\n                details: priceParams,\n              })\n              sendEvent('error', { message: toolResult.error || 'Failed to fetch price data' })\n              controller.close()\n              return\n            }\n\n            // Limit data sent to LLM and client to prevent JSON serialization errors\n            // For large datasets, provide summary statistics instead of all data points\n            const MAX_PRICE_POINTS_FOR_LLM = 50\n            let dataForLLM: any\n            let dataForClient: any\n\n            if (toolResult.data.length &gt; MAX_PRICE_POINTS_FOR_LLM) {\n              // Provide summary data instead of all points\n              // Note: data is sorted most recent first (descending by date)\n              const mostRecent = toolResult.data[0]\n              const oldest = toolResult.data[toolResult.data.length - 1]\n              const prices = toolResult.data.map(d =&gt; d.close)\n              const high = Math.max(...prices)\n              const low = Math.min(...prices)\n\n              // Calculate percentage change\n              const percentChange = ((mostRecent.close - oldest.close) / oldest.close) * 100\n\n              const summaryData = {\n                summary: &#96;${toolResult.data.length} daily price records&#96;,\n                dateRange: { from: oldest.date, to: mostRecent.date },\n                priceRange: { high, low, startPrice: oldest.close, endPrice: mostRecent.close },\n                percentChange: percentChange,\n                note: \"Full price data available in chart\"\n              }\n\n              dataForLLM = summaryData\n              dataForClient = summaryData  // Send summary to client too to prevent streaming errors\n              console.log('📊 Using SUMMARY for LLM &amp; client:', toolResult.data.length, 'records →', JSON.stringify(summaryData).length, 'chars')\n            }\n      }\n\n}",

        "contents": "export async function askQuestion(\n  userQuestion: string,\n  conversationHistory: ConversationHistory = [],\n  sessionId: string = ''\n): Promise&lt;AskQuestionResponse&gt; {\n {\n      // Support both preset ranges and custom dates\n      let priceParams: PriceParams\n\n      if ('range' in toolSelection.args) {\n        // Preset range mode\n        const range = toolSelection.args.range as PriceRange\n        const allowedRanges: PriceRange[] = ['7d', '30d', '90d', '365d', 'ytd', '3y', '5y', '10y', '20y', 'max']\n        if (!allowedRanges.includes(range)) {\n          return { answer: '', dataUsed: null, chartConfig: null, error: 'Invalid range', queryLogId: null }\n        }\n        priceParams = { range }\n      } else if ('from' in toolSelection.args) {\n        // Custom date range mode\n        const from = toolSelection.args.from as string\n        const to = toolSelection.args.to as string | undefined\n\n        // Basic date format validation\n        const dateRegex = /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/\n        if (!dateRegex.test(from)) {\n          return { answer: '', dataUsed: null, chartConfig: null, error: 'Invalid from date format', queryLogId: null }\n        }\n        if (to &amp;&amp; !dateRegex.test(to)) {\n          return { answer: '', dataUsed: null, chartConfig: null, error: 'Invalid to date format', queryLogId: null }\n        }\n\n        priceParams = to ? { from, to } : { from }\n      } else {\n        return { answer: '', dataUsed: null, chartConfig: null, error: 'Invalid getPrices args: must have range or from', queryLogId: null }\n      }\n\n      const toolResult = await getAaplPrices(priceParams)\n\n      if (toolResult.error || !toolResult.data) {\n        toolError = toolResult.error || 'Failed to fetch price data'\n        return {\n          answer: '',\n          dataUsed: null,\n          chartConfig: null,\n          error: toolError,\n          queryLogId: null,\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Limit data sent to LLM to prevent JSON serialization errors\n      // For large datasets, provide summary statistics instead of all data points\n      const MAX_PRICE_POINTS_FOR_LLM = 50\n      let dataForLLM: any\n\n      if (toolResult.data.length &gt; MAX_PRICE_POINTS_FOR_LLM)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Fetch latest Nasdaq index price and intraday data for homepage\n */\nexport async function getNasdaqMarketData() {\n  try {\n    // Get latest index price from FMP API\n    const apiKey = process.env.FMP_API_KEY\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      return { error: 'API configuration error' }\n    }\n\n    // Fetch latest price quote for Nasdaq Composite index\n    const quoteUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/quote/^IXIC?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n    const quoteResponse = await fetch(quoteUrl, {\n      next: { revalidate: 10 }, // Cache for 10 seconds (real-time data)\n    })\n\n    if (!quoteResponse.ok) {\n      console.error('FMP API error:', quoteResponse.status)\n      return { error: 'Failed to fetch price data' }\n    }\n\n    const quoteJson = await quoteResponse.json()\n    const priceData = quoteJson[0] // FMP returns array with one item\n\n    // Fetch 1-minute intraday data and aggregate into 10-minute candles\n    // FMP Premium tier includes 1-minute data for last 3 trading days\n    const intradayUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/historical-chart/1min/^IXIC?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n    const intradayResponse = await fetch(intradayUrl, {\n      next: { revalidate: 10 }, // Cache for 10 seconds (real-time data)\n    })\n\n    let priceHistory = []\n    if (intradayResponse.ok) {\n      const intradayJson = await intradayResponse.json()\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getAaplMarketData() {\n\n    }\n\n    // Fallback to daily data if no intraday data available (markets closed, weekend, etc)\n    if (priceHistory.length === 0) {\n      console.log('No intraday data, fetching daily historical data instead')\n      const dailyUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/historical-price-full/AAPL?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n      const dailyResponse = await fetch(dailyUrl, {\n        next: { revalidate: 3600 }, // Cache for 1 hour\n      })\n\n      if (dailyResponse.ok) {\n        const dailyJson = await dailyResponse.json()\n        // Get last 30 trading days\n        priceHistory = dailyJson?.historical?.slice(0, 30).reverse() || []\n        console.log('Daily data fetched:', {\n          count: priceHistory.length,\n          first: priceHistory[0],\n          last: priceHistory[priceHistory.length - 1]\n        })\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Get the date - prefer price history date (actual candle date), then quote timestamp\n    // When market is open, priceHistory has today's intraday candles\n    const historyDate = priceHistory.length &gt; 0\n      ? priceHistory[priceHistory.length - 1].date.split(' ')[0]  // Use most recent candle date\n      : null\n    const quoteDate = priceData.timestamp\n      ? new Date(priceData.timestamp * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0]\n      : null\n    const actualDate = historyDate || quoteDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]\n\n    return {\n      currentPrice: priceData.price,\n      priceChange: priceData.change,\n      priceChangePercent: priceData.changesPercentage,\n      date: actualDate,\n      priceHistory: priceHistory,\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error in getAaplMarketData:', error)\n    return { error: 'Failed to fetch market data' }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Fetch latest Nasdaq index price and intraday data for homepage\n */\nexport async function getNasdaqMarketData() {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getRussellMarketData() {\n\n    }\n\n    // Fallback to daily data if no intraday data available (markets closed, weekend, etc)\n    if (priceHistory.length === 0) {\n      console.log('No intraday data, fetching daily historical data instead (Russell)')\n      const dailyUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/historical-price-full/^RUT?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n      const dailyResponse = await fetch(dailyUrl, {\n        next: { revalidate: 3600 }, // Cache for 1 hour\n      })\n\n      if (dailyResponse.ok) {\n        const dailyJson = await dailyResponse.json()\n        // Get last 30 trading days\n        priceHistory = dailyJson?.historical?.slice(0, 30).reverse() || []\n        console.log('Daily data fetched (Russell):', {\n          count: priceHistory.length,\n          first: priceHistory[0],\n          last: priceHistory[priceHistory.length - 1]\n        })\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Get the date - prefer price history date (actual candle date), then quote timestamp\n    // When market is open, priceHistory has today's intraday candles\n    const historyDate = priceHistory.length &gt; 0\n      ? priceHistory[priceHistory.length - 1].date.split(' ')[0]  // Use most recent candle date\n      : null\n    const quoteDate = priceData.timestamp\n      ? new Date(priceData.timestamp * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0]\n      : null\n    const actualDate = historyDate || quoteDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]\n\n    return {\n      currentPrice: priceData.price,\n      priceChange: priceData.change,\n      priceChangePercent: priceData.changesPercentage,\n      date: actualDate,\n      priceHistory: priceHistory,\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error in getRussellMarketData:', error)\n    return { error: 'Failed to fetch market data' }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Fetch recent financial data for chart (last 5 years)\n */\nexport async function getAaplFinancialHistory() {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst stream = new \nasync start(controller) {\n  // Send summary to client too to prevent streaming errors\n              console.log('📊 Using SUMMARY for LLM &amp; client:', toolResult.data.length, 'records →', JSON.stringify(summaryData).length, 'chars')\n            } else {\n              dataForLLM = toolResult.data\n              dataForClient = toolResult.data\n              console.log('📊 Using FULL data for LLM &amp; client:', toolResult.data.length, 'records')\n            }\n\n            factsJson = JSON.stringify(dataForLLM)  // NO pretty-printing (no , null, 2)\n            dataUsed = { type: 'prices', data: dataForClient }\n            flow.startStep({\n              step: 'chart_generation',\n              group: 'answering',\n              summary: &#96;Preparing ${chartLabel} price chart&#96;,\n              why: 'Visualizing price movement',\n              details: { priceParams, source: 'prices' },\n            })\n            chartConfig = generatePriceChart(toolResult.data, chartLabel)  // Chart still gets full dataset\n            if (chartConfig) {\n              const pointCount =\n                Array.isArray((chartConfig as any)?.data) &amp;&amp; (chartConfig as any).data.length\n                  ?         "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst stream = new \nasync start(controller) {\n {\n            // Only support custom date ranges\n            if (!('from' in toolSelection.args)) {\n              flow.failStep('tool_execution', {\n                summary: 'Failed to execute tool',\n                why: 'Invalid getPrices args: must have from date',\n                details: toolSelection.args,\n              })\n              sendEvent('error', { message: 'Invalid getPrices args: must have from date' })\n              controller.close()\n              return\n            }\n\n            const from = toolSelection.args.from as string\n            const to = toolSelection.args.to as string | undefined\n\n            // Basic date format validation\n            const dateRegex = /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/\n            if (!dateRegex.test(from)) {\n              flow.failStep('tool_execution', {\n                summary: 'Failed to execute tool',\n                why: &#96;Invalid from date format \"${from}\"&#96;,\n                details: { from },\n              })\n              sendEvent('error', { message: 'Invalid from date format' })\n              controller.close()\n              return\n            }\n            if (to &amp;&amp; !dateRegex.test(to)) {\n              flow.failStep('tool_execution', {\n                summary: 'Failed to execute tool',\n                why: &#96;Invalid to date format \"${to}\"&#96;,\n                details: { to },\n              })\n              sendEvent('error', { message: 'Invalid to date format' })\n              controller.close()\n              return\n            }\n\n            const priceParams: PriceParams = to ? { from, to } : { from }\n            const chartLabel = &#96;${from} to ${to || 'today'}&#96;\n\n            const toolResult = await getAaplPrices(priceParams)\n\n            if (toolResult.error || !toolResult.data)\n      }\n\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getDowMarketData() {\n\n    }\n\n    // Fallback to daily data if no intraday data available (markets closed, weekend, etc)\n    if (priceHistory.length === 0) {\n      console.log('No intraday data, fetching daily historical data instead (Dow)')\n      const dailyUrl = &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/historical-price-full/^DJI?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;\n      const dailyResponse = await fetch(dailyUrl, {\n        next: { revalidate: 3600 }, // Cache for 1 hour\n      })\n\n      if (dailyResponse.ok) {\n        const dailyJson = await dailyResponse.json()\n        // Get last 30 trading days\n        priceHistory = dailyJson?.historical?.slice(0, 30).reverse() || []\n        console.log('Daily data fetched (Dow):', {\n          count: priceHistory.length,\n          first: priceHistory[0],\n          last: priceHistory[priceHistory.length - 1]\n        })\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Get the date - prefer price history date (actual candle date), then quote timestamp\n    // When market is open, priceHistory has today's intraday candles\n    const historyDate = priceHistory.length &gt; 0\n      ? priceHistory[priceHistory.length - 1].date.split(' ')[0]  // Use most recent candle date\n      : null\n    const quoteDate = priceData.timestamp\n      ? new Date(priceData.timestamp * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0]\n      : null\n    const actualDate = historyDate || quoteDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]\n\n    return {\n      currentPrice: priceData.price,\n      priceChange: priceData.change,\n      priceChangePercent: priceData.changesPercentage,\n      date: actualDate,\n      priceHistory: priceHistory,\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error in getDowMarketData:', error)\n    return { error: 'Failed to fetch market data' }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Fetch latest Russell 2000 index price and intraday data for homepage\n */\nexport async function getRussellMarketData() {\n  try\n}",

priceHistory[priceHistory.length - 1].date.split(' ')[0]  // Use most recent candle date\n      : null\n    const quoteDate = priceData.timestamp\n      ? new Date(priceData.timestamp * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0]\n      : null\n    const actualDate = historyDate || quoteDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]\n\n    return {\n      currentPrice: priceData.price,\n      priceChange: priceData.change,\n      priceChangePercent: priceData.changesPercentage,\n      date: actualDate,\n      priceHistory: priceHistory,\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error in getNasdaqMarketData:', error)\n    return { error: 'Failed to fetch market data' }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Fetch latest Dow Jones index price and intraday data for homepage\n */\nexport async function getDowMarketData() {\n  try\n}",

## Changes Made:

1. **Fixed date filtering logic** in `prices.ts`:
   - Changed `isAskingForToday` to `isAskingForTodayOnly` — only triggers when both `from` and `to` are today
   - Previously, any range ending today (like 1Y) would trigger the fallback and limit data to 5 days
   - Now it only limits data when explicitly requesting today's data

2. **Improved date formatting** in `TradingViewChart.tsx`:
   - Handles dates with or without time components
   - Ensures dates are in `YYYY-MM-DD` format for lightweight-charts

3. **Removed debug logs** for cleaner code

The chart should now display all candles for the selected range (1Y, 3Y, etc.) instead of just one. The issue was that ranges ending today were incorrectly treated as "today only" requests, which limited the data.

Refresh the page and select a range like "1Y" to see all candles.
