        "contents": "export default function FinancialsModal({ isOpen, onClose }: FinancialsModalProps) {\n  const [companies, setCompanies] = useState&lt;CompanyWithFinancials[] | null&gt;(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null)\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (isOpen &amp;&amp; !companies) {\n      loadFinancials()\n    }\n  }, [isOpen])\n\n  const loadFinancials = async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true)\n    setError(null)\n    const result = await getCompaniesWithFinancials()\n    if (result.error) {\n      setError(result.error)\n    } else {\n      setCompanies(result.data)\n    }\n    setLoading(false)\n  }\n\n  if (!isOpen) return null\n\n  // Get the first company (AAPL) for display\n  const company = companies?.[0]\n  const financials = company?.financials_std || []\n\n  // Get last 3 years only (descending for display)\n  const years = [...financials]\n    .sort((a, b) =&gt; b.year - a.year)\n    .slice(0, 3)\n    .map(f =&gt; f.year)\n\n  // Filter financials to only include those 3 years\n  const filteredFinancials = financials.filter(f =&gt; years.includes(f.year))\n\n  // Sort by year ascending for proper sparkline direction\n  const sortedFinancials = [...filteredFinancials].sort((a, b) =&gt; a.year - b.year)\n\n  // Helper to get value for a specific year\n  const getValue = (year: number, field: keyof FinancialRow): number | null =&gt; {\n    const record = financials.find(f =&gt; f.year === year)\n    return record ? (record[field] as number | null) : null\n  }\n\n\n  // Metric row component\n  const MetricRow = (\n\n}",

        "contents": "export default function FinancialsModal({ isOpen, onClose }: FinancialsModalProps) {\n\n\n\n  // Metric row component\n  const MetricRow = ({\n    label,\n    field,\n    formatFn = formatLargeNumber,\n    isPercentage = false\n  }: {\n    label: string\n    field: keyof FinancialRow | 'calculated'\n    formatFn?: (value: number | null) =&gt; string\n    isPercentage?: boolean\n  }) =&gt; {\n    let values: (number | null)[] = []\n\n    if (field === 'calculated') {\n      // For calculated fields, we'll handle them separately\n      values = years.map(() =&gt; null)\n    } else {\n      values = years.map(year =&gt; getValue(year, field))\n    }\n\n    return (\n      &lt;tr className=\"hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700\"&gt;\n        &lt;td className=\"px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 font-medium\"&gt;{label}&lt;/td&gt;\n        {values.map((value, idx) =&gt; (\n          &lt;td key={idx} className=\"px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 text-right\"&gt;\n            {formatFn(value)}\n          &lt;/td&gt;\n        ))}\n      &lt;/tr&gt;\n    )\n  }\n\n  // Special metric row for calculated values\n  const CalculatedRow = ({\n    label,\n    calculator,\n    formatFn = formatLargeNumber\n  }: {\n    label: string\n    calculator: (year: number) =&gt; number | null\n    formatFn?: (value: number | null) =&gt; string\n  }) =&gt; {\n    const values = years.map(calculator)\n\n    return (\n      &lt;tr className=\"hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700\"&gt;\n        &lt;td className=\"px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 font-medium\"&gt;{label}&lt;/td&gt;\n        {values.map((value, idx) =&gt; (\n          &lt;td key={idx} className=\"px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 text-right\"&gt;\n            {formatFn(value)}\n          &lt;/td&gt;\n        ))}\n      &lt;/tr&gt;\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Get all financial statements for the last 5 years\n * Returns income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow data\n * Currently hardcoded to AAPL\n */\nexport async function getAllFinancials(): Promise&lt;AllFinancials&gt; {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient();\n\n    // Fetch last 5 years of financial data\n    const { data: financialsData, error } = await supabase\n      .from('financials_std')\n      .select('*')\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n      .limit(5);\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching financials:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (!financialsData || financialsData.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        incomeStatement: [],\n        balanceSheet: [],\n        cashFlow: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Transform data into separate statement arrays\n    const incomeStatement: FinancialYear[] = financialsData.map((row) =&gt; {\n      const revenue = row.revenue || 0;\n      const costOfRevenue = row.cost_of_revenue || 0;\n      const grossProfit = row.gross_profit || 0;\n      const operatingIncome = row.operating_income || 0;\n      const netIncome = row.net_income || 0;\n\n      return {\n        year: row.year,\n        revenue,\n        costOfRevenue,\n        grossProfit,\n        grossMargin: revenue &gt; 0 ? (grossProfit / revenue) * 100 : 0,\n        operatingExpenses: grossProfit - operatingIncome, // Derived\n        operatingIncome,\n        operatingMargin: revenue &gt; 0 ? (operatingIncome / revenue) * 100 : 0,\n        netIncome,\n        netMargin: revenue &gt; 0 ? (netIncome / revenue) * 100 : 0,\n        eps: row.eps || 0,\n      };\n    });\n\n    const balanceSheet: BalanceSheetYear[] = financialsData.map\n;\n}",

        "contents": "# Financial Metrics for AAPL\n\nThis document details all financial metrics (primitives and calculated) available for Apple Inc. (AAPL) in the Fin Quote system.\n\n---\n\n## Data Coverage\n\n- **Ticker**: AAPL (Apple Inc.)\n- **Years Available**: 2006 - 2025 (20 years)\n- **Data Source**: Financial Modeling Prep API\n- **Database Table**: &#96;financials_std&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Raw Financial Metrics (Primitives)\n\nThese metrics are stored directly in the database and fetched from the Financial Modeling Prep API.\n\n### Income Statement Metrics\n\n| Metric | Database Field | Description | Unit |\n|--------|---------------|-------------|------|\n| **Revenue** | &#96;revenue&#96; | Total revenue (sales) for the fiscal year | USD |\n| **Gross Profit** | &#96;gross_profit&#96; | Revenue minus cost of goods sold (COGS) | USD |\n| **Operating Income** | &#96;operating_income&#96; | Profit from core business operations (EBIT) | USD |\n| **Net Income** | &#96;net_income&#96; | Bottom line profit after all expenses and taxes | USD |\n| **EPS** | &#96;eps&#96; | Earnings per share (diluted) | USD per share |\n\n### Balance Sheet Metrics\n\n| Metric | Database Field | Description | Unit |\n|--------|---------------|-------------|------|\n| **Total Assets** | &#96;total_assets&#96; | Sum of all assets owned by the company | USD |\n| **Total Liabilities** | &#96;total_liabilities&#96; | Sum of all debts and obligations | USD |\n| **Shareholders' Equity** | &#96;shareholders_equity&#96; | Net worth of the company (Assets - Liabilities) | USD |\n\n### Cash Flow Statement Metrics\n\n| Metric | Database Field | Description | Unit |\n|--------|---------------|-------------|------|\n| **Operating Cash Flow** | &#96;operating_cash_flow&#96; | Cash generated from core business operations | USD |\n\n---\n\n## Calculated Financial Metrics (Derived)\n\nThese metrics are computed on-the-fly from raw metrics when requested. They are not stored in the database.\n\n### Profitability Ratios\n\n#### Gross Margin\n- **Formula**: &#96;(gross_profit / revenue) × 100&#96;\n- **Unit**: Percentage (%)\n- **Description**: Percentage of revenue retained after accounting for cost of goods sold. Higher is better.\n- **Interpretation**:\n  - Shows how efficiently a company produces its goods",

        "contents": "# Database Structure &amp; Chatbot Optimization Guide\n\n## Current Database Structure\n\n### Core Tables for Chatbot\n\n#### 1. &#96;financials_std&#96; - Standard Financial Data (Wide Table)\n**Purpose**: Stores basic financial metrics in columns (one row per year)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nColumns:\n- symbol (TEXT) - Stock ticker (e.g., 'AAPL')\n- year (INTEGER) - Fiscal year\n- revenue (NUMERIC)\n- gross_profit (NUMERIC)\n- net_income (NUMERIC)\n- operating_income (NUMERIC)\n- total_assets (NUMERIC)\n- total_liabilities (NUMERIC)\n- shareholders_equity (NUMERIC)\n- operating_cash_flow (NUMERIC)\n- eps (NUMERIC)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**How Chatbot Uses It**:\n- Query: &#96;SELECT year, revenue FROM financials_std WHERE symbol='AAPL' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 5&#96;\n- Returns: &#96;[{year: 2024, revenue: 383285000000}, {year: 2023, revenue: 383285000000}]&#96;\n- Sent to LLM as JSON string in prompt\n\n**Pros**:\n- Fast queries for single metrics\n- All related data in one row\n- Easy to calculate ratios (has all fields together)\n\n**Cons**:\n- Can't add new metrics without schema changes\n- Wastes space if most fields are NULL\n- Inconsistent with &#96;financial_metrics&#96; table structure\n\n---\n\n#### 2. &#96;financial_metrics&#96; - Extended Metrics (Key-Value Table)\n**Purpose**: Stores 96+ advanced metrics in key-value format (one row per metric per year)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nColumns:\n- symbol (TEXT)\n- year (INTEGER)\n- period (TEXT) - 'FY', 'Q1', 'Q2', etc.\n- metric_name (TEXT) - e.g., 'peRatio', 'marketCap', 'returnOnEquity'\n- metric_value (NUMERIC)\n- metric_category (TEXT) - 'Valuation', 'Profitability', etc.\n- data_source (TEXT) - 'FMP', 'Calculated', 'SEC'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**How Chatbot Uses It**:\n- Query: &#96;SELECT year, metric_name, metric_value FROM financial_metrics WHERE symbol='AAPL' AND metric_name IN ('peRatio', 'roe') ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10&#96;\n- Returns: &#96;[{year: 2024, metric_name: 'peRatio', metric_value: 28.5}, ...]&#96;\n- Sent to LLM as JSON string\n\n**Pros**:\n- Flexible: Easy to add new metrics\n- Supports multiple metrics per query\n- Categorized for organization\n\n**Cons**:\n- More rows = slower queries\n- Requires multiple rows for one year's data",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/migrations/20241106000001_create_financial_metrics_table.sql",

        "contents": "-- Create financial_metrics table for key-value metric storage\n-- This table stores ~96 financial metrics from FMP API for AAPL\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS financial_metrics (\n  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,\n  year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  period TEXT, -- 'FY' for annual, 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4' for quarterly\n  metric_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  metric_value NUMERIC,\n  metric_category TEXT, -- 'Valuation', 'Profitability', 'Growth', etc.\n  data_source TEXT DEFAULT 'FMP', -- 'FMP', 'Calculated', 'SEC'\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n\n  -- Composite unique constraint: one value per symbol/year/period/metric\n  CONSTRAINT unique_metric_per_period UNIQUE (symbol, year, period, metric_name)\n);\n\n-- Create indexes for fast queries\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year ON financial_metrics(symbol, year);\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_metric_name ON financial_metrics(metric_name);\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_category ON financial_metrics(metric_category);\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year_metric ON financial_metrics(symbol, year, metric_name);\n\n-- Add RLS (Row Level Security)\nALTER TABLE financial_metrics ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- Allow anyone to read financial metrics (public data)\nCREATE POLICY \"Allow public read access to financial metrics\"\n  ON financial_metrics\n  FOR SELECT\n  USING (true);\n\n-- Add comment\nCOMMENT ON TABLE financial_metrics IS 'Key-value storage for 96+ financial metrics from FMP API. Supports annual and quarterly data.';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.metric_name IS 'Metric identifier (e.g., \"marketCap\", \"peRatio\", \"grossMargin\")';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.metric_value IS 'Numeric value of the metric';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.metric_category IS 'Category from stock_metrics_master.csv (e.g., \"Valuation\", \"Profitability &amp; Returns\")';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN financial_metrics.data_source IS 'Data source: FMP API endpoints, calculated from existing data, or SEC filings';",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {

            "text": "  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,",

          {
            "text": "  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,",

            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  metric_name TEXT NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  metric_value NUMERIC,",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "  metric_category TEXT, -- 'Valuation', 'Profitability', 'Growth', etc.",

          {
            "text": "  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "  -- Composite unique constraint: one value per symbol/year/period/metric",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  CONSTRAINT unique_metric_per_period UNIQUE (symbol, year, period, metric_name)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Create indexes for fast queries",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year ON financial_metrics(symbol, year);",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_metric_name ON financial_metrics(metric_name);",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_category ON financial_metrics(metric_category);",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE INDEX idx_financial_metrics_symbol_year_metric ON financial_metrics(symbol, year, metric_name);",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Add RLS (Row Level Security)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "ALTER TABLE financial_metrics ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Allow anyone to read financial metrics (public data)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"Allow public read access to financial metrics\"",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  ON financial_metrics",

          },
          {
            "text": "  FOR SELECT",

          },

            "text": "  USING (true);",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Add comment",

          },
          {
            "text": "COMMENT ON TABLE financial_metrics IS 'Key-value storage for 96+ financial metrics from FMP API. Supports annual and quarterly data.';",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },

        "contents": "/**\n * Get key statistics for stock detail page\n * Combines data from financial_metrics table and FMP API\n * Currently hardcoded to AAPL\n */\nexport async function getStockKeyStats(): Promise&lt;StockKeyStats&gt; {\n  const symbol = 'AAPL';\n  const apiKey = process.env.FMP_API_KEY;\n\n  if (!apiKey) {\n    throw new Error('FMP_API_KEY is not set');\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createServerClient();\n\n    // Fetch latest metrics from financial_metrics table (key-value format)\n    const { data: metricsData, error: metricsError } = await supabase\n      .from('financial_metrics')\n      .select('metric_name, metric_value, year')\n      .eq('symbol', symbol)\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n      .limit(200); // Get enough rows to cover all metrics for the latest year\n\n    if (metricsError) {\n      console.error('Error fetching financial metrics:', metricsError);\n    }\n\n    // Transform key-value rows into an object with metric names as keys\n    const latestMetrics: Record&lt;string, number&gt; = {};\n    metricsData?.forEach((row) =&gt; {\n      if (!latestMetrics[row.metric_name]) {\n        latestMetrics[row.metric_name] = row.metric_value;\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Fetch key metrics from FMP API for real-time data\n    const [quoteRes, keyMetricsRes] = await Promise.all([\n      fetch(\n        &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/quote/${symbol}?apikey=${apiKey}&#96;,\n        { next: { revalidate: 60 } }\n      ),\n      fetch(\n        &#96;https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/key-metrics/${symbol}?limit=1&amp;apikey=${apiKey}&#96;,\n        { next: { revalidate: 3600 } } // Cache for 1 hour\n      ),\n    ]);\n\n    const quoteData = await quoteRes.json();\n    const keyMetricsData = await keyMetricsRes.json();\n\n    const quote = quoteData?.[0] || {};\n    const keyMetrics = keyMetricsData?.[0] || {};\n\n    // Fetch latest financials for TTM data\n    const { data: financialsData } = await supabase\n      .from('financials_std')\n      .select('*')\n      .order('year', { ascending: false })\n      .limit(1);\n\n    const latestFinancials = financialsData?.[0] || {};\n}",

        "contents": "# Multi-Company Comparison Implementation Plan\n\n## Phase 1: Data Layer\n1. Create &#96;companies&#96; table with S&amp;P 500 tickers + metadata\n2. Expand FMP fetch scripts to loop through companies\n3. Ingest financials for top 100 companies into existing tables\n\n## Phase 2: Tool Updates\n1. Rename &#96;getAaplFinancialsByMetric&#96; → &#96;getFinancialsByMetric&#96;\n2. Add &#96;symbols: string[]&#96; parameter (default: &#96;[\"AAPL\"]&#96; for backwards compat)\n3. Update &#96;getFinancialMetric&#96;, &#96;getPrices&#96; similarly\n4. Add &#96;searchCompanies&#96; tool for ticker lookup (\"Microsoft\" → \"MSFT\")\n\n## Phase 3: Prompt Updates (&#96;lib/tools.ts&#96;)\n1. Add company extraction rules to tool selection prompt\n2. Examples:\n   - \"Compare Apple and Microsoft revenue\" → &#96;symbols: [\"AAPL\", \"MSFT\"]&#96;\n   - \"AAPL vs GOOGL P/E\" → &#96;symbols: [\"AAPL\", \"GOOGL\"]&#96;\n3. Handle ambiguity: \"Compare tech giants\" → ask user to specify\n\n## Phase 4: Server Actions\n1. Update queries: &#96;.eq('symbol', 'AAPL')&#96; → &#96;.in('symbol', symbols)&#96;\n2. Return data grouped by symbol\n3. Add company name to response for display\n\n## Phase 5: Charts\n1. Multi-series Highcharts config (one series per company)\n2. Color coding by company\n3.             "text": "   - Debt-to-Assets = total_liabilities / total_assets",
            "lineNumber": 646
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 647
          },
          {
            "text": "   EFFICIENCY RATIOS:",
            "lineNumber": 648
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Asset Turnover = revenue / total_assets",
            "lineNumber": 649
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Cash Flow Margin = (operating_cash_flow / revenue) × 100",
            "lineNumber": 650
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 651
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If user asks for a \"margin\" or \"ratio\", calculate it from the available data",
            "lineNumber": 652
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Show the calculation concisely with formatted numbers",
            "lineNumber": 653
          },
          {
            "text": "   - For margins (profitability), show as percentage: \"Gross margin is 46.2% ($180.7B gross profit / $391.0B revenue)\"",
            "lineNumber": 654
          },
          {
            "text": "   - For ratios (leverage, efficiency), show as decimal: \"Debt-to-equity ratio is 3.87 ($285.5B liabilities / $73.7B equity)\"",
            "lineNumber": 655
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 656
          },
          {
            "text": "7. ⚠️ CRITICAL: EXTENDED METRICS FORMATTING (from financial_metrics table):",
            "lineNumber": 657
          },
          {
            "text": "   When the facts JSON contains \"metric_name\" and \"metric_value\" fields, you MUST apply these formatting rules:",
            "lineNumber": 658
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 659
          },
          {
            "text": "   PERCENTAGE METRICS - MULTIPLY BY 100 AND ADD %:",
            "lineNumber": 660
          },
          {
            "text": "   ❌ WRONG: \"ROE is 1.52\" or \"ROE is 1.50\"",
            "lineNumber": 661
          },
          {
            "text": "   ✅ CORRECT: \"ROE is 152%\" or \"ROE is 150%\"",
            "lineNumber": 662
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 663
          },
          {
            "text": "   - returnOnEquity (ROE): If data shows 1.52, write \"152%\"",
            "lineNumber": 664
          },
          {
            "text": "   - returnOnAssets (ROA): If data shows 0.28, write \"28%\"",
            "lineNumber": 665
          },
          {
            "text": "   - returnOnCapitalEmployed (ROCE): If data shows 0.35, write \"35%\"",
            "lineNumber": 666
          },
          {
            "text": "   - grossProfitMargin: If data shows 0.46, write \"46%\"",
            "lineNumber": 667
          },
          {
            "text": "   - operatingProfitMargin, netProfitMargin: Same rule",
            "lineNumber": 668
          },
          {
            "text": "   - All metrics ending in \"Margin\", \"Growth\", \"Yield\": multiply by 100, add %",
            "lineNumber": 669
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 670
          },
          {
            "text": "   RATIO METRICS (show as decimal, 2 places, NO multiplication):",
            "lineNumber": 671
          },
          {
            "text": "   - peRatio, pbRatio, priceToSalesRatio → \"P/E ratio is 28.50\"",
            "lineNumber": 672
          },
          {
            "text": "   - currentRatio, quickRatio, cashRatio → \"Current ratio is 1.23\"",
            "lineNumber": 673
          },
          {
            "text": "   - debtEquityRatio, debtToAssets → \"Debt-to-equity is 1.87\"",
            "lineNumber": 674
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 675
          },
          {
            "text": "   CURRENCY METRICS (format with $ and B/M):",
            "lineNumber": 676
          },
          {
            "text": "   - marketCap, enterpriseValue → \"$3.5T\" or \"$350B\"",
            "lineNumber": 677
          },
          {
            "text": "   - freeCashFlow, operatingCashFlow → \"$100.5B\"",
            "lineNumber": 678
          },
          {
            "text": "   - bookValuePerShare, cashPerShare → \"$4.25\"",
            "lineNumber": 679
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 680
          },
          {
            "text": "   DAYS METRICS (show as whole number with \"days\"):",
            "lineNumber": 681
          },
          {
            "text": "   - daysOfInventoryOnHand, daysPayablesOutstanding → \"45 days\"",
            "lineNumber": 682
          },
          {
            "text": "   - cashConversionCycle → \"-35 days\" (can be negative)",
            "lineNumber": 683
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 684
          },
          {
            "text": "   ALWAYS round to 2 decimal places maximum. NEVER show raw decimal values.",
            "lineNumber": 685
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 686
          },
          {
            "text": "General Instructions:",
            "lineNumber": 687
          },
          {
            "text": "- Be concise and clear.",
            "lineNumber": 688
          },
          {
            "text": "- If the user asks for a SPECIFIC YEAR (e.g., \"in 2020\", \"for 2018\"), check if that year exists in the facts:",
            "lineNumber": 689
          },
          {
            "text": "  * If the year IS in the facts → provide the data directly and clearly",
            "lineNumber": 690
          },
          {
            "text": "  * If the year is NOT in the facts → say \"I don't have data for [year].\" and stop",
            "lineNumber": 691
          },
          {
            "text": "- If the user asks for multiple years or a trend, show all relevant years.",
            "lineNumber": 692
          },
          {
            "text": "- If trend is relevant (and the user asked for it), describe it (e.g., increasing/decreasing/flat).",
            "lineNumber": 693
          },
          {
            "text": "- Do not invent numbers or sources.",
            "lineNumber": 694
          },
          {
            "text": "- Respond in plain text sentences. Do NOT use Markdown formatting (no bullet lists, bold, italics, tables, or code blocks).",
            "lineNumber": 695
          },
          {
            "text": "- When there is only ONE data point, provide a concise single-sentence answer with the year and value. Do NOT mention any chart or table.",
            "lineNumber": 696
          },
          {
            "text": "- When there are 2-4 data points AND the user did NOT explicitly ask for a chart/graph, list them briefly in your answer.",
            "lineNumber": 697
          },
          {
            "text": "- When there are 2-4 data points AND the user explicitly asked for a chart/graph/visualization, briefly mention the key values and direct them to check the chart below.",
            "lineNumber": 698
          },
          {
            "text": "- When more than four data points are relevant, do not list each one. Write at most two sentences: the first calls out the earliest year/value, latest year/value, and any notable high/low WITH the percentage change; the second describes the overall trend and tells the user to check the chart and data table below for the full yearly breakdown.",
            "lineNumber": 699
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 700
          },
          {
            "text": "Examples:",
            "lineNumber": 701
          },
          {
            "text": "- Question: \"What was net income in 2020?\" → Answer: \"AAPL's net income in 2020 was $57.4 billion.\" (Only 2020, exact number)",
            "lineNumber": 702
          },
          {
            "text": "- Question: \"What's the revenue trend?\" → Answer: \"Revenue increased from $274.5B in 2020 to $383.3B in 2024.\" (Show trend, exact numbers)",
            "lineNumber": 703
          },
          {
            "text": "- Question: \"Revenue in 2020 vs 2024?\" → Answer: \"Revenue was $274.5B in 2020 and $383.3B in 2024, a 40% increase.\" (Compare as requested, exact numbers)",
            "lineNumber": 704
          },
          {
            "text": "- Question: \"What's the gross margin?\" → Answer: \"AAPL's gross margin in 2024 is 46.2% (gross profit of $180.7B divided by revenue of $391.0B).\" (Calculate ratio from data)",
            "lineNumber": 705
          },
          {
            "text": "- Question: \"Chart of debt to equity ratio last 5 years\" → Answer: \"The debt-to-equity ratio decreased from 2.61 in 2022 to 0.11 in 2025; check the chart below for the full trend.\" (User asked for chart, direct them to it)",
            "lineNumber": 706
          },
          {
            "text": "- Question: \"Show year to date performance\" → Answer: \"AAPL is up 9.88% year-to-date, from $243.85 to $267.93 as of the latest date in the data. Check the data table below for the full yearly breakdown.\" (Calculate percentage, format prices with $, mention trend)",
            "lineNumber": 707
          },
          {
            "text": "- Question: \"What did AAPL say about risk factors in their latest 10-K? provide quotes.\" → Answer: \"According to the 10-K filed November 1, 2024, Apple identifies several main risks: 'The Company is exposed to the risk of write-downs on the value of its inventory and other assets, in addition to purchase commitment cancellation risk.' The filing also notes that 'rapid technological change and competitive dynamics could materially adversely affect the Company's business, results of operations and financial condition.'\" (Provide direct quotes from chunk_text with proper citation)",

            "lineNumber": 709
          },
          {
            "text": "}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Converts financial data to chart configuration\n */\nexport function generateFinancialChart(\n  data: FinancialData[],\n  metric: string,\n  userQuestion?: string\n): ChartConfig | null {\n  // Edge case: no data\n  if (!data || data.length === 0) return null\n\n  // Apply smart filtering based on user question\n  const filteredData = userQuestion ? getFilteredYearRange(userQuestion, data) : data\n\n  // Sort by year ascending\n  const sortedData = [...filteredData].sort((a, b) =&gt; a.year - b.year)\n  const validData = sortedData.filter((d) =&gt; d.value != null &amp;&amp; !isNaN(d.value))\n  if (validData.length === 0) return null\n\n  // Don't generate chart for single data point\n  if (validData.length === 1) return null\n\n  const categories = validData.map((d) =&gt; d.year.toString())\n\n  // ===============================================\n  // HANDLE NATIVE CALCULATED METRICS\n  // ===============================================\n\n  if (metric === 'debt_to_equity_ratio') {\n    const values = validData.map((d) =&gt; parseFloat(d.value.toFixed(2)))\n    return {\n      type: 'line',\n      title: &#96;AAPL Debt-to-Equity Ratio (${categories[0]}-${categories[categories.length - 1]})&#96;,\n      data: values,\n      categories,\n      yAxisLabel: 'Ratio',\n      xAxisLabel: 'Year',\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (metric === 'gross_margin') {\n    const values = validData.map((d) =&gt; parseFloat(d.value.toFixed(1)))\n    return {\n      type: 'column',\n      title: &#96;AAPL Gross Margin (${categories[0]}-${categories[categories.length - 1]})&#96;,\n      data: values,\n      categories,\n      yAxisLabel: 'Margin (%)',\n      xAxisLabel: 'Year',\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (metric === 'roe') {\n    const values = validData.map((d) =&gt; parseFloat(d.value.toFixed(1)))\n    return {\n      type: 'line',\n      title: &#96;AAPL Return on Equity (${categories[0]}-${categories[categories.length - 1]})&#96;,\n      data: values,\n      categories,\n      yAxisLabel: 'ROE (%)',\n      xAxisLabel: 'Year',\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ===============================================\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Extracts years from question and returns filtered year range based on distance-based context\n * Option A: Distance-Based Context\n * - Current year (2025): Show 3 years before → [2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]\n * - Other years: Show 2 years before and 2 years after → [year-2, year-1, year, year+1, year+2]\n * - 3+ years mentioned: Show exact years only (no context)\n */\nfunction getFilteredYearRange(question: string, availableData: any[]): any[] {\n  if (!question || !availableData || availableData.length === 0) {\n    return availableData\n  }\n\n  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear()\n\n  // Extract explicit years (e.g., 2023, 2024, 2025)\n  const explicitYears = [...question.matchAll(/\\b(20\\d{2})\\b/g)].map(match =&gt; parseInt(match[1]))\n\n  // Extract \"last N years\" or \"past N years\"\n  const lastYearsMatch = question.match(/(?:last|past)\\s+(\\d+)\\s+years?/i)\n  let mentionedYears: number[] = []\n\n  if (lastYearsMatch) {\n    const n = parseInt(lastYearsMatch[1])\n    // \"last 5 years\" means current year back to current-4\n    for (let i = 0; i &lt; n; i++) {\n      mentionedYears.push(currentYear - i)\n    }\n  } else if (explicitYears.length &gt; 0) {\n    mentionedYears = [...new Set(explicitYears)] // Remove duplicates\n  }\n\n  // If no years mentioned, default to last 5 years\n  if (mentionedYears.length === 0) {\n    const last5Years = []\n    for (let i = 0; i &lt; 5; i++) {\n      last5Years.push(currentYear - i)\n    }\n    return availableData.filter(row =&gt;\n      last5Years.includes(row.year)\n    ).sort((a, b) =&gt; a.year - b.year)\n  }\n\n  const yearCount = mentionedYears.length\n\n  // Rule: If 3+ years mentioned, show exact years only\n  if (yearCount &gt;= 3) {\n    return availableData.filter(row =&gt;\n      mentionedYears.includes(row.year)\n    ).sort((a, b) =&gt; a.year - b.year)\n  }\n\n  // Rule: If 1-2 years mentioned, add context\n  const latestMentionedYear = Math.max(...mentionedYears)\n  const earliestMentionedYear = Math.min(...mentionedYears)\n\n  let minYear: number\n  let maxYear: number\n\n  if (latestMentionedYear === currentYear)\n}",

Added the financial statements display. The page now shows three tables:

## What I Added:

1. **Income Statement Table**:
   - Revenue, Cost of Revenue, Gross Profit
   - Gross Margin (percentage)
   - Operating Expenses, Operating Income
   - Operating Margin (percentage)
   - Net Income, Net Margin (percentage)
   - EPS (Basic)

2. **Balance Sheet Table**:
   - Total Assets, Current Assets, Cash & Equivalents
   - Total Liabilities, Current Liabilities, Long-Term Debt
   - Shareholders' Equity
   - Debt-to-Equity (ratio)
   - Current Ratio (ratio)

3. **Cash Flow Statement Table**:
   - Operating Cash Flow
   - Investing Cash Flow
   - Financing Cash Flow
   - Capital Expenditures
   - Free Cash Flow

## Features:

- **Multi-year display**: Years as columns (most recent first)
- **Formatting**:
  - Currency values with B/T/M/K suffixes
  - Percentages with % symbol
  - Ratios with 2 decimal places
  - EPS formatted as currency
- **Responsive tables**: Horizontal scrolling on smaller screens
- **Dark mode support**: Styling for light and dark themes
- **Hover effects**: Row highlighting on hover

All three statements are visible on the page, stacked vertically. Each table shows the last 5 years of data side-by-side for easy comparison.
